novel_info.title: Danmachi: A Mage's Journey
novel_info.author: Astralicity
novel_info.summary: Arriving into the World of Danmachi, not only was Akira penniless, but his body had also turned into that of a child.Just when he thought he would struggle to survive in this world, a screen suddenly appeared in front of him.Then, Akira's body transformed, possessing Dark Eyes and becoming a DFO Male Mage, mastering the power of the 5 sub-classes.Invited by Alise, he joined the Astraea Familia.Embarking on an endless journey, ultimately becoming the strongest.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 1: Thrown Into a New World
chapters.content:
In a dark alley, a white light flashed and then a young man suddenly appeared.
With a bang, the boy fell to the ground, the sound startling the rats that were dining in the garbage dump.
"Ugh, it hurts."
Akira opened his eyes with difficulty. He propped up his heavy body with his hands, squatted on the ground, and touched his forehead with his fingers.
"Where is this? I remember I was playing games at home." Akira looked around blankly.
He was surrounded by unfamiliar khaki walls and a faint stench.
Looking at the palm of his hand, he saw a clean and tender little hand. Akira quickly touched his body and found that his height had shortened a lot, about 1.5 meters, and his body looked like that of a 13-year-old.
The sudden change frightened Akira. He propped himself up against the wall with his hands and staggered out of the dim alley.
The bright sunlight stung his eyes. He blinked a few times and looked around.
The busy streets did not have any modern buildings. Instead, it looked like a medieval scene. The people around him were dressed in clothes that could only be found in fantasy novels.
A group of people wearing armor made of leather and metal and equipped with a variety of weapons.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
A girl with animal ears on her head and a girl with long pointed ears walked together, shopping at the stalls with bamboo baskets in their hands.
In the distance stood a huge tower, with its peak reaching the sky. One could not help but wonder where the end of the tower was.
It reminded Akira of the Bible, where humans united to build a tower that they hoped would lead to heaven, also known as the Tower of Babel.
"So, what is this place? It can't be a different world than the one I know and live in, right? I'm just an ordinary person. Please don't mess with me." Akira muttered to himself.
He pinched his thigh hard with his hand, letting the pain calm him down a little. Although his body was shaking uncontrollably due to his inner fear, he still forced himself to stand up and sit back in the alley.
"Calm down. I need to understand what is going on, where I am, and what is happening."
Akira forced himself to calm down and think about the problem.
"First of all, I must have transmigrated to another world. The animal-eared girl and the elf just now didn't look fake, they didn't look like headbands or props."
Akira thought about the information he had just collected.
"Next, these people are carrying weapons and armor, and even staffs, which means this should be a world of swords and magic."
At this moment, bustling sounds rang out from outside the alley.
"Wow, it's the captain of the Astraea familia, Alise Lovell, who is known as the Scarlet Harnel."
"There is also the vice-captain Gojouno Kaguya, who is known as Yamato Rindou, Ryuu Lion, and Lyra, who is known as Thrail."
There was a sudden noise outside. Although he didn't know why he could hear and understand their language, now was not the time to worry about it, so Akira quickly stuck his head out.
A girl with long shiny red hair, a one-handed sword on her waist, with a visible enthusiasm on her face, waved and greeted everyone.
Behind her were three girls, a girl in a Japanese kimono, with black hair and squinty eyes, an elf girl in hot pants, a mask, and long golden hair, and a short girl with short pink hair.
"They look familiar, and I seem to have heard of them somewhere before, but I can actually understand what they say." Akira thought.
"Ryuu Lion, there is also her familia?"
Is it wrong to try to pick up girls in a dungeon or Danmachi for short. This is a world where various races live in harmony. In this world, humans are not the only race with wisdom. There are also many other wise races such as elves, orcs, dwarves, and even "Gods".
In this world, the labyrinth city Orario is the center of the world as it is the only city in the world that has a dungeon.
Since the Gods are basically immortal, their lifespans are much longer than any other species. The endless years made their hearts very empty and bored, so they descended to the mortal world and sealed up their divine powers.
They bestowed their blessing or Falna on the beings on earth, giving them the possibility to become stronger, so that they could survive in a world full of monsters and form groups called "familias". Therefore, if you want to become stronger, you must join the familia of God.
As a city created by mortals and gods, countless intelligent creatures yearn to come to this city, join a familia, become an adventurer, and realize their dreams.
However, realizing your dreams is not something you can do simply by talking about it. Obtaining a falna will not allow you to make rapid progress or reach the sky in one step.
Only through self-discipline, polishing of body and mind, and even defeating monsters stronger than oneself to achieve great things, can one become stronger. Each step is extremely difficult, and one may even lose their life.
"So, what should I do to join a familia? From my current appearance, it can be seen at a glance that I am a loser who can't even beat a chicken."
"Maybe I can't even beat Bell when he first arrived in Orario. No god except Hestia was willing to let him join their familia. Then the chances of me being accepted into a familia is even lower." Akira thought bitterly.
At this moment, accompanied by a familiar music, a character selection panel suddenly appeared in front of him with a countdown.
[1]
[2]
[3]
Before Akira could react, a character had already been selected on the screen.
[DFO character: Mage (male), beginning to transform the body.]
As the fonts appeared on the screen, Akira's body suddenly erupted with a heart-wrenching pain.
It seemed that various parts of his body were being peeled off, his organs were leaving his body, nails were hitting his head, his fingers were shaking uncontrollably, and he rolled around.
"Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!!"
Akira's screams rang out in the dark alley. The severe pain made it impossible for him to maintain his consciousness for long. After a short while, he fainted.
"Hey, what happened?" A clear voice sounded before Akira fell into a coma.
······
When Akira opened his eyes again, he saw a pure white ceiling.
"Strange ceiling, was I rescued?"
When he stood up, Akira noticed the changes in his body. He felt like an overwhelming vitality and vigor.
Although his body is now that of a child, he still felt a sense of power flowing in his body. He had a feeling that he could jump two or three meters.
"Are you awake? Is there anything wrong with your body?" A clear voice sounded beside his ears.
A girl in a white and blue short skirt, a white hat, with silver hair and purple eyes stood aside.
Akira was stunned for a moment, then quickly replied, "It's no big deal. Thank you for your help. May I ask where this place is?"
"This is the treatment room of the Dian Cecht familia. The people of the Astraea familia said that you had no external injuries, but you fainted on the ground. You might have been cursed, so they brought you here." The girl responded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 2: Joining the Astraea Familia?
chapters.content:
Akira asked, "Really? Who are you?"
"I am Airmid Teasanare from the Dian Cecht familia. I am a healer. If you are injured or sick, you can come to me."
"Dea saint, huh? It seems I'm here too early, and it's not time for the main story yet." Akira thought as he looked at the girl in front of him.
He asked, "Airmid-san, has the Astraea familia left?"
Airmid replied, "No, not yet. Do you want me to call them now?"
Akira said, "Please don't. I want to thank them."
"Okay, please wait here, I'll be back soon." Ahmed said and stood up to leave.
A few minutes later.
"Hi, are you okay?" An enthusiastic voice sounded.
Airmid said, "Please don't make too much noise, Alise-san."
"Okay, I'm going to knock on the door!"
Knock Knock!
"Come in." Akira replied, tidying up his clothes and bed sheets.
Five girls came in from the door.
"Wow, I didn't look closely when I brought him here, this child is so cute." Alise said in amazement.
"Indeed, he is an elf like Ryuu." Lyra said.
"Indeed, at least she is much prettier than this stupid useless elf." The smiling black-haired girl Kaguya teased the elf girl beside her.
"You, you…" Ryuu gritted her teeth.
"Elf? Me?" Akira was startled and quickly touched his ears.
Fortunately, the ears were just a little pointier and longer, and there was no big difference from his original ears.
"What's wrong? Are you still feeling uncomfortable?" Alise asked worriedly.
The others also looked over.
"No, I'm fine now. I was just thinking about how to thank you."
Being stared at by so many people, especially girls, Akira felt a little anxious.
"Ah! I haven't asked your name yet. I'm Alise. They are Kaguya, Lyra, and Ryuu." Alise pointed at the others and said.
Akira said, "I am Akira. Thank you again for your help."
Alise's cheerful voice echoed in the ward, "Akira, don't keep thanking me. Are you okay now? Do you need us to send you back to your familia? After all, Orario is a bit chaotic right now, and you're a patient now."
Akira said, "Um... I haven't joined a Familia, and this is my first time in Orario."
Alise said, "Ah, you fainted in the alley the first time you came here. You are so unlucky. If you didn't have any injuries, I would have thought you were bullied."
"Alise! How rude!" Kaguya smiled and tapped Alise's head.
"As expected of the stupid captain. You can say such rude words. Right, Ryuu?" Lyra said to Ryuu with a chuckle.
"...Is that so?" Ryuu replied in panic.
The other three looked at each other and laughed.
"Well, if there is no problem, I will take my leave first. There are other patients who need treatment." Airmid suddenly said.
"Okay, thank you, Airmid."
"Don't mention it." Airmid closed the door gently and left.
"Well... although it's a little hard to say, I don't have any money on me right now. Can you pay the medical expenses first?" Akira asked bitterly.
"I will find a chance to pay it back."
"Hmm, although I don't mind this little money, but seeing your determined look..."
"Why don't you join our familia?" Alise said loudly, as if she had a good idea.
"Eh!"
All four of them, including Akira were shocked by the idea.
"This way you don't have to pay it back, right?"
"Alise! What are you talking about? Don't make a decision on your own suddenly." Lyra complained.
"Foolish captain, you are not just saying it out of impulse again, are you? All of our members are girls." Kaguya's forehead was tense and she said to Alise with a dark face.
"Um...shouldn't Astraea-sama decide who can join the familia?" Ryuu said seriously.
"I have a feeling that Akira joining us must be a good thing, so let's go back and ask Astraea-sama if we can let Akira stay." Alise said proudly.
After several examinations, Akira was found to be in very good health, being only mentally tired, so Airmid said that Akira could leave early.
Following behind the group of four and listening to their quarrel, Akira did not dare to disturb them.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
After all, it was related to whether he could have a place to live and protection.
Now is the most chaotic period in Orario. Without enough strength or a familia, who knows what might happen to him?
After crossing the main street, and turning a few corners, they arrived at a quiet residential area at a corner in the southwestern area of ​​Orario.
"We're here. This is the residence of our Astraea familia, the Stardust Garden." Alise said, pointing to the small but very beautiful mansion.
The mansion was mainly white, with a solid wall built around it, an open space, a sea of ​​flowers in the center, and a warm atmosphere.
"It's really beautiful." Akira looked at the white mansion in front of him in awe.
He had thought that a small familia of 11 people would at most live in a one-story building like an apartment, but their residence turned out to be a mansion. But that makes sense. After all, the Astraea familia, at least the current one, is very strong.
"Hehe, you didn't expect this, right? This is all the result of the hard work of everyone in the familia, under the leadership of a wise captain like me." Alise said proudly with her hands on her hips.
After Alise opened the door of the Mansion, a beautiful goddess stood up from the sofa to greet everyone.
At first sight, she seemed like a kind, gentle, and compassionate goddess with firm faith.
Her long brown hair gave a feeling of warmth and elegance, and her eyes that were as blue as the sea of ​​stars, attracted the viewer like the starry sky.
The flawless white coat did her extraordinary figure justice, but also covered her soft body. Her manners and actions gave off a vibe of nobility and elegance.
She exuded a maternal temperament. Coupled with the twin giants, it was safe to say that she was a mommy type.
"Everyone, welcome back." The gentle voice lingered in the air, and Astraea smiled.
"Astraea-sama!"
Seeing Astraea greet them, Alise was the first to speak, not hiding her joy at all.
She was just like a child who admires their mother, feeling a kind of "admiration" that is different from loyalty and respect.
"We are back, Astraea-sama." The others responded.
Akira stood there, not knowing whether to move forward or backward, and could only look at them awkwardly.
"Oh, who is this child?" Astraea looked at Akira with a smile.
"Ah! Astraea-sama this is the child we found outside. His name is Akira. He is as unlucky as Ryuu." Alise said, pulling Akira's hand.
"Alise! Why do you keep talking about this?!" Ryuu embarrassedly said.
In fact, before she was granted a falna, Ryuu was surrounded by thugs and almost trafficked. If she fell into their hands, she would be sold at a high price. After all, there is always a demand for elves.
Looking at Astraea, Akira was so nervous that he was almost speechless.
He said, "Hello, Astraea-sama. Thank you very much for your familia's help."
Akira suddenly smelled a faint fragrance, and saw that Astraea had suddenly appeared in front of him.
She reached out and stroked Akira's head, saying, "Don't be nervous, child. This is what we are pursuing for justice. I am also very happy that you could get help."
Akira suddenly felt a little hot, and his fair face turned red.
He quickly took a step back and said, "Um... Astraea-sama, I want to join your familia and become a member of justice."
(T/N: This reminds me of Toppo, lol.)
'I feel like I'm going to faint. She is really too beautiful.'

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 3: Skills and Magic Right at the Start
chapters.content:
"I welcome children with a sense of justice to join the familia, but—" Astraea showed a troubled expression.
"My familia is made up of girls, and they worked hard to build it. I didn't contribute much in the process."
"So, if you want to join our familia, you need the consent of all of them, right?"
"Well, I understand. Thank you for your support." Akira said gratefully.
It was basically certain that Astarea had agreed.
"Hehehe, so this is how Astraea-sama sees me. That's right! This familia grew stronger because of me as the captain!" Alise shook her hair and showed a proud attitude.
"Haha, a proud, hot-blooded idiot as a captain. So unlucky!" Kaguya said venomously. "
"Astraea-sama was clearly talking about us, but you took all the credit. Shameless!"
Lyra whispered to Ryuu, "What do you think, Ryuu?"
'Ryuu replied, "I don't care.''
Astraea clapped her hands and said, "That's enough. Call everyone over for a meeting."
— — —
After learning that Akira wanted to join the familia, all members gathered in the conference room.
Alise, Kaguya, Lyra, Ryuu, Neze, Noin, Asta, Ryana, Celty, Iska, Maryuu.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
The bold girls swarmed over to Akira as soon as they saw him. They surrounded him, touched his head, touched his face, and chattered.
Menawhile, the shy and quiet girls just watched from the side and got to know the situation from the people around them.
"Finally, there's a new guy, and he's a cute boy."
"His hair is also very smooth, and it's black like Kaguya and Iska."
"His face is so red, this child is shy, hahaha."
Akira had a numb expression on his face. He suddenly felt that it might be a bit difficult to join this familia, as it was full of girls, ONLY girls.
Kaguya walked over to Astraea and said as she watched Akira being toyed with, "Is this really okay? Astraea-sama, we are all women here. If he joins us, it will be troublesome for both him and us."
Astraea said, "How about giving this child a chance? I can see that he is a well-behaved, upright and has a sense of justice, but it is just hidden in his heart. He will not let us down."
"That's right, Kaguya is always suspicious, which is why people don't like her." Alise made a face at Kaguya and said.
Kaguya said, "Humph, you are too naive. What if he was sent by Evilus?"
Lyra crossed her arms and said, "Hey, Kaguya-chan, don't be like this all the time, right, Ryuu?"
Ryuu said, "That's right, you venomous woman."
Kaguya said, "Ha, you want to fight, you useless elf!"
A fistfight was about to break out.
"Okay, you all agree to let Akira join the familia, right?" Astraea's gentle voice stopped the noise in the meeting room.
''Agreed.''×11
Astraea walked up to Akira and held his hand.
"Then you are welcome to the familia."
— — —
Astraea's bedroom
''Then please take off your clothes, Akira.''
"Okay."
Akira sat on the chair, took off his shirt, and turned his back to Astraea.
"That's not it. I meant everything."
"Um, okay. Eh, everything?"
"Hehe, just kidding."
Astraea smiled and pierced her finger with a needle. A ray of divine power leaked out and a crystal clear divine blood oozed out.
She began to carve on Akira's back with her finger, and divine light flashed.
"Using the Sacred Text as a guide and the blood of God as a medium, we the gods depict your abilities in an easy to understand way with specific numerical values."
"As long as someone can read the Sacred Text, they can confirm the abilities of those of you who have received a falna with their naked eyes."
"After being blessed by the gods, all your potential, talents, body, and soul will be materialized."
"I cannot grant you great power, nor can I change your fate."
"You will remain the same even after receiving a falna. It will not increase your power in the slightest."
"What are you longing for, what are you looking forward to, how are you going to do it, what path are you going to take, and ultimately, who you really are."
"As your goddess, I can only bless you."
Falna is just falna. Every god grants falna to their people, but there will be basically no change after receiving a falna.
There is no such thing as the falna gained from a powerful god being stronger or better, and there is no such thing as the falna gained from a weak god being weak or worse in comparison.
The only function of a falna is to discover and materialize ability values ​​based on accumulated experience points or excelia.
What the person has seen, heard, and done will be evaluated by the gods and recorded in the falna on their backs.
Astraea smiled, looking at the sword and wings that was her symbol.
Under the watchful eyes of his Goddess, Akira took a step towards becoming righteous.
In this way, the ceremony of bestowing falna was over.
"Astraea-sama, is it over?" Akira asked as the fingers on his back left.
Astraea said, "The ceremony is over. I was just surprised."
"Surprised?"
Now, it was Akira's turn to be surprised.
How could his ordinary talent surprise Astraea, a goddess?
"Well, I'm very surprised."
Astraea showed an unconcealable joy, and gently touched Akira's back with her slender fingers.
"You have awakened a magic and three skills, all of which are very powerful."
"That's awesome."
Although Akira knew that his body had been modified, he was still surprised to hear this.
Only a few people have skills at LV 1, and he has multiple skills at that. Such people are undoubtedly gifted.
For example, Finn, who spent four years in the mountains honing his skills and strategies, met Loki at the age of fourteen and gained a magic and three skills right when he got a falna.
Astraes said, "This has nothing to do with practice, but is closely related to experience, and is most directly related to interest and recognition in something. It is not an exaggeration to say that it is the power to materialize the fantasies and thoughts in your heart."
"No, I got this because I cheated, even though it hurts like hell." Akira thought to himself.
After being granted a falna, everything, whether known or unknown, will be materialized. This is the effect of a falna.
Through the falna, one can clearly see someone's hidden power.
Astraea said, "Skills can be acquired through practice, but magic is a miracle. It is the proof of the world's blessing and one's own potential."
"The magic and skills you obtained this time are the top of the top. Akira, you are undoubtedly a natural hero. Even Ryuu is far inferior to you."
Akira was almost embarrassed by the excessive praise.
"Astraea-sama, if you keep saying that to me, I'll become arrogant." Akira said helplessly.
"Hehe, how cute."
Although she was elegant and gentle, Astraea was not a serious and old-fashioned goddess. Instead, she was more like a mischievous elder sister with a maternal vibe.
Then, Astraea took out parchment and covered Akira's back. A fluorescent circle flashed, and the sacred letters on Akira's back were copied and converted into common language.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 4: 1 Magic and 3 Skills
chapters.content:
Akira looked at the parchment and fell silent.
"What's wrong? Is there something you don't understand?" Astraea stood beside Akira, bent over, and whispered in his pointed ear.
"Is it because I have joined her familia, she no longer feels so distant, or is it because I am still a child and she is not on guard against me?" Akira thought as he looked at Astraea approaching him.
Akira asked, "Astraea-sama, can I ask you for a favor?"
"No problem, what's the matter?" Astraea replied while stroking Akira's ear.
Akira helplessly said, "Can you please explain to me what is written on this parchment? And can you teach me the common language in the future? I don't know the common language."
Although he was a little shy, he still explained the situation calmly.
Astraea looked at Akira's red ears, smiled gently and said, "Haha, I see. Let me explain your magic and skills to you first. I will arrange for someone to teach you the common language later."
She pulled Akira to sit on the sofa and explained to him.
Akira

Awakening
– Clear the path, awaken yourself, and accelerate growth
"Elemental Magic, Dark Eyes, and Immortality can be considered the initial skills of male mages in DFO, but what about awakening?" Akira thought as he listened to Astraea's explanation.
Astraea said, "What a powerful configuration, one magic and three skills. They are all skills that I have never heard of, but I know that they are awesome. It is really hard to imagine how powerful you will be in the future."
"In addition, I would like to remind you that, generally speaking, you should not reveal your ability values ​​to anyone except your most trusted familia members and God, so as to avoid being targeted by people with bad intentions, not to mention that Orario is in a state of chaos right now."
Akira obediently said, "I understand. I will obey Astraea-sama."
Seeing Akira's well-behaved appearance, Astraea smiled with satisfaction.
Astraea said, "But don't worry too much. I will use my divine blood to lock your status, which means hiding your falna to prevent others from prying."
"You are my child, I will protect you."
— — —
After the ceremony, Astraea called Alise, Kaguya, Lyra and Ryuu over and told them that Akira was very talented.
"More than Ryuu?" Alise asked curiously.
"Well, Akira has awakened a magic and three skills, and they are all very powerful abilities." Astraea replied while touching Akira's head.
"Alise really picked up a treasure. Every time you go out, you can bring a genius with you. Just like Ryuu, do you have any skills to pick up geniuses?" Lyra complained loudly.
Alise proudly said, "Ahahahaha, that's right, this is my extraordinary ability as the captain of the Astraea familia."
Kaguya scoffed, "You're just a lucky fellow, you hot-blooded fool."
Ryuu helplessly said, "…Why do you keep saying that I was picked up by the captain?"
Astraea said, "Well, in the future... Akira will definitely become the trump card of our familia. Whether it is an adventure to the dungeon to subjugate monsters or to protect Orario, his strength is indispensable, so I ask you to take care of him a little."
''Understood!''×4
Astraea did not tell them the specific abilities. She only told them about the magic [Element Control] that Akira had. Other skills were not suitable for publicity.
"Well, everyone has worked all day, so go to bed early. I'll prepare a room for Akira next." Astraea said with a smile.
"By the way, Kaguya, could you please teach Akira some common characters when you have time?"
Kaguya looked at Akira with a smile and said, "Hehe, leave it to me. I will make sure our ace learns the common language as soon as possible."
Akira helplessly said, "Well... I might learn slowly, so don't expect too much."
Although he didn't know why, as soon as he arrived in this world, he could speak the common language instinctively and understand others.
But it is really difficult to start learning a language now.
He could only hope that the transformation had transformed his brain as well.
"Then let's go and choose your room." Astraea took Akira's hand and said.
"Astraea-sama, can you please not hold my hand?" Akira asked in a low voice.
"I just want to get closer to Akira, does Akira hate me?" Astraea spoke in a pitiful tone, like she was acting coquettishly or teasing.
Akira hurriedly said, "No, no, I like Astraea-sama too. It's just that... Aren't things progressing too fast? I can't stand it."
"Ah~, is this a confession of love, Akira?" Astraea's pitiful face quickly turned into a smile.
Akira closed his mouth tightly and faced it in silence.
Alise and the others watched the scene and made sounds of envy.
"Astraea-sama likes Akira very much."
"After all, he is very talented, a long-awaited new member, and a good kid."
"Hmph, you make Astraea-sama sound like a goddess who gets bored easily! However, Ryuu, your place in the goddess' heart is about to be taken away."
"You, don't say anything extra."
— — —
''Do you see a room you like?''
Akira chose a room in a remote corner, while the women lived in another building, and Astraea lived with them.
"Well, go to bed early. Tomorrow you will need to buy equipment with Alise and then go to the guild to register as an adventurer."
''I see.''
Akira lied on the bed and took a long breath. He was finally alone.
''Panel.''
A screen appeared in front of him, with five modules occupying it.
[Personal Information]

[Backpack]
[Task]
"Is this my cheat? What a simple panel." Akira looked at it and commented.
Akira pointed at [Personal Information] and passed his finger through the screen, but nothing changed.
"Is this panel fake?" Akira pointed to the other modules, but there was still no response.
"Oh! I understand now."
Akira thought to himself, "Open the personal information."
The [Personal Information] module on the screen expanded and occupied the entire screen.
[Personal Information]

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 5: Ryuu VS Akira
chapters.content:
"The amount of information is too little. At least add a few more uses. Never mind. Simplicity has its advantages. At least it's understandable." Akira comforted himself.
Clicking into the [Skill Bar], he saw that it was very rich, unlike [Personal Information]. Putting aside the early common skills, the skills of the five subclasses were also in it, but many of the skills were dark.
The only skills that had been unlocked were Wind Strike and Ice Ball. There seemed to be nothing like skill points in [Skill Bar]. Maybe the skills can be unlocked as long as the level is raised to the corresponding stage.
When clicking on [Backpack], Akira saw 30 slots, one of which contained a level 1 gift pack.
He opened the gift pack, and a weapon selection package, 5 bottles of red potions, 5 blue potions and a level 10 gift pack appear.
For weapon selection, Akira chose an ordinary magic wand. To handle the melee aspect, he had decided to buy a spear when purchasing equipment tomorrow.
After that, he clicked [Task] just to see that there was already a task waiting for him.
Three months later, survive the "Return of the Gods" and "Seven Days of Death" and fight against Evilus.
Reward: An Artifact
'That means there are still three months left. To be of help, I need to at least have a level 2 falna and reach level 15 so that I can perform class advancement.' Akira thought.
Perhaps it was because he was exhausted from going through so many things today, he fell asleep as soon as he closed his eyes.
.....
Early morning
Akira closed his eyes and fumbled around the pillow. When he didn't find his phone, he opened his eyes and stared blankly at what was in front of him.
"Ah, I am no longer in my old world."
After washing up, he went to the kitchen and found that Astraea had already prepared breakfast.
"Morning, Astraea-sama." Akira raised his hand to greet her.
"Good morning, Akira. Would you like to have breakfast first, or wait for everyone to eat together?" Astraea responded, supporting her face with her hands on the table.
"Let's eat together."
After a while
"Good morning." Ryuu and Kaguya opened the door and came in.
Then the other girls got up one after another.
"Good morning! Today is a very energetic day, hahaha." Alise the last one to arrive, said.
"Lion-san, can you practice with me later? I want to try out some skills." Akira said to Ryuu who was sitting next to Astraea.
Ryuu replied, ''No problem.''
Iska said, "Hey, are you challenging Ryuu right off the bat? Is this true?"
"Astraea-sama, can we go and watch?"
Astraea clapped her hands and said, "Okay."
— — —
Akira picked up a wooden sword in the training ground. Although he didn't know any sword skills, he could at least perform basic chops.
Ryuu also stood aside holding a wooden sword.
Akira took a deep breath.
Facing a powerful second-class adventurer, he was very nervous.
He held the wooden sword diagonally across his chest and strode towards Ryuu, with a magical whirlwind secretly condensing in his left hand.
The wooden swords collided with each other, and the moment Akira was pushed back, he pressed the whirlwind in his left hand towards Ryuu, and quickly jumped back a few steps under the resulting force.
The whirlwind only blew Ryuu's golden hair before it was shattered by the wooden sword.
Akira placed one hand on the hand holding the sword, and ice condensed on the tip of the sword. An ice ball quickly took shape, flying towards Ryuu. Water gathered around the ice and fired at Ryuu, quickly following the ice ball, intending to launch a double attack.
Ryuu took a step forward, and with quick steps, she used her wooden sword to split the ice ball in two, and at the same time, the wooden sword instantly turned back and chopped at Akira's wooden sword.
Akira's eyes trembled, and the sword in his hand was quickly pushed away. Before the whirlwind in his hand could be fully condensed, Ryuu's wooden sword was already on his neck.
Ryuu calmly said, ''You lose.''
Akira sat on the ground, panting, for a while. "Well, I lost. Lion-san is really amazing."
Ryuu shook her head and said, "That's not true. You just received a falna and have already achieved this level. Not to mention that your talent is better than mine. You will definitely surpass me soon."
The Astraea familia members gathered around.
Iska picked up Akira in a familiar manner and said, "You're quite good."
"You actually used two magics without a chant."
"Is this your magic, little Akira?"
Ignoring the commotion over there, Kaguya came to Alise's side and said, "It's really too stressful for this guy to fight with Ryuu right after receiving a falna."
Alise shook her head and said, "Hahaha, it's okay. Isn't it a good thing that the power of justice has increased? Before he becomes stronger, let us protect him!"
She had a dazzling smile on her face.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on
"Then, can Kaguya temporarily guide Akira's adventure next?" Astraea approached the two of them, stroking their heads and said.
"Leave it to me, Astraea-sama." Kaguya blushed as she enjoyed Astraea's love.
"Come to think of it, Akira has joined our familia, so let's do that!" Alise said excitedly.
Everyone, let's do that!"
Alise strode confidently over to Akira, her ruby-red hair swaying like fire as she extended her hand toward him with a radiant smile.
"Akira, you probably don't know about our vow yet, do you?"
"Vow?"
She explained, her expression growing solemn yet full of light, "You can't lie in front of a goddess. In her presence, your words become your truest feelings."
Her smile brightened at that very moment—warm, honest, and impossible to resist.
Faced with her irresistible aura, a few of the girls around them couldn't help but avert their eyes, their cheeks turning pink.
"Do we have to say it aloud? I feel kind of embarrassed." Lyra muttered.
"Yeah, I'm not really good at saying things out loud like that…" Kaguya added with a nervous chuckle.
"Lyra, Kaguya, come on, be serious now. I-I'm not embarrassed at all." A blushing Ryuu chimed in, trying hard to hide her shyness.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 6: The Dungeon
chapters.content:
Ignoring Ryuu's flustered face, Alisa clapped her hands, her voice commanding. "Alright, everyone! Get ready!"
One by one, the members of the Astraea Familia stacked their hands, forming a solemn circle of unity. At the top of the stack was Ryuu's hand.
Only one person remained—Akira.
Alise urged with a grin, "Hurry up and place your hand too. You're our partner now."
Akira hesitated for a breath, then slowly placed his hand on top. The moment his skin touched Ryuu's, he felt her hand slightly tremble. Yet she didn't recoil.
As an elf, Ryuu carried a deep-rooted custom—never allowing skin contact unless she accepted the person.
If it were anyone else, she would have shaken them off without hesitation. But this time, she didn't.
Her face flushed with color, and she struggled to maintain her composure.
"Mission accomplished! Correct the scales! Until the day I fall and become a star!"
"Maintain order! Fight against evil! Justice will never die in our hearts!"
The solemn chant of justice echoed in the air like a sacred hymn.
It was the anthem of the Astraea Familia.
Their declaration.
Their proof.
"Running side by side with the sky, filling this land with star trails!"
This was the vow engraved deep within the hearts of those who lived for righteousness.
"Swear to the sword and wings of justice!"
"Swear to the sword and wings of justice!"
Akira's voice joined theirs, firm and unwavering.
Under Astraea's watchful gaze, he and the girls bound themselves to a shared oath—a promise of justice.
Akira silently thought, 'I don't particularly yearn for justice, but… for their sake, why not become a partner of justice?'
After the vow concluded, Kaguya turned to him and said, "Let's go. First, I'll take you to get your equipment. Then, we begin your first adventure."
Kaguya led him down a narrow path veering away from the main street, guiding him toward the heart of Orario's southwestern district, a region filled with shops and upscale residences.
In the center stood a stately branch of the Hephaestus Familia's workshop, across from which was the Blue Pharmacy, owned by the Miach Familia.
"That's the place." Kaguya said, pointing to a shop.
Its design matched the elegant yet sturdy buildings that surrounded it.
"Alise said it's best to use ordinary gear at first."
Kaguya explained as they approached, "Later, we can forge better equipment using materials from monsters. This'll do for now."
Inside, Akira and Kaguya selected basic armor pieces and a spear measuring approximately 1.7 meters in length. All of it was funded by the generous pocket money given to Akira by their captain.
Afterward, they made their way to the city's center—toward the Tower of Babel.
The towering white spire stretched endlessly into the sky, piercing the heavens with an awe-inspiring presence.
Despite Orario's appearance as a thriving metropolis, at its core, it was a fortress built around the Dungeon—a military stronghold wrapped in civilization.
The Tower of Babel wasn't just for show. It served a crucial purpose.
Acting as a seal and cover for the Dungeon beneath, suppressing the monstrous nest below that once overflowed with chaos.
From afar, the tower looked majestic. But up close, it was overwhelming.
They entered.
A vast corridor stretched ahead, leading into a massive underground cavern nearly ten meters high.
A spiraling staircase curled along the inner wall of the colossal cylindrical space, leading them downward—into the depths beneath the Tower of Babel.
The first underground floor was vast, wide enough to accommodate thousands at once.
This was a safe zone—a haven from the madness below.
Two cloaked figures walked quietly, hoods covering their features, as they reached the true entrance to the Dungeon.
Although this place was underground, the light-blue crystalline walls shone faintly, illuminating their surroundings with a mysterious, magical glow.
Before them stretched a living labyrinth—natural tunnels twisting in every direction, an underground maze that swallowed the unprepared.
Even with a map, a novice like Akira could easily lose himself in this subterranean nightmare.
Then—
Bang!
A sharp crack shattered the silence. Stone splintered. Spiderweb-like cracks spread across the walls.
From the shadows, four goblins emerged. Small, hunched, unarmed—but their bloodshot eyes burned with savage fury.
The first one roared and charged.
"Go."
Kaguya said coolly, "It's time to fight monsters."
Akira didn't hesitate. He stepped forward.
With swift precision, he drove his spear through a goblin's skull. Blood splattered as he spun, compressing wind magic into his fingertips.
He struck another goblin in the head, causing it's skull to burst apart in a red mist.
Without stopping, he sidestepped a claw swipe and swung his spear again, slamming two goblins into one another.
Before they could recover—
Boom!
A magic-infused ice orb exploded between them, freezing and shattering their bodies.
The battlefield fell silent.
"For your first outing, that wasn't bad."
Kaguya said, tossing Akira a small dagger, "Now, it's time to learn how to harvest the magic stones."
Akira frowned, eyeing the goblin corpse on the ground. With an uneasy breath, he crouched, gripped the dagger, and began to cut.
Warm blood soaked his fingers as he reached inside, groping blindly. Sticky chunks of flesh clung to his skin.
He turned to Kaguya, his expression pitiful.
"I really… don't wanna do this anymore."
"Don't act spoiled."
She replied without sympathy, "Every adventurer has to do this. No exceptions."
"Ugh… it's so gross…"
Reluctantly, Akira returned to the task at hand. After a while, his fingers brushed against something hard.
At last, he pulled it out—a magic stone no larger than a fingernail.
As soon as it was removed, the goblin's body lost its color, began to break apart, and crumbled into dust. Within seconds, it vanished completely, as though it had never existed.Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
This was the Dungeon.
A living, breathing labyrinth.
Monsters emerged from the walls, only to disappear into them again.
No matter how many were slain, the tide never ended.
Kaguya asked, "By the way, how much do you know about the Astraea familia?"
Akira replied, "Emm... It has been less than five years since its establishment, but it is strong and united. All members are women, and it is a righteous clan."
Kaguya asked, "So, do you know the price of maintaining order and justice?"
Akira solemnly said, "Offending others."
Kaguy nodded and said, "That's right. Maintaining order means we will fight against those evil familias, and enforcing justice means we have to fight evil head-on."
"So our Astraea familia is not really welcome in Orario. For justice and order, we have offended many people."
"Adventurers can die at any time, so bullying is everywhere. We are too noble and don't fit in in Orario. If we can't get along with them, we will be seen as a thorn in their eyes."
"Of course, they don't dare to confront us openly, because we are strong and united, and we are the protectors of Orario."
"They dare not attack us who have grown up. But it is different for a novice like you. In the next adventure, do not trust anyone except your familia, and do not reveal that you are a member of the Astraea familia."
Akira understood what Kaguya meant and asked, "Does that mean I have to take this risk alone?"
Kaguya said, "Well, all the members of our familia are familiar faces, and you are the only newcomer. If you are found to be in a team with us, it may bring you unnecessary trouble."
"No matter what, you are also a member of our familia. I don't want to hear that you are injured."

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 7: War Shadows
chapters.content:
Akira looked at Kaguya. Her expression was blank, yet her words carried clear concern. Just like that, the heavy pressure on his chest seemed to melt away. A smile quietly bloomed on his face.
"Yeah... I understand, Kaguya-mom."
"Haa? What did you just call me?! Idiot! Stupid! Fool!"
Kaguya's expression instantly shifted, like a thundercloud ready to burst.
She spun around and grabbed Akira's cheeks without mercy and said, "You dare call me 'Mom' just because I treat you a little well?! I'm really too nice to you!"
"It hurts! It hurts! I was wrong, Kaguya-nee! Kaguya-nee!!"
— — —
The second floor welcomed them with four grotesque clown-like monsters and a gecko-shaped lizard clinging to the wall.
"Heh, let me show you something I just came up with."
Akira raised his spear. Wind began to swirl at its tip, spinning like a tightly compressed drill.
The vortex of air blew through his black hair as he grinned.
"Wind Spear—Charge!"
He lunged. The spear struck out three times in rapid succession, each blow piercing into one of the clown monsters. In an instant, all three dropped lifelessly, their bodies dissolving into ash.
At the same time, he twisted just in time to dodge the snapping tongue of the wall-crawling lizard.
Power surged through his legs as he stepped forward, twisting his waist and hurling the spear. It whistled through the air and pinned the lizard cleanly to the wall, ending its life in one move.
The last remaining clown monster trembled, screeching in fear as it turned to flee.
"Hmph. You think it's that easy to escape?" Akira smirked and said.
He mimicked the shape of a pistol with his fingers. A sharp ice cone formed at the tip, wrapped in a howling vortex of wind.
With a snap, the projectile shot forward. The cone caught up to the fleeing monster in an instant.
Upon impact, the swirling wind erupted like a blast, shattering the creature's body and dropping a glowing magic stone.
"Hah~"
Akira blew on his fingers as if cooling a real weapon, then tucked his hand back to his waist like a cowboy.
Kaguya stood frozen, watching Akira's bizarre theatrics unfold one after another.
She said, "...You really are an idiot. You've changed too much. And hurry up, go retrieve your weapons!"
"Ahahaha, sorry. I just got the sudden urge to play around." Akira said, scratching his cheek with a goofy grin.
"Even if it's easy for you to reach the fifth floor, don't get complacent." Kaguya scolded him, her expression serious now.
"Remember this. Never use up all your strength. Always save some, no matter what."
"You never know what accident will strike next—whether it's a monster or another adventurer."
"There are no prisons in Orario. If you kill someone, you just pay compensation. That's it."
"Only your familia will care enough to avenge you."
"Especially in the dungeon... there are no witnesses."
"No one will ever know what happened."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
She continued lecturing while leading him down toward the sixth floor.
"Since the monsters on the fifth floor are no longer a challenge for you, it's time to try facing the War Shadows."
Along the way, Akira continued clearing out goblins and ogres with smooth, practiced movements.
Once he became comfortable, he even started fighting barehanded, deliberately letting some hits land in order to sharpen his instincts.
Kaguya, acting as a temporary supporter, picked up magic stones and materials behind him.
By the time they reached the fifth floor's depths, Akira's DFO status had already risen to Level 4.
After wiping out the surrounding monsters, Kaguya finally called out.
"Alright, time to eat."
She pulled out the lunch box she had packed in the morning, filled with a variety of neatly prepared ingredients.
Akira praised, "Mmm~ So good. Kaguya-nee really is a kind person."
Kaguya replied with a huff, "...If you don't know how to compliment someone properly, just stay quiet."
"I thought you were a smart kid when I met you. But now I see you're just another idiot—just like our captain and that numbskull Ryuu."
Akira smiled faintly as he looked at her and said, "Hehe... Can't help it. We can't turn back time, so we've got to find some way to keep moving forward."
"If the people in Astraea Familia hadn't been so kind... if they hadn't let me in..."
"I might've ended up crawling to the Hostess of Fertility and begging Aunt Mia for a job in the tavern before I starved to death."
"And if that didn't work... maybe I'd just pray they'd give me some leftovers to survive on."
Ending up in this demon-filled world, if the Astraea familia hadn't shown me kindness, I probably would've become a beggar. Would a half-elf like me even get accepted into a familia?
"I see... So you've been struggling too." Kaguya murmured.
Her expression softened. She reached out and pulled Akira into a warm hug.
Akira felt the peaceful warmth radiating from her embrace, a gentle promise that he wasn't alone.
After a moment, he patted her hand and smiled. "Thanks, Kaguya-nee. You're... really warm."
Kaguya clarified, "Hehe. Don't misunderstand, I'm not comforting you or anything. I just couldn't stand seeing you sulk like that. Now come on. Go challenge the War Shadows so we can head home."
She stood up, brushing herself off, and took the lead.
— — —
The creature before them resembled a human silhouette but lacked skin, hair, or any sign of flesh. Its entire body looked like it had been dyed in pure black ink.
Its head was shaped like a cross, and its face was adorned with round, mirror-like plates. Its wrists were long and thin, each ending in three blade-like claws.
In short, it was a shadow-like entity—black from head to toe, humanoid in form, standing roughly 1.6 meters tall.
Its combat style was simple—slashing with its claws—but its physical prowess was far above that of any monster from the first five floors.
Those claws could slice through flesh like a butcher's cleaver.
For rookie adventurers used to facing goblins or kobolds, this was a walking death sentence.
Hence its nickname: [Rookie Killer].
When more than five appear together, even a seasoned Level 1 adventurer could fall victim to their assault.
Because of this, War Shadows are regarded as one of the most dangerous threats in the upper floors.
"Two War Shadows. Want me to handle one?" Kaguya asked, her hand resting on her weapon.
"No need, Kaguya-nee. I want to see how far I can push myself." Akira's voice was calm and firm.
"...Alright. If you're in danger, I'll step in."
Akira nodded. Without hesitation, he charged at the War Shadows.
With each level up, Akira found it easier to control elemental magic. Now, the moment he thought about it, a whirlwind curled around his spear like it belonged there.
The two monsters lunged simultaneously, claws slashing with a shriek of air.
Akira parried the first blow with his spear, then shifted sideways to dodge the second. His weapon lashed out like a whip, slamming into one of the War Shadow's legs.
The claws came again. Akira ducked low, letting them slice through empty air above his head. He thrust upward—his spear piercing through the War shadow's face.
The whirlwind exploded under his feet, launching him into the air. As he landed on the wall, he twisted, yanked his spear free, and hurled it like a bolt.
The whirling wind carried the spear straight through the second War Shadow's chest, pinning it to the ground.
"It's over!" Akira shouted.
Both monsters dissolved into nothingness, like melting ice.
All that remained was a pair of glimmering items: a magic stone, and the curved black blades once attached to their claws.

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - 8: What's The Difference Between an Elf And a Half-Elf?
chapters.content:
By the time Akira and Kaguya resurfaced on the ground, the skies had already descended into twilight.
Golden streetlamps spilled their glow across the cobbled roads, casting long, flickering shadows.
Despite the inherent chaos that pulsed through Orario's veins, it now seemed almost serene—alive with a mysterious aura.
The bustling night streets, filled with vendors, adventurers, and laughter, gave Akira a sense of attachment. For the first time, he felt a subtle fondness for this foreign world.
Before long, night had fully fallen.
With no towering skyscrapers to obscure the view, and no smog to pollute the air, the sky stretched wide and unfiltered. Orario's dim lighting refrained from stealing nature's spotlight.
Above them, the vast sky unfolded—clear and unobstructed.
A silver river of stars stretched across the sky, magnificently suspended in eternal stillness. It was the kind of sky Akira hadn't seen since childhood, back when he still lived in the countryside.
He stopped walking and looked up quietly, eyes glimmering with nostalgia and wonder.
The moon, radiant and full, hung beside a sea of stars.
Akira reached a hand up as if to grasp the starlight itself, then turned to face Kaguya, his tone unusually solemn.
"Under the watchful eyes of this starlit sky… I swear I'll protect you and Astraea-sama. No matter what happens."
Kaguya stared at the black-haired, black-eyed boy in silence, his sudden vow stirring something in her heart.
Finally, she gently rested her hand on his head and responded softly, "Yes. You can do it."
"Come on. Let's go home."
Side by side, they walked down the quieting street toward the Stardust Garden.
Along the way, Akira's sharp eyes caught sight of two familiar silhouettes walking ahead—one a petite girl with radiant blonde hair, the other a tall, composed elf with emerald-green locks.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
He asked, "Wait... are those the Sword Princess Ais and the Nine Hell Riveria from the Loki Familia?"
Kaguya took a careful look and nodded. "Yes, that's them. What's wrong? Do you know them? Want to go say hello?"
Akira shook his head and said, "No. I've just heard about the Sword Princess—the girl who leveled up in just one year."
Kaguya hummed thoughtfully and said, "That girl really is impressive."
"You're an elf too… well, half-elf. Isn't Riveria supposed to be a royal among elves? Do you want to go pay your respects?"
"Oh, please."
Akira replied dryly, "I've never even met her. Why should I show her respect? It's not like she's ever done anything for me."
"Hah! You really are a strange half-elf."
Kaguya said, both amused and baffled, "I heard from that useless elf Ryuu that elves are supposed to bow before royal blood."
"Is that so?"
Akira chuckled nervously and said, "Ahaha… by the way, Kaguya-nee, do you know the difference between elves and half-elves?"
Kaguya said, "Hmm. Isn't it just the shape of the ears?"
Akira sarcastically said, "Wow! Nee-san is amazing! You know so much! As expected of the vice-captain of our familia!"
"Stop it, you little brat. Do you think I'm that easy to fool?" Kaguya snapped, narrowing her eyes despite the smirk tugging at her lips.
"No, of course not. Must've been your imagination." Akira said, mentally sweating bullets.
Now that I've gone this far, how am I supposed to tell her I'm not even an elf?
— — —
"We're back!"
Upon returning to the Stardust Garden, Akira went staright to his room, took a long shower, and changed into comfortable clothes.
Once refreshed, he headed to another building—only to find several girls gathered near the door to the shower room.
Some wore casual clothes and held pajamas, clearly just done bathing. A few were chatting openly, while others looked flustered, glancing toward the hallway.
"Hey, Akira! How was your first adventure?" Iska called out.
"Heh, as a certified genius, of course it was a success! Are you ready to be amazed?" Akira declared proudly.
"Oh-ho~ Then we definitely need to check your updated stats. By the way… where's Kaguya? She didn't bully you, did she? That awkward woman isn't exactly known for being gentle." Lyra asked with a small, gentle smile.
Akira said, "Eh? Kaguya-nee was really supportive today. She taught me a lot too. Oh, and we even saw the Sword Princess and Nine Hell from Loki Familia on the way back."
Lyra said, "Kaguya-nee? Wow… for her to accept you so soon… You really must be someone Astraea-sama favors."
Lyra was genuinely surprised. Though Kaguya had a sharp tongue, she always cared deeply about her comrades.
Iska gave a sly grin amd said, "What's this~? So you saw those two princesses from Loki Familia? Akira, are you already eyeing other girls? You've got eleven beautiful girls and Astraea-sama around you, and you're still aiming higher?"
"Wha—That's not—!"
"Akira! Good evening!"
Alise suddenly emerged, hair still damp, her body steaming from a recent bath.
Beside her was Ryuu, her expression a mix of concern and quiet embarrassment.
She politely greeted, "Good evening."
"What happened with you two?" Akira asked.
Alise said with a tired smile, "There was a commotion on the street, so Ryuu and I stepped in."
"I just took a bath, but now I'm sweaty again…"
"How long are you going to stand there talking?" A familiar, dissatisfied voice cut through the chatter.
Kaguya appeared, dressed in a floral yukata, clearly fresh out of her bath.
Her smooth, glowing skin and damp black hair gave off an ethereal beauty, her yukata gently hugging her curves. She was the very image of a Yamato Nadeshiko.
(T/N: Yamato Nadeshiko basically means ideal Japanese woman.)
She scolded, "You lot can chat anytime. But this is the entrance to the girls' bath! Don't you idiots realize no one dares come out with you blocking the way?"
Only then did Akira realize just where he was standing.
From the cracked door behind him, several wary female faces peeked out—all members of the Astraea Familia.
Though strong and reliable in battle, most of them were still young, pure-hearted girls.
Their normal lives had been altered ever since Akira joined the familia. And now, being men and women living under the same roof, the girls had to be more cautious.
"Sorry! I didn't mean to interrupt! I was just heading to see Astraea-sama to update my status! Really sorry!" Akira quickly bowed and fled in embarrassment.
"Hmph." Kaguya exhaled through her nose as she watched him scamper off.
She said, "Also, since he's now one of us, don't be overly polite with him. Just tell him off directly if he's in the way. If you're too reserved, he'll overthink things."
Alise chimed in, "Hahaha, she's got a point! I want to go see Astraea-sama too. I want to check Akira's growth!"
Ryuu also said, "Me too."

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 9: Status Update
chapters.content:
"That's not quite what you said earlier, Kaguya."
"We've only known him for two days, and you're already speaking on his behalf."
Lyra's grin widened as she leaned in, her tone light but laced with playful accusation.
"Could it be… you've already developed a crush on him? Hah! No need to deny it."
"You might say no, but your actions have already given you away. Something must've happened between you two, right?"
She shot Kaguya a teasing, knowing smile.
Kaguya's eyes twitched, her lips parting and about to give a sharp retort but before the words could form, Lyra spun on her heel and followed Alise and Ryuu ahead with an impish chuckle.
Despite her teasing, Lyra wasn't someone who judged lightly. She trusted Astraea's judgment, of course—but Akira was a newcomer.
No matter how kind or capable he seemed, it was too early to gauge his true potential.
Still… something about him gnawed at her instincts. That strange gut feeling—like watching a dormant volcano and sensing the tremors before the eruption.
Orario had always been a city where the unbelievable happened. Heroes, myths, miracles… they often wore the skin of ordinary people.
The ritual of updating one's status was the most anticipated moment for any adventurer.
Sometimes, under the pressure of life-or-death encounters or pivotal decisions, an adventurer might awaken new skills or magic. But for most, it remained a distant dream.
The norm? Slow, steady increases in basic stats.
Only when an adventurer hit their bottleneck, where even the smallest gain was a battle, did they even dare to chase breakthroughs.
— — —
A gentle voice rang out, laced with warmth. "Come in! Akira, you're here to update your status, right? Sit down—let me see how much you've grown."
The room carried a faint floral scent, and at its center, the goddess of justice smiled softly.
Astraea's warmth was like sunlight breaking through storm clouds.
Akira nodded, took a deep breath, and sat on the chair, removing his shirt with a bit of hesitation. His back faced Astraea.
