Immortality
Awakening
Akira sat up from the bed, stretched his arms, and moved his fingers—but oddly, he didn't feel any immediate surge of strength.
Astraea giggled, covering her face with her hand and said, "Did you think your power would spike the moment you leveled up? You'll only notice the difference once you go adventuring again."
Akira scratched his cheek and chuckled. "Well, I was hoping for a little boost at least."
Despite all the level-ups she had performed for other children over the years, this one felt different. For the first time, Astraea found herself genuinely happy over a child's growth. She watched him with warmth in her eyes.
It had barely been a month since Akira joined the familia, but to her, it already felt like they had shared years together.
After Akira dressed and turned to face her, Astraea's expression shifted. It wasn't her usual gentle smile, nor her serene composure.
It was… intense. Emotional.
Akira, flustered, scratched his head and asked, "Uhm… Astraea-sama? Is something wrong with my Falna?"
Astraea smiled and shook her head. Silently, she beckoned him to come closer.
Akira stiffly walked up to her and looked into her eyes. At 1.8 meters, he had to tilt his head slightly to meet the gaze of Astraea, who stood at 1.67 meters.
With a gentle motion, Astraea cupped Akira's ears and tilted his head upward.
Then, with graceful poise, she leaned down and pressed her soft, warm lips against his forehead.
Her lips were like petals—plump, pink, and faintly glowing. Their touch was tender and reverent, like a blessing passed down from the heavens.
Moments later, she pulled away, placed one hand behind her back, and raised the other to her lips, making a "shhh" gesture.
"This is a reward just for you." She whispered with a girlish grin.
"Don't tell the others. It's… for justice!"Thɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Akira stared at her, awestruck. That expression on her face… the light in her eyes… It was something he had never seen before.
Then, without thinking, he reached up and gently grasped her right hand. Astraea blinked in surprise, but didn't pull away.
Akira leaned forward and touched his lips to her index finger—lightly, respectfully.
Looking up at her, he smiled. "It's my honor, Astraea-sama."
Their eyes met and they flashed a smile at each other.
After a moment, Astraea flicked his forehead with her finger and scolded him gently, "Don't do that to other girls."
Akira grinned. Her scolding tone was more loving than stern.
Feeling emboldened, he joked, "That kiss was too stingy, Astraea-sama. Just a forehead kiss? I'm a greedy child. I want more love next time."

chapters.title: Chapter 40 - 40: Should We Report to The Guild?
chapters.content:
Instead of getting angry, Astraea simply smiled, her expression softening as she pressed a slender finger gently against Akira's forehead.
"You really are something, aren't you?"
Akira laughed softly. She hadn't rejected his teasing—not outright, anyway. Maybe, just maybe, that meant she wasn't entirely opposed to the idea of showing him more affection next time.
Seizing the chance with a hopeful glint in his eyes, he asked playfully, "Then, Astraea-sama… will there be another reward when I reach the next level?"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
Hearing his question, Astraea's heart trembled—just a little.
Affection, fondness, and something more uncertain fluttered within her. She was growing attached.
But this warmth between them… was it becoming too close?
Even so, she didn't linger on the thought. Smiling gently, she reached out and pinched Akira's cheek.
"That depends entirely on your performance." She said teasingly.
Akira grinned boldly and said, "In that case, I want the place you just pinched as my next reward!" He pointed dramatically to his cheek.
Astraea laughed softly, unable to resist the charm of his youthful boldness.
"Very well. I promise. But don't tell a soul."
Placing a hand over his chest, Akira straightened up and gave a mock salute.
He exaggeratedly said, "Understood, my goddess!"
Outside Astraea's room.
"I didn't expect you to snatch such a peerless genius, Alise." Iska said, arms folded as she leaned casually against the wall.
Maryuu clasped her hands together in front of her chest, a warm smile appearing on her face.
She said, "Indeed. I always knew Akira was strong… but leveling up in less than a month? That's truly something else. It's… complicated."
"Right. And he took down a floor boss while still Level 1." Kaguya added, echoing what Astraea had revealed. "We're all Level 3, but I doubt even we could have done that."
"Hey hey—wait a minute…"
"Not only did he beat the Black Wyvern, he also defeated Goliath?" someone exclaimed in disbelief.
Ryuu added with a calm nod, "I heard Akira fell down while exploring the fifteenth floor."
Noin murmured as she paced restlessly through the corridor, "Akira really had a packed schedule today… Even though it was the one day I hoped would be peaceful."
Asta raised a hand and stopped Noin with a casual grip.
She calmly said with sharp eyes, "No wonder his stats increased so much. Akira's been working himself hard."
Neze tilted her head and said, "He's already reached Level 2. I wonder what alias he'll receive at the next Denatus?"
Ryana twirled a lock of her hair with a coy smile and said, "As long as it's not something ridiculous, it's fine by me."
Celty adjusted her glasses with a quiet push and spoke softly, "Astraea-sama won't let that happen. She'll make sure his alias is respectable."
Meanwhile, Alise stared at the closed door, her fingers twitching with anxiety. It had been twenty minutes, and still… silence.
Lyra sauntered over and patted Alise's butt and said, "Relax. What's got you so impatient? It's not like you haven't ranked up before."
Still tense, Alise stepped up and knocked on the door. "Astraea-sama, are you still not finished in there? We're about to burst from curiosity!"
From behind the door came Astraea's serene voice. "Come in, everyone."
And so, they did. Eleven members crammed into the room at once, filling the space with a chaotic flurry of movement and energy.
Akira, who had just sat down on the sofa, suddenly found himself surrounded on all sides.
Astraea handed Alise a parchment, the familiar paper bearing Akira's updated stats and development abilities.
Alise's eyes scanned it. The stats had reset to zero as expected but what caught her attention was a word written in the column for Development Abilities: [Mystery].
"Ah! This is a super rare development ability!" She exclaimed in surprise.
Immediately, three others shoved past her to get a better look at the parchment.
"It's [Mystery]—the one that allows the creation of magical tools." Lyra said.
Kaguya turned her head to Astraea, sharp as always. "Astraea's, what about his options?"
Astraea smiled and said, "Mage, Hunter, Mystery… and possibly some unique ones that seem to be exclusive to Akira."
"It's true." Ryuu murmured. "Given his unusual traits, it wouldn't be surprising if he gained his own original development ability."
Ryuya looked to Astraea and asked, "Astraea-sama, do you know what his unique development ability does?"
Astraea responded thoughtfully, "It appears that Akira can access additional powers depending on the state he's in."
Kaguya frowned. She knew Astraea wouldn't pressure anyone, but still…
She reached over, tugging on Akira's ear gently, and sat beside him.
She said, "Even if [Mystery] is rare, you should choose the development ability that suits your path best."
"Are you planning to become a toolmaker instead of an adventurer?"
Her grip was gentle. Not painful. Classic Kaguya—always tsundere. Akira glanced at her face and saw her concern.
He said, "I'm still planning to be an adventurer, Kaguya-nee. Don't worry. Just hear me out."
As she released his ear, Maryuu moved in and began to massage both of Akira's ears and ruffle his hair affectionately.
She kindly said, "Yes, let's listen to what little Akira has to say."
"Well then, tell us."
Feeling pampered, Akira relaxed and spoke his thoughts plainly, "It's simple. I just want to use [Mystery] to create magic tools—items that can help all of you escape danger during emergencies."
The group behind the sofa exchanged glances.
Lyra clutched her chest, feigning a dramatic swoon. "W-wow… I didn't expect that. So sweet. I am this close to falling in love with you."
She promptly squeezed into Akira's other side and began rubbing her cheek against his.
"Ah! That's not fair! I want one too!" Neze cried, promptly yanking Akira up from the couch.
Without Akira's support, Kaguya and Lyra's heads collided with a loud thump.
"Ow!" ×2
"Oops. Sorry."
Neze apologized, then shamelessly began hugging Akira and rubbing her face against him with gusto.
"My turn, Neze!"
Iska declared, snatching Akira away like a prized dessert and rubbing against him with terrifying efficiency.
Just like that, Akira found himself at the mercy of his overenthusiastic familia, passed around like a beloved plush toy. Even Asta joined in, lifting Akira up and spinning him joyfully like a trophy.
Only two elves lingered near the back—hesitant, struggling with temptation but too reserved to act.
Akira glanced toward Astraea with a look that clearly screamed for rescue.
Seeing his plea for help, Astraea sighed and clapped her hands.
"Okay, okay. That's enough. Let's get back on topic. Do you think Akira should go to the guild to register his level-up?"
After all, reporting a child's advancement and letting the gods catch wind of it was the kind of drama no god could resist.
Lyra narrowed her eyes with a sly grin and said, "Akira, you know there's a loophole. Even if you don't register your level-up, the worst you'll face is a fine."
Sliding out of Ryuu's blushing embrace, Akira stood behind the couch where the others now lounged.
After a brief pause, he raised a question, "If I register for a rank up… can I change the date of the level-up?"
Everyone turned toward him, blinking in unison, confused by what he was trying to get at.

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - 41: A Confession to Everyone?!
chapters.content:
Kaguya twirled a lock of her hair around her finger and said thoughtfully, "So, what you're really saying is that you plan to stretch the time it took you to rank up to Level 2—from one month to something like over a year?"
Akira snapped his fingers, grinning. "Smart! That's exactly it. At worst, I can just say I transferred from another familia—that's why I was able to level up so quickly."
However, before he could delve deeper into his thought, Alise and Kaguya both cut him off in unison.
Alise frowned, visibly anxious. "Rejected! Your first Familia is the Astraea Familia—we're members of justice. No underhanded tricks allowed."
"That's right."
Kaguya added with a steely glint in her eyes, "I refuse to be connected to any rumors about stealing members from other Familias."
Akira, now being stared down by the two women, raised his hands in surrender with an awkward laugh. "I'm just kidding, alright? It was just an example."
"Is that something you should be joking about?! You idiot! Right, Astraea-sama?" Alise huffed.
Astraea, wearing a stern expression that was clearly forced, joined in with exaggerated seriousness. "Indeed, indeed! Akira is such an idiot!"
She continued, her voice turning proud, "But as his goddess, I personally blessed this child—and now he's reached Level 2 so quickly. I'm going to flaunt this to the other gods! Let them be envious of how amazing my child is."
Then she looked at him slyly and suddenly brought up the topic of his reward, "You actually had the nerve to want me to become your second god. Hmph! I won't give you your reward next time."
At the word "reward," the atmosphere changed. Everyone in the Familia perked up, their gazes turning curious.
Alise bounced up to Astraea like an excited puppy and asked loudly, "Reward? What reward?! Astraea-sama, I want a reward too!"
Astraea chuckled, gently stroking Alise's hair, then looked at Akira with an expression filled with meaning and said, "Otherwise, I won't give you your reward of having your head patted next time."
When everyone heard that the "reward" was merely a head pat, they all deflated. Sure, Astraea's touch was pleasant, but it was something anyone could get just by asking. Interest faded fast.
Akira understood immediately—it was a threat, masked as affection.
Sighing, he raised both hands in defeat. "Alright, alright. I get it. I'll agree to register. But... can we change the recorded time to three months instead?"
"Why does Akira have to hide the time?" Ryuu asked softly, her gaze sincere.
Akira's expression turned serious and he said, "Because we're already pretty famous. Now that I've leveled up too, the mischievous gods will surely make a huge fuss. It'll cause a lot of trouble for all of you."
"And Evilus will definitely zero in on you now." Kaguya added, her voice tinged with concern.
"It's dangerous."
"It's always like this with you. You really are a troublesome kid." Lyra said, shaking her head helplessly.
"We've only known each other for less than a month, yet you already treat us like we're more important than your own safety. That's not okay, you know?"
Then, with a smirk, Lyra threw out her usual teasing line, "You don't actually think of us as your harem or something, right?"
Akira didn't dodge the question. With an earnest tone and unwavering gaze, he replied seriously, "If I could live together with all of you for the rest of my life, I'd be happy."
"That's why... I don't want to lose even one of you."
The room fell into stunned silence.
Blushes bloomed across faces.
This kid... he actually just dropped a full-blown confession!
The atmosphere thickened, the air heavy with unspoken emotions and ambiguity.
...
After what felt like an eternity, Celty was the first to crack. Her face was now a blazing shade of red. She let out a strangled "Waaah!" and fled from the room.
With one person gone, the rest quickly followed suit, escaping the heated atmosphere. Soon, only Iska and Maryuu remained at the door.
Leaning against the doorframe, Iska blew a playful kiss to Akira and said, "Catch that for later."
Meanwhile, Maryuu clasped her hands gently and smiled with a soft glow in her eyes. "My wish is the same as Akira's. I just want to live with everyone, peacefully."
With that, she gave a gentle nod and turned away. "That's all. The rest is up to you guys. I'm off to join the girls' meeting!"
She flashed a "yeah" sign with her fingers beside her eye before vanishing.
Now, only Astraea, Akira, and the remaining four girls were left.
All eyes were on Akira. Every face wore a different expression—curiosity, annoyance, affection, embarrassment.
"What's wrong? Cat got your tongues?" Lyra nudged Akira's arm with her elbow, cheeks still tinged pink.
"You just confessed to everyone, you know."
Akira smiled calmly and responded, "No, I didn't confess. I just said I want us all to live together for the rest of our lives."
"I never said I liked you all, or wanted to marry you."
Lyra clicked her tongue with a teasing grin and said, "Doesn't matter. I'm planning to marry Finn anyway. I don't want to spend the rest of my life with you lot."
"Really? If you find happiness, then of course we'll bless you." Akira replied without a hint of hesitation.
"But without you around to bicker with, I'll be lonely." He said the embarrassing words so naturally, it left everyone stunned again.
Akira wasn't fooled. He knew Lyra was only saying that out of habit. If it really came down to choosing between the Familia and Finn, Lyra would definitely pick her Familia.
She was that kind of person—someone who would sacrifice herself without hesitation to protect the others.
Lyra spread her arms, letting out a dramatic sigh. "Sorry, girls. I don't think I can win an argument with this guy. Since when did he become so shameless?"
She waved them in. "You lot deal with him. I can't handle this by myself."
Alise threw up her hands and said, "Even you, Lyra? If a cunning rat like you can't win, then we really don't stand a chance."
"Yeah."The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
Kaguya added, "And now that he's Level 2... We might not even be able to fight him off. He could take us prisoner anytime."
She theatrically covered half her face with her sleeve, pretending to sob in despair.
Hearing her words, Akira's expression shifted. He sat down on the sofa, straightened his posture like a king holding court, and curled a finger toward Astraea.
Astraea chuckled, clearly enjoying the moment, and sat next to him. Akira pulled her gently by the waist, hugging her like a spoiled lover.
"And you too, Ryuu. Come over here." He patted the sofa beside him, motioning with a smirk.
"Eh...?" Ryuu blinked, confused, but still obediently walked over and sat down.
Before she could even react, Akira slipped his arm around hers. Ryuu's face turned stiff with confusion.
With that, Akira lifted his chin, a smug grin spreading across his face as he addressed the trio still standing.
"Hmph. Look at this. Now even Astraea-sama and Gale Ryuu are on my side. And you think you can still go against me? What a joke!"
"You dare call yourselves prisoners, yet you haven't even admitted your mistakes or sworn loyalty. Hmph! Maybe, if you submit, I'll even assign you a position."

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - 42: Alise in a Mess
chapters.content:
Lyra turned to the two of them and complained, "It turns out that we spoil him too much usually. He can even do such a thing."
Akira said, "How dare you you slander me so casually? I will punish you by unleashing a curse upon you that you never get to marry Finn for the rest of your life! You will become a lonely old woman."
Several people chuckled.
"What a vicious punishment! For Finn's sake, Lyra, use the secret bomb on him!" Kaguya smiled and patted Lyra's shoulder.
Lyra rolled up her sleeves with a smile and walked towards Akira.
Akira pulled Ryuu's arm and said to Lyra in a terrified manner, "Protect the emperor, protect the emperor. General Ryuu, why don't you step forward to fight against the cunning rat Lyra?"
"Oh?" Ryuu stood in front of Lyra, confused.
"I never thought that a righteous man like you would submit to that evil king?" Lyra went along with the play.
"Ah, what king? Are you referring to Akira?" Ryuu and Lyra wrestled with their fingers intertwined, while Ryuu expressed her confusion.
"As expected, have you also been bewitched by Akira's beauty?" Seeing that she couldn't break free from Ryuu's fingers, Lyra could only speak out Ryuu's current weakness.
Ryuu immediately let go of Lyra, waving her hands in front of her face, and said anxiously, "Hey, no! Lyra, what are you talking about?"
"A flaw."
Lyra quickly bypassed Ryuu and reached out to grab Akira, but missed.
Akira teleported and suddenly appeared in front of Alise and Kaguya.
He made a face at Lyra and said, "Hahaha, you didn't expect that, did you?"
"Damn it!" Lyra said unwillingly.
Kaguya gently stretched out her hands from behind Akira, twisted his neck, and made a "click" sound.
Akira lay softly in Kaguya's arms and closed his eyes.
"Just like that, the Blood Hell Lord Akira was defeated by the brave and fearless spirit of the heroes. This is a cause for celebration." After saying this, Akira continued to sing the ending song.
Astraea, who was sitting on the sofa, covered her mouth and laughed sweetly.
Kaguya lowered her head and whispered to Akira in her arms, "You are really getting more and more wanton. You even dare to touch Astraea-sama."
After the farce ended, Astraea asked the five people to sit back on the sofa.
"Then let's hand in Akira's level up report to the guild tomorrow. Alise, can I give it to you?"
"No problem, just leave it to me, the perfect captain!" Alise patted her chest and promised.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"Alise, remember to change my level up time to three months. This will at least reduce some trouble. At the same time, I only fought the black Wyvern." Akira stated his request.
"I see. Even though it's shocking that it took three months to level up, it's much more easy to handle than one month." Alise leaned on Akira's lap and said.
Lyra said with a look of disappointment, "Akira is really timid. If it were me, I would brag about this kind of thing every day like Alise."
With Lyra's intelligence, she actually understood Akira's worries, but she also hoped that he would become everyone's pride.
Akira understood that everyone wanted him to accept the honor openly, but it was not yet time for that. His strength was not yet at the point where he could handle everything, so he needed to make some preparations.
Now is still an age of chaos. If it were seven years later, it wouldn't matter how fast he leveled up, but it's not possible now because Evilus is still eyeing the Astraea and other familias.
Therefore, Akira had no choice but to stroke Alise's hair and said, "When I rank up to LV 3, you can do whatever you want. Just listen to me now."
"It turns out that our familia is too weak. If I had the strength of Finn or Ottar, Akira would not have to do this." Alise was in a low mood for once.
Kaguya and Ryuu looked at each other and decided to train harder.
Astraea and Lyra looked at Akira, signaling with their eyes that he should comfort Alise.
Akira showed a helpless expression, but...
Since they had asked him to comfort her, he won't be responsible if anything happens.
"Captain."
Alise turned around and looked at Akira with her dashing and heroic face. Her face, which was usually full of energy, now looked a little depressed and made her look more charming.
Is this the contrast of cuteness?
"What's wrong, Akira? Any other requests?" Alise's slightly low voice reached Akira's ears.
'Alise, you really don't suit this posture, so let me restore you to your original state.' Akira thought as he looked at Alise.
Akira gently brushed back Alise's bangs, revealing her smooth forehead.
In Alise's slightly widened eyes, Akira's face was reflected, and the distance between them was getting closer and closer.
She felt a gentle and delicate touch on her forehead. Although she had been kissed on the forehead lovingly by her relatives when she was a child, she had never felt such a heart-pounding feeling.
When Alise realized that she was kissed on the forehead, she felt as if her magic had been activated and her whole body became hot.
"Wow wow wow—"
Alise let out a cry of surprise, climbed up from Akira's lap, and quickly ran across the table to a corner to calm down.
Without looking in the mirror, Alise knew that her face must be blushing with shame.
Seeing this, not only the three girls, but even Astraea was frightened by Akira's actions.
"Haa... Haa... Haa..."
After taking a few deep breaths, Alise finally calmed down a little. She turned around and looked a little more normal, but her face was still slightly red.
"This meeting is now over, and I, the captain, declare the group disbanded!"
With a trembling voice, Alise rushed to the door immediately after she finished speaking.
Kaguya punched Akira on the head and left in silence, while Ryuu followed closely with a red face.
Lyra patted Akira's head and comforted him, "It's okay, Kaguya won't be angry with you, she's probably just jealous. Make it up to her next time."
Then, she waved to Akira and Astraea and left the room.
Watching the three of them leave, Akira asked Astraea, "Astraea-sama, am I really too greedy? Is it bad that I don't want to give up anyone?"
Astraea hugged Akira and comforted him, "Who can know about this kind of thing?"
"But, tonight, Akira plans to sleep with me for the first time in a long time?"
"Um."

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 43: Is This Feeling Friendship Or Something More?
chapters.content:
Alise lay sprawled on her bed, her crimson hair spread across the sheets like fire. Her fingers lightly brushed the spot on her forehead where Akira had kissed her just moments ago.
A soft giggle escaped her lips, one that danced between bashfulness and joy. She rolled over onto her side, buried her face into her pillow for a moment, then touched her flushed cheeks with both hands.
"Ahhh… What am I even doing?" She muttered under her breath, kicking her feet slightly.
Suddenly, a knock interrupted her flustered daze.
"Alise, we're coming in!" came a familiar voice from beyond the door.
Startled, she jumped up as if struck by lightning and darted toward the door. With a hand still pressed to her warm cheek, she cracked the door open ever so slightly, peeking through like a guilty child.
When she confirmed that Akira wasn't among them, she exhaled in relief and allowed the three girls to enter.
Lyra stepped inside with a smirk that said more than words ever could.
She teased, "Oh my, oh my~ Who would've thought that our shining, righteous Alise—perfect in mind, body, and heart—would be flustered like a maiden in spring?"
Alise's eyes widened. "L-Lyra, don't tease me!"
Ryuu, ever the voice of reason, smiled faintly. "It's normal, isn't it? Alise is a girl too. If someone suddenly kisses her, even she would feel shy."
Her words immediately drew suspicious glances from the other two, who turned toward her like wolves catching the scent of prey.
"Well now." Lyra purred, narrowing her eyes,
"Ryuu, that's awfully specific. Don't tell me… were you also attacked by Akira?"
As if struck by lightning, Ryuu raised her hands and gestured frantically in the air.
She hurriedly said, "N-No! That's not what happened! It's just... Kaguya asked me to greet Akira at the door once, that's all!"
"And?" Lyra leaned closer, her expression full of intrigue.
"When I… When I wished Akira would call me by my name, he suddenly did. Then he grabbed my hand." Ryuu confessed, her voice shrinking to a whisper as her ears turned red.
Lyra snorted, arms crossed. "Tch. That's it? No dramatic kiss, no lingering embrace, no forbidden fruit nibbled in the shadows?"
Feeling the mockery in Lyra's tone, Ryuu puffed out her cheeks and snapped back, "What? Holding hands is embarrassing too!"
Lyra clicked her tongue and said, "Only a pure-hearted germaphobic elf like you would turn red from something so tame."
"And you!" Ryuu jabbed a finger at her.
"You say you're experienced, but you don't even have a boyfriend! Even your pursuit of Finn failed miserably!"
A gasp echoed as the verbal sparring escalated. The graceful elf had taken off her gloves.
"What did you say?!" Lyra's eyes blazed.
"You little punk! You can't even talk to a man without stammering. Akira probably thinks of you like a scared cat!"
As their bickering intensified, Kaguya rolled her eyes and let out a long, tired sigh.
She turned to Alise, who was still standing awkwardly near the bed, and asked calmly, "Enough about them. Alise… do you like Akira?"
That one simple question instantly silenced the room. Ryuu and Lyra froze mid-argument, their faces shifting to curiosity as they waited for her response.
Alise blinked, startled at the sudden question, then let out a soft breath. The warmth returned to her cheeks, but this time it wasn't embarrassment—it was gentleness.
She sat down on the edge of her bed, a thoughtful expression appearing on her face.
"...I do care about him deeply." She said at last, her voice calm but tinged with hesitation.
"I like Akira a lot. But I don't think it's... love. Not yet, anyway."
She looked down at her hands and continued, "It's more than friendship, but not quite that step beyond."
The others listened silently, their expressions softening.
"Besides."
She added with a wry smile, "I don't think Akira loves me. That kiss earlier… I think it was meant to comfort me, not because he's in love."
Her words hung in the air, giving off a bittersweet feeling.
"He gives off the feeling of someone desperately clinging to something precious."
She said, clutching her chest gently, "Like a child afraid to lose the only warmth they've ever known. Maybe… he's carrying something we can't see."
Ryuu nodded slowly and said, "Akira… does express his emotions freely. Most elves are reserved, but he's different. He acts without hesitation."
Alise continued, "He's also always worried about us. Almost like he sees something we don't. Maybe... it's intuition, or something more."
"Or he's just that big of a worrywart." Lyra muttered, scratching her head.
"Still… he's only been with us for a short time, and yet he's giving up so much. Why?"
She clenched her fist, torn by the idea that someone would prioritize them over themselves.
Kaguya said nothing for a long moment. Her eyes dimmed, recalling the first time she had taken Akira into the dungeon.
He'd worn a smile then—bright, almost carefree—but his eyes were so terribly sad. Like a lost soul pretending to have found a home.
"He reminds me of myself." Kaguya murmured.
"Someone who had no place in the world and came to Orario, hoping to find one."
She paused, her voice lowering. "Maybe that's why he holds us so dear. Because we're his light."
After that, the room grew quiet again.
Kaguya glanced up at the others, noting the way their cheeks glowed faintly, their eyes lost in reflection. None of them would admit it, but they were all close to crossing that line between friendship and that kind of affection.
A knowing smile tugged at her lips.
"You really are a sinful man, Akira." She whispered, more to herself than to anyone else. "Even I've fallen for you."
— — —
At noon, the sun hung lazily over Orario, casting a golden warmth over the towering Guild building.
Most adventurers had already disappeared into the depths of the dungeon, but the guild hall remained alive with activity. It wasn't just a place for paperwork or briefings—it was the central hub of the city's beating heart.
Thanks to monopolizing the city's magic stone trade and urban management, the Guild had long since grown into a power greater than most nations.
Its grand halls were gilded and vast, filled with soft sofas, polished wood counters, and wide screens that constantly updated with information from across the dungeon floors.
Free amenities, up-to-date intelligence, and a gathering of like-minded souls made it a hotspot—not only for adventurers but for gossipers, dreamers, and braggarts alike.
Boasts echoed from table to table.
"Fighting dragons? Bah! Let me tell you about the time I single-handedly tamed a floor boss!"
But in truth, these adventurers knew: living was more than just swinging a blade. Surviving the dungeon wasn't just about combat prowess—it was about navigating the undercurrents of fate, luck, and friendship.
After all, one wrong move, one wrong companion, and your bones might decorate the lowest floors of the dungeon forever.
So, in this place of casual laughter and unspoken fears...
They kept their spirits up.
And told each other again and again—
"We are the best."

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 44: An Uproar
chapters.content:
Just as everyone was chatting, bragging, and killing time with idle tales of dungeon heroics, a sudden hush spread through the guild hall like a wave.
The cheerful buzz dimmed into silence, subtle but immediate. Heads turned, eyes widened, and conversations halted as attention converged on a single figure entering the hall.
She wasn't clad in any dazzling armor, nor was she surrounded by fanfare. Yet her presence demanded attention.
A simple breastplate covered her upper body, worn over a black undershirt. Her toned legs were wrapped in tight, functional hot pants designed for speed and agility.
A short crimson cape hung from her waist, fluttering slightly with each step. The confidence in her gait, paired with her focused, almost fierce gaze, painted a picture of calm authority.
Her fiery red ponytail swayed behind her like a burning banner. It was a signature as recognizable as her name.
Though her youthful face might not rival the goddesses worshipped across Orario, it carried a spirited charm that had captivated many adventurers.
But it wasn't just beauty that drew their stares.
She was the captain of the Astraea Familia. A second-class adventurer. A wielder of potent fire magic.
Scarlet Harnel Alise Lovell.
"Why's she at the guild all of a sudden?"
"No clue. Think it's about a new familia moving in?"
"Could be some secret mission or a rogue faction issue again…"
Whispers swirled but Alise paid them no mind. She strolled calmly to the front counter of the guild, where the staff member stationed there perked up upon recognizing her.
A few curious adventurers subtly followed at a distance, hoping to eavesdrop or catch a glimpse of some classified information.
Normally, for private matters, one would request a meeting in a separate room, but Alise handed over a form and spoke calmly.
A level-up report.
Instantly, the whispers intensified again.
"Level up? Who?"
"Wait—don't tell me it's Gale?"
"No way. Didn't she just rank up last year?"
"Yeah, and the Astraea familia is full of top-tier beauties. Honestly, joining them is harder than joining either of the two strongest familias in Orario."
"No, no—wasn't there a new recruit recently? That guy... what was his name again?"
"Oh, come on. He's only been there for, what, a month? There's no way—"
Then, an audible gasp broke the room's tension.
The werewolf staff, Rose, stared at the document in her hands with disbelief. Her tail stiffened and ears perked, betraying her shock.
"W-what…?"
All eyes locked on her. Rose quickly straightened her posture and gave an apologetic bow to Alise before regaining composure.
She asked in a serious tone, "Captain Alise, is the information in this report accurate?"
Alise scratched her cheek sheepishly amd said, "Honestly, I was surprised too. But yeah, it's real. The guild can investigate if needed."
Rose stared at the report again, then gave a hesitant nod. "Understood. I'll have this processed right away."
Alise had completed her duty. With the report submitted, she turned to leave. But before she could get far, an adventurer—someone she knew well—approached her with a grin.
"Hey, come on, give me a hint. Who leveled up? You can tell me, right?"
Alise chuckled and said, "You've probably heard of him already. He's the newest member."
The adventurer blinked. "You mean… that guy? Already?! Isn't that a little too fast?"
"I know, right?" Alise smiled proudly.
"If I hadn't watched him grow with my own eyes, I wouldn't have believed it either."
She waved and headed for the door and said, "Anyway, you'll see soon enough. The guild will make the announcement. See ya."
Despite her casual tone, the joy in Alise's expression couldn't be hidden. Her radiant smile lingered in the minds of those watching.
Rumors exploded. Curiosity reached a fever pitch. Even the guild staff, typically calm and collected, were whispering among themselves.
About ten minutes later, the heavy doors opened again. This time, the captain of the Ganesha Familia—Shakti Varma, known as the Ankusha—stepped into the hall.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
She was a first-class adventurer with a commanding presence, and someone who had previously met the newcomer in question.
Without delay, she was escorted to a private room. A brief discussion ensued before she emerged with a group of her members.
An opportunistic adventurer boldly stepped forward and asked, "Captain Shakti, is there some emergency mission?"
Shakti replied curtly, "Just gathering some intel. Don't overthink it—and stop crowding the place." With that, she left.
The room was now so packed that new arrivals couldn't even get past the entrance. Everyone was waiting.
And finally, several hours later, the guild's poster girl returned—Werewolf Rose, holding a parchment and a thick clipboard.
She approached the largest announcement board and pinned the report in place. Then she vanished into the back as if to avoid being trampled.
In a flash, a flood of adventurers surged forward, elbowing their way to the front.
Gasps, stammers, and stunned silence followed.
[Adventurer: Akira]
[Level: LV1 → LV2]
[Time: 3 months]
[Great Feat: Defeated the enhanced monster "Black Wyvern" on the 12th floor]
[Guild Verification: Confirmed – Passed]
There was even a record parchment displaying his newly reset stats, stamped with the Astraea Familia's insignia.
"Three months…? That's impossible!"
"No way… He fought an enhanced monster?!"
"Yesterday, wasn't it? He must've triggered the conditions just then!"
"Unreal. Even Ais took longer than that..."
Far away, in a certain office in the Twilight Manor of the Loki Familia—
BANG!
A desk trembled under Loki's palm.
"Finn! What's with this guy?! He leveled up faster than my precious Ais!"
Finn calmly picked up the papers that Loki had scattered with her outburst. "Calm down, Loki. I'm just as surprised. But the report's real."
"Wait—don't tell me… you know him?!"
Riveria stepped forward and folded her arms. "Actually, all four of us do."
She glanced at Ais, Gareth, and Finn.
"Hey hey hey, what the heck! You mean it's that divine power incident guy?! The one from back then?" Loki pointed at the report, eyes narrowing.
"So why didn't any of you tell me?! You traitors! You're not treating me like your goddess anymore!"

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 45: Creating Magic Tools
chapters.content:
Riveria raised her hand and brought it down in a clean chop on Loki's head, her expression dark with frustration.
"You were completely drunk and passed out until now. That's why you didn't hear a thing. And that evil god the boy encountered… it's likely the same one Ais faced back then."
Loki scratched the back of her head with an awkward laugh. "Aha… so that's what happened. My bad."
She plopped down onto the sofa, resting her cheek on one hand.
Her tone turned serious as her narrowed eyes scanned the room, "So, what kind of kid is he, exactly? Do you have any idea what his real information is like? Finn, this level-up report seems fishy, doesn't it?"
Finn nodded, pulling out a few documents from his coat—records of Akira's solo expeditions and a number of whispered rumors gathered from the lower floors.
"These are the earliest confirmed sightings of Akira's activities. It's clear he didn't begin his adventuring career in Orario just three months ago."
He tapped one record and said, "Here's when he was reportedly seen fighting a Silverback on the 11th floor."
Then he pointed to another and continued, "And this is the date he leveled up—after defeating the enhanced monster yesterday."
Finn's fingers drummed against the table in thought as he summed up the evidence, "If we assume Akira wasn't an adventurer before arriving in Orario, then the actual time he took to level up… is probably less than a month."
Loki whistled, eyebrows raised. "Less than a month? Seriously?"
"To take down a monster affected by divine power—or at the very least, a monster of equivalent threat—his stats would have to be on par with Ais back when she was still Level 1."
Her red eyes gleamed with curiosity. "Does he have magic, Finn?"
Finn nodded and said, "Witnesses from the divine anomaly mentioned someone cloaked in a powerful wind. Given that, it's likely wind-element magic—just like Ais's."
Loki groaned and leaned back with an exaggerated sigh. "What is he? A bootleg Ais?"
Finn was silent for a moment before muttering with grave certainty, "…He's not just some imitation. Loki, I get the feeling Akira isn't as simple as he looks. When I first met him… my thumb twitched. That instinct of mine—it told me this guy is dangerous."
Loki's usual playful demeanor slipped away as she stared wide-eyed at her trusted advisor.
"You serious? You're saying this kid might be stronger than Ais was back then? He's got magic, his stats might surpass hers… and even you're getting warning bells?"
She rubbed her temples and groaned again, "And now you're telling me Astraea picked him up just like that?! Just how lucky are they?! Finn, if we ever end up in a War Game against them, what are our odds?!"
She didn't even get the chance to finish her complaint—Riveria's tightly clenched fist came down hard on Loki's skull.
BAM!
"You idiot goddess! Stop dragging us into your trouble!" Her voice erupted like a thunderclap.
Even Ais, who had been standing silently to the side, flinched at the sudden outburst and instinctively hid behind Gareth.
Riveria's stern expression intensified as she said, "Don't you realize how unstable things are in Orario right now?! It's only thanks to the tireless work of the Astraea Familia and the Ganesha Familia that things are barely holding together! And now you want to stir the pot again?!"
Her rapid-fire reprimands flew at Loki like arrows, pinning her into the sofa with every word.
Finn leaned in and whispered with a small smile, "By the way… Akira's a half-elf. That might explain why Riveria's particularly fond of him."
Loki immediately raised both hands in surrender, curling up defensively.
"I get it, I get it! I was wrong, okay?! I won't say another word, Mother Riveria!"
Meanwhile, far across the city, another faction stirred quietly.
In the domain of one of the two ruling familias—Freya Familia—nothing was being said, nothing was being done.
Because Ottar, the Familia's captain, remembered Freya's words.
Don't bother with Akira.
And so, despite the ripples the boy was causing across Orario, the Freya Familia remained silent.
— — —
Of course, none of this was known to Akira.
After assisting Shakti in completing her investigation, he had returned to Astraea's embrace that morning.
After a peaceful rest, he decided to dedicate his day to a new pursuit—crafting magic tools.
He began by pulling a few texts on enchantment and mystic item theory from the Astraea Familia's library, burying himself in their pages.
Then, with several books in hand, he visited a local jewelry store to purchase a collection of basic accessories.
Upon returning to his room, he laid out his tools and materials. Using knowledge obtained from [Dimension Walker], he replaced certain outdated techniques with his own insights.
Since every member of the familia would need to fight at some point, Akira resolved to make the magic tools compact and practical—easy to wear and easy to use.
After thoroughly studying the process, he finally sat down to begin.
First, he switched his class to [Dimension Walker].
The shift was immediate. His senses warped, his perception expanding in strange, unsettling ways—like something invisible had started slithering just beyond his sight.
"Tch… what a pain of a job." Akira muttered.
He quickly equipped a dimensional distortion stabilizer, and the discomfort dulled.
He didn't have time to waste.
Taking out a thumbnail-sized magic stone, Akira channeled the dimension's power, etching a teleportation formula into the crystal's surface. His palm emitted a mysterious light, covering the stone as he imbued it with the spell.The source of this content ɪs
A radiant flash lit up the entire room. The brilliance was so intense that Akira had to raise his hand to shield his eyes.
When the light faded, the stone was now shimmered with runes that pulsed faintly within its core.
He mounted the finished stone onto a necklace, then activated the binding light once more. Intricate markings appeared along the band, locking the magic stone into place.
To complete the teleportation mechanism, Akira needed an anchor. He crafted a second stone to act as the origin point and carefully placed it in the center of his room.
After securing the anchor, he stepped outside, distancing himself.
Standing in the hallway, Akira activated the necklace. Magic power surged into it.
A brilliant circle formed beneath his feet, its light expanding until it engulfed his body.
Then—
WHOOSH.
He vanished.
Bang.
He reappeared next to the origin stone, stumbling slightly as he caught himself on the wall. A wave of dizziness swept over him.
He pressed two fingers to his temple, groaning softly, "Ugh… teleportation side effects…"
He looked down at the necklace, only to find the once-glowing stone now dull and lifeless—its magical energy completely spent.
"A single-use artifact, huh…" Akira sighed, but there was no disappointment in his voice.
This was just the first step. He didn't expect perfection. Not yet.
What mattered now was improving the design—refining it until he could hand it off to Alise and the others. Until it could protect them in battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 46: Let's Have Barbecue Tonight
chapters.content:
"Whoa, it's teeming with adventurers and gods outside today! What should we do, Astraea-sama?"
Alise exclaimed as she stood at the window, her eyes scanning the bustling scene beyond the front door.
Clusters of figures moved to and fro in front of their home. Among them, Alise even recognized a few familiar faces.
Watching them, Astraea let out a helpless sigh and said, "It seems Akira's talent really is something that draws attention, whether we want it to or not."
"Not to mention, his rapid level-up within three months couldn't possibly go unnoticed by the gods. I'm sure many of them have already figured out his actual level up time."
Astraea gave Alise a gentle pat on the shoulder and added, "Go on, try to convince them to disperse. We don't need a crowd forming at the gates of the Astraea Familia. Unless you're planning to start a war game?"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Still holding onto Astraea's sleeve, Alise looked up and asked, "But why did you agree to Akira's request to alter the official level up date, Astraea-sama? Isn't that kind of... unnecessary?"
"I couldn't refuse him." Astraea said with a soft chuckle.
"Lately, he's been hard to turn down."
"Ahhh! Astraea-sama, you're so mean! You spoil Akira way too much! I'm jealous. I've decided—I'm sleeping with you tonight!" Alise clung to her arm and pouted playfully, her voice dripping with mock indignation.
"Haha, says the girl who pampers Akira just as much." Astraea smiled wryly.
Just then, she stepped forward, facing the gathering outside with a serene expression.
"Everyone."
"Please don't gather in front of our home like this. It causes trouble for my children. Would you kindly disperse?"
Her voice carried the divine calm unique to one who upheld justice. Hearing her speak, and realizing that a goddess herself had come out to address them, most of the onlookers exchanged sheepish glances and began retreating, murmuring apologies.
Still, a few voices rose in protest.
"Astraea, can't we at least get a peek at the super rookie?"
"Yeah, yeah, just a glimpse and we'll be gone!"
With a slightly regretful smile, Astraea responded, "Akira entered the dungeon yesterday to adjust to his newfound strength. He's not home at the moment. I'm afraid there's nothing for you to see here."
She added meaningfully, "But he's a member of Astraea Familia. You'll see him in action soon enough."
The crowd, sensing her subtle hint, finally relented and trickled away. Only a few familiar gods remained behind—Loki, Hermes, and Ganesha.
"Well, aren't you going to invite us in for a chat?" Loki asked casually, already striding up to the door with Ais in tow, without even waiting for an answer.
Astraea let out a sigh and helplessly said, "Come in, everyone."
After greeting them, Alise took their respective familia members—Asfi and Adi—over to Ryuu's room, giving the gods space to speak freely.
In the main hall, the four gods settled into their seats, their attention turning to a single topic: Akira.
"I am Ganesha!" Ganesha suddenly declared.
"You're too loud!" Loki snapped. "You scared my Ais."
She swatted at his bulky arm, only to recoil and clutch her hand. "Damn it, that hurt!"
Astraea, calm and composed, lifted a teacup and took a slow sip.
She asked, "So, what exactly do you want to ask? Let me say this first—I won't reveal anything specific about Akira."
"Oi—then why are we even here? Isn't that exactly what we came for?" Loki slammed the table, clearly displeased.
The teacup on the table trembled from the impact.
Hermes said with a frown, "Loki, can you not shake the entire table? It's ruining my tea experience."
Crossing her arms with a huff, Loki dropped into the sofa, green with envy.
"Tch. She's too lucky. First a familia full of pretty girls, now a freak who leveled up in a single month. I was this close to launching a war game to steal them."
Astraea raised an eyebrow but remained serene. "I'll take that as a compliment for my child, Loki."
Hermes chimed in, folding his hands together in mock prayer. "Astraea, are you sure we can't meet the newest member? He's probably still inside the base, right?"
"I do want to show him off." Astraea admitted with a wry smile.
"But he's been holed up in his room working on something since yesterday."
She offered a sincere, apologetic bow. "It'd be rude to interrupt him."
Just as Loki was about to make another remark, the door to the hall creaked open. A half-elf burst in without knocking.
Akira strode in confidently, holding a black-framed necklace above his head like a trophy.
"Astraea-sama! Everyone! I did it! I really am a genius!!"
He didn't even glance at the room's occupants. Instead, he turned around dramatically, arched his back, and shouted toward the hallway.
"Let's have a barbecue tonight!!"
Then Akira turned back around—only to be met by the dumbfounded gazes of four gods.
The room plunged into silence.
Astraea rubbed her forehead in exasperation. The other three gods simply stared.
Bang!
Akira dropped to the floor with a thud, face flushed red. Silently, he picked up a cloth bag stuffed with necklaces and slapped it over his face.
Then, like a defeated caterpillar, he began crawling backward toward the door with his feet, dragging his body in shame.
Loki's laughter exploded. "So this is the super rookie, huh?! What a riot! Hahaha!"
Even Ais couldn't stop the corners of her mouth from twitching upward.
Hermes and Ganesha?
They didn't hold back. Their laughter echoed through the hall, with Ganesha's booming voice making the floor vibrate.
Astraea sighed as she watched the pitiful scene. "Akira, come over here a moment, will you? Let me introduce you properly."
Still red-faced, Akira stood up with forced composure. He fetched a chair, placed it beside Astraea, and sat down stiffly.
With a calm tone that belied his inner chaos, he said, "Hello, Loki-sama, Ganesha-sama, Hermes-sama. I'm Akira."
Only Hermes and Ganesha gave nods in response.
(End of Chapter)
