chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 128: Slaying The Monster Rex, Amphisbaena
chapters.content:
Then, with a swift pivot, Neze shifted gears. Her fingers curled like claws, and with explosive strength, she swung her arms upward beneath the massive dragon's head.
In that instant, the air around her hands twisted as gusts of wind converged and were shaped into sharp, cutting slashes. These wind-blade attacks struck the already bloodied and battered neck of Amphisbaena—ripping through the flesh like blades through paper.
The gruesome wound that had barely begun to form a scab was torn wide open again, and crimson blood burst out like a geyser, splattering violently in all directions. The pain, raw and shocking, sent an unbearable jolt through the dragon's massive frame.
Stimulated beyond reason, Amphisbaena let out an ear-shattering roar of agony.
Its already unstable state tipped further toward unrestrained fury. It lost all remnants of reason and sanity, and what little cunning wisdom it had was swept away by a tide of violent madness.
Driven solely by vengeance and the instinct to destroy, the right head of Amphisbaena twisted with savage speed, its bloodshot eyes locked with hatred on a single target—Neze.
That gaze was filled with nothing but murderous rage.
The enormous dragon jaws parted, revealing jagged fangs that gleamed with lethal hunger as it lunged toward her with bloodthirsty intent.
But in that split second of blind wrath, the beast had made a fatal mistake.
It was so focused on the werewolf girl that it had completely overlooked the shadow lurking nearby—the figure that had been patiently waiting for just this opportunity.
"Where are you looking?"
The chilling voice rang out with calm confidence.
Kaguya's stance shifted in an instant. Her lower body dropped into a crouch, her posture leaning forward ever so slightly—the unmistakable stance of the Iai style.
Her hand hovered over the hilt of her blade.
The air grew heavy with killing intent as it expanded outward like a suffocating pressure wave. The oppressive aura caused Amphisbaena's pupils to contract in fear. It instinctively tried to pull back, to lift its head in defense but it was already too late.
With a whisper like a prayer, Kaguya invoked her magic, and in the next moment—
"Iai no Tachi: Gokou!"
Her blade shot from its sheath in a brilliant flash of crimson.
Five crimson sword arcs split through the air like blooming flowers of carnage, each one descending from a different angle—front, back, left, right, and top. The slashes weaved together to form a deadly net, an inescapable cage of death.
There was no escape.
This was the perfected form of her magic-infused sword technique. The [Five Lights]—a symphony of magic and skill blended into one seamless strike. The slashes, guided by precision and bloodlust, found their marks with ruthless accuracy.
The dragon scales—normally unbreakable and hardened like armor forged by the gods—were nowhere to be found in this weak spot. The blade met tender, exposed flesh.
The sword cuts carved through like hot knives through butter, ripping into the dragon's neck. Blood gushed from the gaping wounds, spraying outward in torrents as bone and sinew were exposed beneath mangled muscle.
"ROARR!!"
Amphisbaena's right head howled in utter agony, rearing back with unnatural force.
With the last of its strength, it unleashed a fan-shaped burst of dragon breath directly ahead, a final act of desperation amidst the chaos.
Yet Alise—shielded by the protection of her teammates and empowered by her magic—stood firm, unleashing her full strength as a lebel 4 adventurer. Her task was to keep the left head of Amphisbaena restrained, and she did so with unrelenting resolve.
As the blazing torrent of blue flame roared forth once again, the trio on the frontline wasted no time—they swiftly retreated to evade the lethal attack.
But one more player remained on the board. A single figure who had yet to reveal his final card.
Akira.
Positioned behind the writhing behemoth, Akira raised his hand with silent intensity and clenched it tightly.
The ice beneath him—the very battlefield frozen solid by his own power—reacted to his will. The ambient cold and lingering mana in the air surged in response.
Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...
A sharp hissing sound pierced the air.
Dozens of icy chains burst forth, appearing as if summoned from the void. These spectral chains glittered with frost and shimmered like snakes of divine punishment.
With eerie precision, they shot toward Amphisbaena's twin heads, wrapping around them tightly like restraints forged by the heavens themselves.
The chains constricted with terrifying force, emitting an agonizing creak as they squeezed down. Then came a sudden jerk—merciless and absolute—pulling the monster's heads violently backward.
Akira didn't hesitate. He was already moving, sprinting forward across the frozen battlefield. His hands glowed with swirling power, and with a focused whisper, he declared—
"Ice Lance."
The moment the words left his lips, surging magical power flooded from his core.
Buzz... Buzz... Buzz…
A low rumble filled the air as two massive drills began forming on Akira's palms—gleaming icy drills spinning at breakneck speed.Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
They were flawless, crystalline, and lethal.
Then, with a thunderous stomp, Akira launched himself forward. The force shattered the very ice beneath his feet, sending shards flying in all directions.
Like a comet, he shot toward the monster.
In the blink of an eye, Akira arrived behind the restrained Amphisbaena. Both heads were struggling madly, but the chains held fast.
"My drill can break through the sky!!!"
With a roar, Akira drove both drills deep into the dragon's vulnerable flesh.
The crystalline growths on Amphisbaena's back cracked and shattered under the force, blood erupting like a fountain. The drills bored into the thick hide, grinding through scale, bone, and sinew.
Even the mighty dragon scales couldn't endure. They resisted, but only briefly—before being torn apart like paper.
"ROAR, ROAR, ROARRRR—!!!"
The scream that followed echoed through the entire dungeon.
It wasn't just a scream of pain—it was despair incarnate.
The agony shattered the last remnants of its resistance. Its glowing scarlet eyes dimmed, and the once fearsome presence it exuded began to fade.
Then—"Poof!"
Akira's rotating drill pierced straight through Amphisbaena's massive skull.
He skidded across the ice, retreating in a graceful arc. Magic dispersed from his hands, the power vanishing into the cold air.
With a firm stomp, Akira brought himself to a halt and turned his head.
He looked back—his crimson eyes meeting the sight of their fallen foe.
The two dragon heads hung lifelessly. Their centers had been hollowed out, pierced clean through.
With a heavy groan, the massive creature finally succumbed.
Its weight pulled it down. Both heads drooped, slamming into the ice-covered floor with a resounding crash. A cloud of shimmering frost burst into the air as it hit.
And just like that, in the span of mere minutes, the Floor Master of the 27th floor—Amphisbaena—was slain by Akira and his companions.

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 129: Akira is a Monster
chapters.content:
"Ohhhhhh!!! The crusade was successful!!"
"It was so easy to succeed!"
"And he defeated the monster rex without receiving any damage at all."
Lyra's voice was full of admiration and praise, her tone echoing the collective awe of the team.
At this moment, looking at the monster rex Amphisbaena, once a towering and seemingly insurmountable threat, now lying motionless on the cold ground, bereft of any breath of life—the companions who had been providing rear support to Alise and the others burst into a thunderous cheer.
As Akira, Alise, and the other three slowly stepped up to the front lines and stood before the lifeless body of Amphisbaena, they shared a quiet glance and smiled at each other.
Ryuu followed behind, running with open arms and joining the others in surrounding the victorious five.
One by one, arms stretched out and embraced each other tightly, a circle of warmth and camaraderie, as if they wished to melt into one another. Bright, jubilant smiles adorned everyone's faces.
Alise made no effort to hide her exhilaration. With a wide grin and arms around Akira, she exclaimed at the top of her lungs, "Everyone did a great job this time! Even I, the captain, think you are super handsome!"
"Hahaha, Alise, what kind of compliment is that?"
Iska, although relegated to rear guard duty, couldn't help but feel a twinge of disappointment at not participating directly in slaying the monster rex. Still, her naturally cheerful and upbeat nature won out, and she laughed lightheartedly, teasing Alise.
Noin, also part of the rear guard alongside Iska, bounced on her heels and shouted with disbelief, "Wow! We actually defeated the monster rex just like that? I still can't believe what my eyes are seeing!"
Her exaggerated reaction, bubbling with excitement, only made her seem more endearing to those around her.
Listening to the waves of enthusiasm, Lyra grumbled with mock annoyance, "Sure enough, with Akira around, the whole expedition becomes too easy."ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Despite her words, as the one who had maintained command of the operation—keeping a constant eye on the battlefield and guiding the team to coordinate with Alise—Lyra finally allowed herself to breathe easier.
On the other side, Ryuu approached Kaguya and gently hugged her.
With a relieved smile, she said softly, "Well done, Kaguya. Your swordsmanship is still as impressive as ever."
Kaguya snorted but raised the corners of her lips slightly, replying, "You did well too, Ryuu. That magic still packs a punch."
Meanwhile, Ais, caught in the center of the joyful atmosphere, looked up at Akira with sparkling eyes and tugged gently at the hem of his clothes. Her small, lovely face was filled with innocent anticipation as she stared up at him, eyes wide and glistening.
Sensing her subtle gesture, Akira shifted his body slightly, using his frame to block Alise, who had been affectionately nuzzling against him.
When he looked down at Ais, her expression full of silent yearning, he immediately understood what she wanted. With a gentle smile, Akira extended a hand and softly patted her on the head.
"Ais, you were amazing out there. You used that move so skillfully. When we get back, everyone will be proud of you."
A faint blush bloomed on Ais's cheeks. Her lips curved into a bright, elated smile, and without warning, she threw herself into Akira's arms, wrapping her arms around his waist.
"Oh, you're so sneaky, Ais-chan! I want to hug Akira too!" Noin exclaimed, full of mischief as she joined in.
Before Alise could react, Ryana had already shoved her aside with her hips and flung her arms around Akira triumphantly. "Hehe, first come, first served! Alise, you've been hogging him for long enough. It's my turn now!"
And just like that, a flurry of playful grabbing and shouting erupted around Akira. A melee of hugs and teasing ensued.
Even Ais, caught in the chaos, was eventually pushed out of the fray. She backed away with a look of quiet defeat, though the blush on her face hadn't faded.
Off to the side, Maryuu crouched down beside Ais and offered her a warm smile. "Ais, you're amazing. That move just now was super cool."
Embarrassed by the sudden praise, Ais lowered her head slightly, her face still tinged red.
She tried her best to smile and replied shyly, "T-thank you... Actually, that move was something Akira taught me."
"Haha, I thought so." Maryuu chuckled knowingly. "Akira must really like you."
Ais blinked, a little stunned by the statement, but soon her expression softened into one of calm determination. "Mhm. I really like Akira, too."
Maryuu couldn't help but laugh again. She gently reached up and gave Ais a reassuring pat on the head. "Then you better keep working hard, Ais. Make your bond with him even stronger."
"Hey, what are you doing!?"
The familiar voice caused both Maryuu and Ais to pause and turn. Moments later, both of them were smiling widely.
"Whoa!"
Just a few steps away, Akira had been hoisted into the air by several companions. With jubilant shouts, they tossed him skyward like a victory banner.
Each time he fell, their hands caught him perfectly before flinging him back up again. Laughter and cheers erupted from all sides.
Watching the joyful scene unfold, Lyra folded her arms, lips curling into a pleased smirk.
"I have to admit, defeating Amphisbaena so easily this time was entirely thanks to Akira."
In years past, even operations that ended with injuries but no deaths were hailed as success stories when facing the 27th Floor's monster rex.
But this time, it had taken only a few minutes. A feat that forced everyone present to reconsider Akira's strength.
"Yeah..." Ryuu murmured, standing beside Lyra.
A touch of quiet frustration lingered in her eyes. "Honestly, even without us, Akira might've handled Amphisbaena all on his own."
Kaguya adjusted her disheveled headdress, her expression uncharacteristically somber. Lips pursed, she added slowly, "Seriously... It's only been a month or two since he received Astraea-sama's blessing, and he's already overtaken all of us. He's really a monster."

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 130: Motivational Environment
chapters.content:
Alise wrapped her arms around the two girls with a radiant smile, her voice warm as she comforted them. "There, there. It's fine. Isn't it actually a good thing that Akira keeps getting stronger?"
"The wings of justice grow ever more powerful!" She added playfully.
Lyra chimed in with a nod, her expression both calm and thoughtful. "From my point of view, the stronger Akira is, the safer everyone else becomes. That's something we can't overlook."The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Ryuu, however, wasn't so easily reassured. Though Alise's encouragement was sincere, Ryuu's eyes still held a flicker of frustration.
"I understand all that. But as a member of the Astraea familia and as someone who sees him like a sibling, I... I want to stand beside him in battle, not just watch from behind."
Although Akira was technically a few years older than Ryuu back in the world he came from, her pride and sense of camaraderie made the gap feel nonexistent.
Kaguya, arms crossed and her usual confidence flashing through her tone, nodded in agreement. "For once, I agree with this not-so-useless elf. I refuse to be left in the dust."
With a chuckle and a gleam in her eye, Alise said, "Well then, when we return, it seems like it's time for a girls' strategy meeting. Let's cheer each other on and train even harder."
Once their lighthearted chatter faded, Akira stepped forward and carefully extracted the glowing blue-purple magic stone from Amphisbaena's torso.
The monstrous corpse, once towering and menacing, began to dissolve slowly. Its vast form faded like melting snowflakes, becoming fine dust that scattered gently to the floor.
All that remained were a few shattered, dense dragon scales and a pungent yet rare material that gleamed faintly in the lamplight: [Amphisbaena's Dragon Liver].
Without hesitation, Akira stored all the precious loot into his backpack.
As expected of a monster rex's drop, every item was immense in size and high in value. The dragon liver alone was nearly as tall as Lyra—a grotesque marvel.
After a brief rest and reorganization, Alise rallied everyone to press forward. They pushed through increasingly dense enemy resistance, battling through layer after layer of dungeon threats. Eventually, their efforts bore fruit as they reached the sanctuary of the 29th floor—a safe zone where they could finally breathe.
Upon arrival, they quickly set up camp. As the weary adventurers relaxed, Akira constructed a makeshift bathing pool, offering everyone a chance to wash off the day's exhaustion.
Conversation floated casually through the air, and before anyone noticed, the time had crept toward ten o'clock.
Mindful of maintaining their biological rhythms, the group began cleaning up and preparing for rest.
But when Akira stepped into the tent, he immediately sensed an awkward tension.
A strange silence hung between Asta and Lyra. Akira remembered the unfinished business between them and could only smile stiffly, uncertain of what to say or do. Instead, he quietly took his place, trying not to intrude.
Asta lay on her side, her back facing the group. Lyra was next to her, whispering something softly.
Meanwhile, as promised in their previous conversation, Ais had claimed her spot next to Akira. With a bright, innocent smile, she scooted close and slipped under her blanket.
Akira sighed helplessly but fondly, then reached out and gently patted her head. Ais immediately started peppering him with curious questions, to which Akira responded patiently until she drifted into peaceful sleep.
Watching Ais's tranquil expression, Akira exhaled slowly and opened his status window.
[Personal Information]
Name: Akira
Age: 13
Level: 37
Status: Healthy
Class: Mage (Male)
Identity: Member of Astraea Familia
He studied the information quietly. "Only two levels gained... It seems the current floor no longer challenges me."
Their victorious push through the monster rex had allowed him to break through easily, reaching the 29th floor without obstruction.
That night, it was Maryuu, Ryana, and Iska who took the watch shifts, safeguarding the rest of the group. Alise and the others, drained to their limits, finally enjoyed a full night of uninterrupted rest.
The next day, invigorated and well-fed, the party resumed their expedition with fresh determination. Their spirits soared like eagles lifting into the wind.
Perhaps inspired by Akira's overwhelming performance, Ais had begun to feel a subtle sense of inadequacy. She watched, fascinated and slightly troubled, as the three most aggressive fighters among them went wild in battle.
Nearby, Ryuu wielded a wooden sword with nimble grace, deftly slicing rocks and monsters alike with her left hand. She moved with unmatched agility, dancing through enemy strikes while chanting magic in her melodic tone. With each chant, blasts of light-infused wind thundered across the battlefield.
What stood out most was her willingness to take blows she could easily avoid, choosing instead to clash head-on and block attacks with sheer strength—a test of resilience and will.
Further along, Alise danced a deadly ballet with her rapier. Every flick of her blade pierced precisely into monster vitals, executing clean and swift kills. Even when surrounded, she refused to rely on magic, instead facing danger with pure swordsmanship. Her movements were sharp and lethal, blinking forward with sudden speed and cleanly dispatching monsters with one slash after another.
The intensity with which these three battled was staggering. They treated each encounter like a training session, relentless and tireless.
Their infectious tenacity spread to everyone in the party, igniting a silent, shared determination.
It wasn't just about survival anymore. It was about rising—to Akira's level, to the next floor, and to whatever lay beyond.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 131: Lecturing The Girls
chapters.content:
At this point, Asta had completely cast aside the defensive role of her shield. Both hands gripped her battle axe tightly as she swung it with full force, cleaving through the approaching monsters like butter. Each powerful strike of the axe summoned a gust of wind, as if even the air itself recognized the sheer strength behind her blows.
Meanwhile, Neze and Iska chose a much more direct and savage method of combat—barehanded brawling.
Relying solely on their formidable physical prowess and expert hand-to-hand techniques, they pummeled the monsters mercilessly. The beasts didn't even get the chance to counterattack before being crushed by iron fists.
Lyra wasn't to be left behind. With her sword gleaming in the dim light, she danced between enemies like a phantom. Every flash of her blade was followed by a shriek, a fall, and a monster laid low.
Even Ryana, who typically specialized in long-range magical bombardments, changed tactics. She swiftly holstered her staff and unsheathed a one-handed sword from her waist. Using parallel chanting, she seamlessly weaved spells while diving into the thick of battle, her blade and magic working in flawless harmony.
In a surprisingly endearing twist, Maryuu clung to Akira's arm with a pout, pleading with puppy-dog eyes, "Akira~ leave a few for me too! I need them to boost my stats."
In contrast, poor Celty looked utterly helpless. She clutched her staff like a lifeline, staring at the chaotic battlefield with watery eyes.
"Akira, what should I do? I feel completely useless. Wuuwuwu..."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
There was despair in her voice as she tugged on the corner of Akira's robe. With the entire battlefield locked in melee combat, casting large-scale magic was too risky.
Sighing, Akira rummaged through his backpack and offered her a spear.
"Try dual wielding your staff and this spear. You can practice parallel chanting while engaging in close range."
The confused expression on Celty's face instantly gave way to determination. Nodding vigorously, she accepted the spear, took a deep breath, and adapted her grip—staff in her left, spear in her right.
With a battle cry, Celty charged.
Akira blinked. "Wait, are you serious?!"
She was. Lightning erupted from her staff, striking down enemies while her spear accurately pierced their skulls. She moved like a seasoned warrior, relentless and fierce.
"..."
Still, Akira knew better than to let the momentum make them careless. He shifted into Swift Master mode, manipulating storm currents to deflect potential lethal attacks.
But even that had its limits. The battle raged until they reached the 33rd floor—the furthest point previously reached by Astraea Familia.
By then, the girls were battered and exhausted. Their elegant features were masked with bruises and dirt.
Akira led them to a secluded corner and raised his arms. Ice blossomed from the ground, forming a crystalline shelter that enveloped them. He followed up with a cloaking spell. Thick black mist spilled from his palm and veiled their haven, ensuring privacy and safety.
Crossing his arms, Akira scolded, "Training's over. If we keep pushing like this, we'll never reach the 34th floor."
His gaze locked onto Alise, Ryuu, and Kaguya. "And you three—our captains—should not be risking yourselves recklessly."
"Ahaha. I get it." Alise scratched her head, laughing sheepishly.
Ryuu turned slightly, her cheeks pink. "I'm sorry. I'll reflect."
"Hmph." Kaguya huffed, ready to retort, "Don't worry, we know ou—"
Before she could finish, Akira teleported right in front of her. He grasped her cheeks and touched his forehead to hers, their eyes meeting.
"I understand now." He said softly.
Kaguya's pride melted into flustered panic. Seeing the genuine concern in his eyes, she sighed and mumbled, "...Okay. I understand."
"That's more like it." Akira grinned and patted her head.
Turning to the rest, he said, "Let's take a break. No safe zone ahead. We'll need our strength."
Responses echoed through the group.
"Okay."
"Understood!"
"Haha, Akira really sounds like a team leader now."
"Even Kaguya couldn't argue."
Lyra, swinging her legs on a rock, smirked, "At this rate, Alise should give up her position to Akira."
Laughter erupted.
"That's mean, Lyra!" Alise pouted and jumped behind Akira, hugging him from behind. "Right, Akira? You wouldn't want that, right?"
"Of course not." Akira chuckled. "Alise is our irreplaceable captain."
Still, as she clung to him, he found himself hoisting her up slightly by the waist. Despite his exasperation, his expression was full of affection.
After everyone took their panaceas, Maryuu used her healing magic. In moments, wounds closed and bruises faded, leaving behind flawless skin.
Raising his fist, Akira declared, "Expedition team! Move out!"
"Ohhhhhh!"
Energized and united, the girls answered back, their spirits once again reignited by trust and camaraderie.
The 35th floor.
This floor, a nightmarish carnival of monsters, pulsed with a suffocating atmosphere of dread and brutality.
Just before Astraea Familia's expedition team reached the threshold of the 36th floor, a battle erupted without warning—a chaotic and deadly clash that would test the mettle of even the bravest adventurers.
A tide of more than twenty monsters surged toward them, a twisted parade of horrors surrounding them in every direction.
The first to appear were the Black Rhinoceros Minotaurs—towering, hulking beasts resembling obsidian hills brought to life, their massive forms exuding raw power.
Each one wielded an enormous trident with terrifying ease, their wild swings generating powerful gusts like underwater cyclones—as if they hailed from the fabled Water City, living nightmares in the form of Mermaid Guards.
Following them came a sweeping swarm of floating fish, each creature radiating a numbing cold. They rolled in like a pitch-black tide, and the moment they passed, the temperature dropped precipitously. These predators were ice incarnate—once surrounded, a person would be frozen solid, turned into a fragile statue incapable of resistance.
Most troublesome of all, however, were the gargoyles. These winged monstrosities, sculpted from dense obsidian, soared through the air with eerie grace. Their bodies were a nightmare for magic-users. Due to the nature of their material, spells barely scratched them. For mages, they were the worst kind of opponent—a living wall that ignored magic altogether.
There was no doubt why this deadly assortment had gathered. All were drawn to the 37th floor—the Arena.
There, they would engage in a brutal contest of evolution, consuming monsters and their magic stones to grow stronger, faster, and deadlier.
Amidst the chaos, Ryuu led the enemy astray. Darting through the battlefield like a wisp of wind, she pulled aggro with calculated movements—taunting, dodging, and striking in unison. Her voice rose in a steady chant, and her magic took shape.
"Luminous Wind"
From the heavens, radiant bolts descended like stardust, crashing down with divine fury. A dozen light bombs slammed into the vanguard of monsters, their bodies shattering under the sheer force of the impact, torn apart in a ballet of carnage.
Scarlet flames burst forth next, wrapping around the petite frame of Alise. She was engulfed in fire, her every step blazing with righteous fury. Her sword, alight with brilliant hue, cut down anything it touched. Monsters howled in agony as her flaming blade carved through them, burning some to ash, severing others with ease.
Her battle cry rang out, clear and resolute.
"No passing through here! I won't let any of you hurt my companions!"
Beside her, Kaguya moved with deadly grace. Her demeanor wasn't flashy, but her skills were honed and lethal. She wielded her katana like an extension of herself, its every swing a promise of death. With every draw, a crimson bloom of blood erupted, deadly and poetic—the embodiment of a red spider lily blooming at hell's gate.
"Eyes forward! Don't get distracted!" She said sharply, cutting down another foe.
Behind the vanguard stood Asta, their sturdy dwarf defender. Her massive shield gleamed as she pushed forward, unwavering, drawing the monsters' attention. Her taunts rang out, pulling the beasts to her like iron to a magnet.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 132: A Lizardman Elite
chapters.content:
At that precise moment, two mages stepped forth—wands raised, eyes narrowed.
The air beneath them shimmered with magic circles, and in a flash, lightning and flame fused together. A searing torrent of elemental destruction roared through the ranks of monsters, wiping them out in one synchronized strike.
But the calm did not last.
The clash intensified as new waves poured in, driven by the noise of combat. Unlike the monsters of the middle and upper floors, these were aggressive, intelligent predators who actively hunted their prey.
The relentless sound of steel and magic became a beacon, drawing even more monstrosities from every direction. The battlefield was plunged into deeper chaos.
Formations broke down. Coordination faltered. The clean synergy of the Astraea Familia started to show cracks.
The most vulnerable spot—the center—bore the brunt of the assault. A gap opened.
Given the sheer numbers, it was only a matter of time. After all, they were just thirteen against an endless tide.
Then, like vultures drawn to a wounded beast, the winged gargoyles spotted their chance.
A flock of them pierced through the faltering defenses, descending in a storm of obsidian wings and claws. They dove straight for the rear guard, where the elf girl with glasses had just completed a support spell.
A cold shadow fell across her.
She turned just in time to see a towering, one-meter-tall gargoyle looming above her—its jet-black stone body gleaming, its crimson eyes burning with murderous glee.
Its presence radiated pure malice. A frozen chill spread in the air around it, and Celty could only gasp—caught in that final moment before impact.
Celty's beautiful emerald eyes clearly reflected the terrifying figure of the monster pouncing at her with its sharp claws raised high.
For a moment, fear occupied her entire heart and her brain went blank.
But the magic wand in her hand was made of branches of the sacred tree. It was highly compatible with the magic power of the elves and also had the property of being tough.
This made her instinctively clench her wand with both hands, and she thrust it at the sharp claws that were coming at her, using the hook on the wand to grab the monster's claws. Then she quickly finished the chant.
As the last syllable fell, a dazzling bolt of lightning gushed out from the tip of the wand and hit the monster hard.
There was a loud bang, and the monster screamed and was blown away by the powerful impact.
Don't be fooled by her weak appearance and poor melee combat skills, but she is also a level 3 adventurer.
What's more, most of the familia members are experts in close combat, and she has learned a few moves from them.
Swish!
A fleeting flash of light suddenly appeared in sight.
The sword was moving so fast that the mind could only capture the afterimage left by the sword due to its fast speed.
Looking closely, it could be noticed that it was Akira holding a one-handed sword that pierced through the gargoyle's chest and knocked it several meters away, and shattered the magic stone inside it.
"Attribute transformation."
In an instant, the power of thunder and lightning began to surge wildly.
Not only did the lightning tightly wrap around Akira's body, but even the one-handed sword in his hand was flashing with dazzling lightning.
Celty stared blankly at Akira's black hair, which flashed silver under the lightning. At the same time, the hair was slightly puffed and stood up. Akira, who was surrounded by thunder, exuded a brilliance that was difficult to look at.
Accompanied by a crackling sound, dazzling white thunder suddenly bloomed and turned into an extremely sharp light.
The light was as fast as lightning, rushing away at a speed that was almost impossible to capture with the naked eye. It was like a huge vortex cloud, emitting a chilling aura.
In an instant, it was not just one slash that was swung out. It seemed as if seven slashes were rushing out at the same time.
The densely packed and intertwined slashes seemed to form an indestructible net.
Those gargoyles, which were originally extremely aggressive, were now completely powerless in the face of Akira's dense slashes.
Only crisp breaking sounds could be heard all around, and they were instantly cut into more than a dozen pieces and scattered all over the ground.
Slash after slash, forming a storm that would cut any monster that came close into pieces.
No matter how ferocious the monster was, if it dared to approach this area, it would be ruthlessly cut into pieces in the blink of an eye and turned into powder and dissipated in the air.
At this point, the crisis was resolved.
"Phew, I'm saved." Celty patted her chest with a look of palpitations on her face.
Ryana, who was about to draw her sword to fight, comforted her, "Don't worry, there are very reliable people here, and you have to slow down."
Then she waved her wand again to use magic to protect the vanguard.
"Yes!"
Celty, who had just breathed a sigh of relief, responded immediately by clenching her wand upon hearing the reminder.
After resting for a while at the entrance of the 36th floor, the expedition team moved forward again.
The environment changed again. The walls here were a somewhat creepy white turbid color, and the structure was incomparable to the previous buildings.
Although there were exceptions in some areas, most of the passages and caves were very wide, and the width of almost all areas was at least more than ten meters.
Although the dim light source made it impossible to visually estimate the height of the zenith, it should not be underestimated.
Although it was no longer a square-like terrain and monsters were unlikely to gather together, if one got lost here, they might be trapped in the dungeon for the rest of their life.
So on the way in, Lyra began to trace the route she had taken and placed small objects in the corners to use as landmarks.
While Akira and his companions were clearing out the monsters, they were heading towards the entrance to the next floor.
As they walked, they encountered a group of monsters that theoretically should only be found on the next floor.
[Lizardman Elite].
As the name suggests, it is an advanced species of [Lizardman] that appears in the Large Tree Maze, and the abilities of the two are very different.
The scales changed from red to blue, which were as hard as armor, with no flaws in both offense and defense. Its hands could flexibly use the two natural weapons, the white rock axe that looked like white bones.
Although there are differences between individuals, the guild has set its threat level at Lv. 3 to Lv. 4, which is specialized in hand-to-hand combat.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
At these levels, it is no longer possible for everyone to waste energy fighting monsters. They should try to eliminate the enemy with a single attack.
In other words, it means one hit kill.
The moment one of the monsters impatiently raised its rock axe to chop down, Ais instantly switched from defense to offense and launched a lightning-fast attack.
Ais stepped forward steadily, and with her right arm, she thrust out with her rapier like a spear. She aimed at the Magic Stone hidden in the monster's chest, and stabbed it right into the center of its defenseless chest.
As the monster let out a "woooo", Ais could feel that the sword in her hand had pierced through the hard magic stone. The lizardman's eyes bulged out, and after a huge spasm, it slowly turned into dust and collapsed.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 133: Returning to the Surface
chapters.content:
At the entrance to the 37th floor, the campfire was burning, illuminating the space shrouded in darkness.
Compared with the harsh battles during the day, the expedition seemed a little more relaxed at night.
Everyone first cleared out the monsters nearby, then dug and destroyed the walls of the dungeon, putting it into a state of repair to ensure that no new monsters would be born here during this period.
The map drawn by the expedition team to break through the 33rd floor was finally completed.
At the same time, all the precious materials entrusted to the Astraea familia by other familias were also collected.
At this point, the mission of this dungeon expedition can be said to have been successfully completed, and everyone can embark on the return journey back to the sunny ground.
At this moment, Alise was sitting quietly on a chair. She leaned forward slightly and gently supported her delicate chin with her white and tender hands.
She deliberately put on an unfathomable look and slowly asked Lyra beside her, "We will start to return to the surface tomorrow. Lyra, how is our mission going?"
Seeing Alise's playful look, since everyone was very happy to go home today, they just joined in the fun.
After all, although adventure is their choice, being in a dark dungeon for a long time, with constant high-intensity battles and subtle darkness and oppression, is a burden.
Even though physical exhaustion can be healed by potions and magic, the wear and tear on the spirit and will is undeniable.
At first the expedition was very enthusiastic, but as time went on, it became increasingly silent.
If it weren't for Alise and Akira who often made jokes to amuse everyone, and Akira's meticulous logistical care, no one would be in the mood to do these boring things. The only thing they would want to do might be to lie down and rest early to recover some energy to face the next challenge.
"Well... Captain, we have the map and materials, so this expedition is a complete success." Lyra held up the map she had drawn and the materials list, saying with respect etched across her face.
Hearing this, Alise continued without changing her movements, "Really? Well done, you are worthy of being our military advisor. Everyone has done a great job on this expedition."
"No, no, all this is thanks to Alise-sama's leadership. We just contributed a little bit of effort." Akira, who was sitting aside with a smile on his face, took over the conversation.
Then he made a clapping gesture and said to the others, "Why don't you hurry up and congratulate Alise-sama?"
Only then did everyone react and began to applaud with a teasing smile.
Facing this scene, Alise scratched her cheek and said, "Ahaha, thank you,... Can you stop for a moment? I'm a little shy."
"Oh— Alise-sama is so amazing." Following Akira's eye signal, Ais shouted out these seemingly praiseworthy words.
With a red face, Alise grabbed Akira and held him tightly in her arms.
Akira was caught off guard and was hugged tightly by Alise, with his whole body pressed against her.
Alise used Akira as a shield to cover her reddened face, while she kept muttering, "You guys are going too far. Wasn't I just showing off a little?"
"I admit my mistake. Stop clapping."
As the applause continued, Alise's shy voice sounded from behind Akira.
After hearing this, the crowd that had been clapping and cheering gradually stopped what they were doing, but the smiles on their faces did not diminish in the slightest. They all laughed even more wantonly.
"Captain, isn't this your favorite compliment?"
"Yes, Captain, you are not usually like this."
...
The last bit of firewood finally went out completely, as if symbolizing the end of a journey.
Although they were on the 36th floor and could not see any signs of "dawn", the endless night finally came to an end.
At least that was the case for the expedition team. Everyone packed their bags and set off on their return journey full of confidence.
As for the deeper floors, they just took a look and left. Although there were many dangers, as everyone became stronger and stronger, they managed to gain a foothold before the 37th floor.
When they go back and update theit falna, and turn the excelia accumulated from this trip into stats, the next expedition will definitely be easier.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The expedition team carried ample supplies, potions, and all kinds of food, enough to support them to return to the surface smoothly.
Therefore, everyone's mood was getting better.
Akira carried a giant backpack on one shoulder that was taller than him. It was filled to the brim with the rich harvest from the expedition.
When carrying the bag on one shoulder, he can throw it away if he encounters danger to prevent it from restricting his movements.
"Are you okay? Maybe it's too heavy. Give me some more."
Celty, was responsible for supporting Akira together. Maybe it was because she was a little scared yesterday, so Lyra asked her to be the supporter. However, she carried very little stuff, probably less than 0.3% of Akira's luggage.
Although Akira could put everything into [Backpack], he can't let others see him on an expedition with nothing in his hands.
Moreover, since helping her in the battle, Akira's relationship with Celty has become much better, and she would often talk to him intentionally or unintentionally.
But Akira considered the fact that she was a mage, and she was also small and young, so he took the initiative to carry most of the harvest himself, even though the elves always looked very slender, including Akira.
Akira smiled and hooked his arm around her slender and soft arm, and followed the crowd quickly with her, saying nonchalantly, "Don't worry, don't you know my body?"
Hearing this, Celty's cheeks instantly flushed with shyness.
She lowered her head hastily and said to Akira in a low voice, "...Akira, your words are a little ambiguous, could you please speak a little more quietly?"
After saying this, she secretly glanced at the people around her out of the corner of her eye, fearing that others would hear this slightly ambiguous conversation.
On the way back to the surface, the girls were warmly welcomed by the monsters.
After going through the training in the lower floors, they not only knew the weaknesses of monsters well, but could also deal with their attack methods with ease.
Before long, those originally aggressive monsters fell at the feet of the girls and turned into piles of lifeless corpses.
Although their stats ​​had not yet increased, everyone could feel that they had made great progress in all aspects.
Compared with the last expedition, they had made significant improvements in both skill application and teamwork this time.
Therefore, when the battle was over, looking at the monster remains all over the ground, every girl's heart was filled with indescribable joy and surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 134: Is It Evilus?
chapters.content:
"Hahaha, the battle felt so easy. Hehe, I wonder how much my stats will improve when I go back this time?"
"No wonder the Loki familia loves expeditions so much, it really helps adventurers gt stronger very quickly."
"Ah, Akira, I want to take a shower and put on makeup, otherwise, I will stink and my face will look ugly." Iska complained.
She was the only Amazoness in the Astraea familia.
Although she liked revealing clothes, at most it would only make Ryuu complain a little, and she was not more excessive than other Amazonesses.
However, the strange thing about Iska is that she pays more attention to dressing up rather than men or struggle.
In the Astraea familia, it is said that her makeup skills rank first. To be honest, she may be the most "girly".
Akira responded loudly, "That's after we reach the safe floor on the 29th floor. Right nw, even if you tell me, there's nothing I can do."
Then he added loudly, "Do you want me to use magic to bathe you while holding up a mirror for you to put on makeup?"
Iska kicked a monster and replied with a big laugh, "Really? Love you, Akira!"
With a backpack as tall as a person in one hand, Akira slashed the monster attacking from behind with a sword and half-helplessly shouted, "Of course it's impossible!!? You stupid Amazoness!"
Akira and Celty picked up the magic stones on the ground, and occasionally valuable materials would appear.
In this regard, the Astraea familia adopted an equal division system.
No matter whether it was Ryuu, Alise or Akira, no matter how well they performed in the expedition, the loot they got in the end would be divided equally among them.
This is the choice made by the children of the goddess of justice. It is precisely because everyone works together and moves forward that they can grow so fast.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 135: Evilus VS Astraea Familia
chapters.content:

Although he didn't know why he was arranged to use the Kaenseki to blow up the floor and bury the Astraea familia, this was also an opportunity.
Maybe after completing the mission, he could become a senior cadre of the Evilus.
A few days ago, the monster controlled by Jura Halmer discovered their tracks, and then they easily killed it in the battle.
In order to avoid alerting the enemy, Evilus no longer sent out monsters to monitor the Astraea familia.
Anyway, if they want to return to the ground, they must go through this road.
Jura had already prepared the trap required by his superiors on this road, and now he was just waiting for them to come to him on their own accord.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Finally, he discovered the girls' figures slowly appearing in front of him.
"Hahaha, they're finally here?"
Jura hid behind the Evilus members with a wild laugh on his face. He observed Akira and the girls for a few seconds. Then, he and a few others began to retreat.
"But I don't intend to die in the dungeon with you, the icons of justice. Hahahaha, just bury you here with these garbage!"
The two sides stopped at a distance of several dozen meters.
Although Akira was at the end, he could see the so-called Evilus, which numbered about thirty or forty people.
But in his perception, these people were in a state of confusion inside. And although their eyes were filled with fanaticism towards Evilus, there seemed to be a hint of fear as well.
'It seems that those guys still like to use their own people as cannon fodder like before. I don't know what these people are thinking.' Akira thought to himself.
The people of Evilus have blocked the passage, which is the only way to the ground. If they want to return to the surface world, they must defeat them.
Although Akira had participated in an operation to suppress Evilus before, he knew that there was no need to reason with these people and he could just kill them directly.
They have committed countless evils. As long as they are members of Evilus for one day, they will be members of Evilus for the rest of their lives. Death is their only destination.
Although most of these people were Lv. 1 and Lv. 2, with only one Lv. 3 at the highest level, Akira still felt a strong sense of uneasiness, just like the crazy behavior of animals before an earthquake.
With insight far beyond those of others and the perception ability brought by the huge magic power, Akira looked around and noticed that there seemed to be a lot of heat sources hidden in the surrounding environment.
Akira thought, 'Sure enough, there are a lot of Kaensekis buried here. There must be some trap nearby.'
Putting away the backpack on his shoulder, Akira stood beside Alise and whispered, "Everyone, there are a lot of Kaensekis nearby. When the battle begins, don't stay too far away from me. Leave these people to me first."
Although it is possible to use a magic item to directly return everyone to the ground, it is not a good thing to reveal that the Astraea familia has this item now.
Without asking Akira why he suddenly changed his mind and wanted to fight alone, the girls who believed in Akira from the bottom of their hearts responded to him in a low voice.
"Okay, I'll leave these people to you."
"Be careful, Akira."
"Don't worry, we will protect ourselves."
"You...are indeed Evilus, right?" Alise's tone was very calm.
Although she already knew the other party's identity, she couldn't help but want to confirm it one last time.
After all, what she held in her hand was the sharp blade representing justice—the sword of justice belonging to the goddess of justice, which would never be stained with the blood of innocent people.
"Hahahaha! You lowly women from Astraea's familia, today is your doom!"
As the only Level 3 member of the remaining Evilus, he was now screaming like a mad beast that had lost its mind. His eyes were bloodshot, and his face was filled with uncontrollable anger and hatred.
Because he knew very well that being left behind to block the Astraea familia from moving forward would be equivalent to death.
However, in order to realize the long-cherished wish of their Evilus, what would it matter even if they had to sacrifice their precious lives?
Moreover, their god once said personally that as long as this operation could be successfully completed, he would resurrect this most important member no matter what.
Thinking of this, an almost insane and fanatical smile appeared on his face, as if he had seen the dawn of victory.
"Hahahahahaha... Are you naive enough to think that the enemy is only us? That's simply stupid!"
The man laughed wildly, his face full of contempt and ridicule for the other party's ignorance.
Because he was convinced of his victory, and because he wanted to delay time, he not only wanted to destroy these women physically, but also intended to give them the heaviest and most extreme humiliation and blow from a spiritual perspective.
"Open your ears and listen carefully. There are five chambers of commerce and twenty-two mercenary groups."
"In addition, there are many other forces involved, and even people in the guild are secretly assisting us."
"The darkness has never really disappeared. It has always been lurking in the dark, but you are too ignorant to notice it."
The man paused, and scanned the crowd in front of him with malicious eyes, and continued, "Astraea familia, this place will be your demise today!"
"In this bottomless underground city, the original abyss of the world, is where you will be buried!"
The Evilus members were roaring, and their voices were echoing in the closed passage.
"Really? There are so many enemies?" Upon hearing this, Alise looked helpless as if she was in distress.
"We can settle the score with them when we get back. The most important thing now is to make their plot fail."
After hearing Akira say that there was a Kaenseki nearby, Lyra had to put away the secret bomb and took out her weapon.
"What a boring, yet cruel world. But it is precisely because of this that I joined the familia of justice and searched for a ray of light in this dark world." Kaguya looked upwards, her eyes filled with undisguised murderous intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 136: Kaenseki Explosion
chapters.content:
"Are there so many people in Orario who want us to disappear?"
Ryuu pursed her lips tightly, with a complicated expression on her face.
As the purest and most fragile one among the four, her heart was a mess, with all kinds of thoughts intertwined together, making her feel extremely entangled and confused.
Are there really so many people in this bustling city of Orario who are hoping that they will disappear?
The LV. 3 member of the Evilus waved his hand and shouted to the other members, "Go! Kill them and you will get the god's wish!"
Following this shout, like a surging black wave, the members of Evilus responded in unison, "Oh oh oh!!!"
Their faces were distorted, revealing expressions of extreme ferocity and madness, and they rushed towards Akira and the girls like hungry wolves pouncing on their prey.
At the same time, the LV. 3 man hiding in the back quietly abandoned his teammates and rode his tamed monster quickly away towards the road that Jura had just left.
At this moment, his heart was constantly roaring.
"Only idiots would believe those nonsense said by the gods!!"
He cursed in his heart, staring nervously at the red gems in the passage ahead, and anxiously urged the monster under him, "Can you go faster? You are such an idiot!"
Looking at the attacking members of Evilus, Akira and the others entered combat mode. Normally, before charging, the mages and Ryuu would first launch a wave of AOE output.
But now there are many Kaensekis buried around, and they can't cast magic, so they can only use melee weapons to fight against the Evilus.
Time was running out, so Alise and the others showed no mercy when facing these Evilus members who were at most Lv. 1 adventurers.
Akira was seen moving as fast as lightning, holding tightly in his hand the one-handed sword that was flashing with cold light.
He swung his sword violently, and where the sword flashed, a member of Evilus didn't even have time to react, and he was split in half along with the sword.
Then, Akira raised his left hand high, and powerful magic power instantly surged in his palm.
In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen extremely sharp ice spears suddenly rose from the ground, piercing straight through the bodies of the enemies with fierce momentum.
The Evilus members who were pinned to the spot by the ice spears let out sharp screams. The blood flowing from their wounds was frozen by the extremely cold ice spears before it could even flow out.
Such a horrifying scene frightened the Evilus members who had originally intended to bypass Akira and attack Alise and the others, and they stopped in their tracks.
When they turned in horror to look at the captain whose strength had reached Level 3, they were shocked to find that he had disappeared long ago.
Seeing their captain disappear and the enemy's moves stay equally terrifying, the morale of the Evilus members plummeted.
The idea of ​​defeat and escape began to spread in their minds.
Jura, riding on the giant snake monster, reached the exit of the 26th floor in just a few minutes and looked at the Kaensekis lined up one by one.
"It's over, everyone from the Astraea familia."
With a wild smile on his face, he took out a flaming magic sword and swung it forward. The moment the flame touched the Kaenseki, sparks flew and the fire spread rapidly.
In the blink of an eye, the originally silent Kaensekis were ignited one after another, and they began to bloom with dazzling brilliance like brilliant fireworks.
Immediately afterwards, a series of earth-shaking explosions occurred.
Sponsored by the Chamber of Commerce and Evilus, tons of flammable and explosive Kaensekis were quietly buried around the expedition team.
The real trap this time is not the secret factions and mercenaries, they are just a group of tools.
The most important thing is to stop the expedition team at a designated location. The reason why the Lv. 3 captain revealed the mastermind behind the conspiracy was to delay time.
The Kaensekis thrown by the group running around in the passage were like fuses that repeatedly caught fire and exploded, shattering every passage.
The monsters in the cave were burned by the flames, and the melted crystal pillars were gradually washed away by the destructive vortex.
....
"!?"
"What's going on? What's the situation now?!"
"The ground collapsed?!"
"Run, run!"
The explosion spanned two floors, and the loud noise was also heard by some adventurers on the 25th floor.
The crystal walls were blown away, the ground exploded, the ceiling collapsed, and the water flow lost its order and flooded.
The 25th floor, which has a multi-layered structure, was gradually collapsing as if it had lost its support.
The force of this impact was also transmitted to Akira, Alise and others who were still on the next floor.
The dazzling explosion flashed in everyone's eyes, but Akira's pupils did not show any negative emotions when Alise and the others were about to inject magic power into the magic items.
In an instant, Akira's hair turned snow-white, his red eyes were filled with cold absolute rationality, and he pressed his hands suddenly, and the power of ice gushed out.
Only a few crisp "crackling" sounds were heard, and the ground quickly solidified. Ice walls appeared out of thin air around them and wrapped up all the members of the expedition team, forming a huge ice ball.
Then, chains of ice flashing with cold light suddenly shot out from the inside of the ice ball and wrapped around everyone like nimble snakes, firmly fixing them in place.
As long as you enter this big sphere formed by the power of ice, no matter what kind of attack comes from outside, it will not affect the people inside in the slightest.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The violent explosion was even more terrifying than Evilus had expected. The shock wave and heat wave blew to pieces all the Evilus members closest to the explosion.
The entire underground city seemed to be hit by a magnitude 13 earthquake, and the violent shaking seemed like the end of the world.
"Hahahaha! It's a success." Jura felt the huge vibration and shouted excitedly.
However, seeing that the collapsed crack was getting closer and closer to him and others, he stopped talking nonsense and quickly left with his men.
The Kaenseki has extremely high explosive power. Once it explodes, the power is astonishing. The explosion is extremely powerful, but it ends quickly.Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 137: The Dungeon's Immune Response
chapters.content:
At this time, the surging heat wave was gradually dissipating, the previous violent vibrations were slowly subsiding, and the sound of collapse came from a distance.
The solid ground where the expedition team was originally located had now turned into a huge hole with a diameter of nearly 100 meters.
Not only that, the nearby caves around the hole were also not spared, and each one became riddled with holes and in ruins.
The walls were covered with dense cracks, some of which were even several meters wide, as if they would collapse at any time.
In the midst of this mess, the huge ice ball controlled by Akira was not greatly affected.
Driven by Akira's thoughts, it slowly melted away and finally turned into a stream of water.
All members of the expedition team were safe and sound in this thrilling explosion.
However, because the ground beneath their feet was completely blown up, everyone lost their support and was caught off guard. They fell straight down from the 26th floor to the 27th, where Amphisbaena was.
"Is everyone okay?"
"That was a close call, Akira, you are awesome."
"It's a trap. They actually want to destroy us with so many bombs. What a scary guy."
The voices of the familia members could be heard from all around.
...
"Huh?!!!"
Ouranos stood up from the throne with a serious look on his face.
In the stone space that looked like an underground temple, four torches set up beside the altar emitted red light. In the center of the altar dominated by the dim darkness, Ouranos opened his pale eyes.
"What's wrong, Ouranos?"
Fels felt the immovable old god standing up, so he sent him a message.
Ouranos paused for a moment, then spoke with a heavy heart, "Something is wrong in the dungeon, something is hatching..."
"Something? What do you mean? What are you talking about, Ouranos?!"
Perhaps sensing the unusual aura of the old god, Fels asked a little impatiently.
Ouranos squinted his eyes and looked down at his feet.
Looking down at the underground world (dungeon) spreading out below, he answered to the crystal, "I don't know, I can only feel that an unknown monster is being born..."
"Monster?!"
Ouranos solemnly declared to the speechless Fels, "The disaster is coming..."
Ouranos listened to the sounds coming from the dungeon and told Fels in a sad voice.
"The defensive instinct triggered by excessive damage... That is the cry of the dungeon that even my prayers cannot reach."
If you simply destroy the structure of the dungeon, it will not cause any reaction. Every time the dungeon is damaged, it will start to repair itself in order to regenerate. The power is so sufficient that adventurers call it [Infinite Resource].
However, once someone carries out an act that makes it too late for the dungeon to regenerate... no, it is an act of excessive destruction.
Then, the dungeon will no longer regenerate, but will start eliminating the "cause".
If we use living things to describe it, it will be easy to understand.
Just like humans, when the body is attacked by foreign objects, the immune function will be activated to eliminate the invading pathogens (viruses).
Of course, all living things have this self-defense instinct.
The same goes for the dungeon.
As a dungeon that can produce monsters, it is alive. When it is attacked excessively, this living underground maze will play its self-defense instinct and give birth to that...
Giving birth to that being that is equivalent to an immune response.
Give birth to apostles to remove foreign objects such as adventurers who invade the body (dungeon).
Back to Akira, everyone landed safely after having a thrilling experience. Everyone was gasping for breath with lingering fear, but soon focused their attention on the huge and deep hole above their heads.
Alise raised her head, looked up at the shocking hole in the ceiling, and said solemnly, "What a horrible attack, these damn Evilus."
Kaguya also had a look of disgust on her face.
She frowned and gritted her teeth and said, "Ah, I didn't expect that they would even raise such a thing."
At this time, Akira stood there calmly, listening to the discussions of the girls around him.
Just as he was about to say something, he suddenly felt his body shake violently.
"What happened again? Is it... an earthquake?" Lyra reacted quickly and noticed.
You know, in this mysterious labyrinth, any tiny vibration is often a harbinger of some abnormal state to come.
Alise didn't dare to delay for even a second. She made a prompt decision and shouted at the top of her voice, "Everyone, hurry up and evacuate the bottom of this hole!"
Hearing Alise's cry, the members of the expedition came back to their senses as if awakened from a dream, and then ran as fast as possible towards the cave leading to the 28th floor that was covered by tree roots.
Akira grabbed Maryuu and Celty in each hand and held them between his waist and quickly followed everyone's pace.
As they ran desperately, the vibrations around them became more and more intense, as if the entire dungeon was shaking.
At the same time, bursts of low and faint roars were heard from a distance, the sound was deafening, it seemed that the monsters in the two adjacent floors were rushing towards here frantically.
Then, a sharp, piercing, and creepy cry resounded throughout the space.
"Ahhh!!!"
The huge maze buried deep underground was like a living being being tortured, crying out in pain.
It was as if a knife was ruthlessly cutting through a silver string stretched to its limit, producing an extraordinary, inorganic, high-pitched melody.
This extremely sharp sound has unparalleled penetrating power. It is powerful enough to easily penetrate people's fragile eardrums and physically drill into the depths of the brain.
The undoubted "crying" of the dungeon made every girl present frown involuntarily.
They instinctively covered their ears with their hands, but even so, the horrible sound still followed them like a shadow, madly attacking their nerve endings.
At this moment, the light around, which had seemed a little dim, suddenly began to flicker and quickly turned into a dazzling red light.
The red light illuminated the surroundings, making it seem as if one was in purgatory, terrifying and depressing.
In Akira's perception, the intricate lines crisscrossed like blood vessels connecting countless lives. These lines were the veins that stored the vast amount of magic power in the dungeon.
The magic power began to gather, like a waterfall falling straight down and like a flood spreading across the sky.
(End of Chapter)
