With insight far beyond those of others and the perception ability brought by the huge magic power, Akira looked around and noticed that there seemed to be a lot of heat sources hidden in the surrounding environment.
Akira thought, 'Sure enough, there are a lot of Kaensekis buried here. There must be some trap nearby.'
Putting away the backpack on his shoulder, Akira stood beside Alise and whispered, "Everyone, there are a lot of Kaensekis nearby. When the battle begins, don't stay too far away from me. Leave these people to me first."
Although it is possible to use a magic item to directly return everyone to the ground, it is not a good thing to reveal that the Astraea familia has this item now.
Without asking Akira why he suddenly changed his mind and wanted to fight alone, the girls who believed in Akira from the bottom of their hearts responded to him in a low voice.
"Okay, I'll leave these people to you."
"Be careful, Akira."
"Don't worry, we will protect ourselves."
"You...are indeed Evilus, right?" Alise's tone was very calm.
Although she already knew the other party's identity, she couldn't help but want to confirm it one last time.
After all, what she held in her hand was the sharp blade representing justice—the sword of justice belonging to the goddess of justice, which would never be stained with the blood of innocent people.
"Hahahaha! You lowly women from Astraea's familia, today is your doom!"
As the only Level 3 member of the remaining Evilus, he was now screaming like a mad beast that had lost its mind. His eyes were bloodshot, and his face was filled with uncontrollable anger and hatred.
Because he knew very well that being left behind to block the Astraea familia from moving forward would be equivalent to death.
However, in order to realize the long-cherished wish of their Evilus, what would it matter even if they had to sacrifice their precious lives?
Moreover, their god once said personally that as long as this operation could be successfully completed, he would resurrect this most important member no matter what.
Thinking of this, an almost insane and fanatical smile appeared on his face, as if he had seen the dawn of victory.
"Hahahahahaha... Are you naive enough to think that the enemy is only us? That's simply stupid!"
The man laughed wildly, his face full of contempt and ridicule for the other party's ignorance.
Because he was convinced of his victory, and because he wanted to delay time, he not only wanted to destroy these women physically, but also intended to give them the heaviest and most extreme humiliation and blow from a spiritual perspective.
"Open your ears and listen carefully. There are five chambers of commerce and twenty-two mercenary groups."
"In addition, there are many other forces involved, and even people in the guild are secretly assisting us."
"The darkness has never really disappeared. It has always been lurking in the dark, but you are too ignorant to notice it."
The man paused, and scanned the crowd in front of him with malicious eyes, and continued, "Astraea familia, this place will be your demise today!"
"In this bottomless underground city, the original abyss of the world, is where you will be buried!"
The Evilus members were roaring, and their voices were echoing in the closed passage.
"Really? There are so many enemies?" Upon hearing this, Alise looked helpless as if she was in distress.
"We can settle the score with them when we get back. The most important thing now is to make their plot fail."
After hearing Akira say that there was a Kaenseki nearby, Lyra had to put away the secret bomb and took out her weapon.
"What a boring, yet cruel world. But it is precisely because of this that I joined the familia of justice and searched for a ray of light in this dark world." Kaguya looked upwards, her eyes filled with undisguised murderous intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Kaenseki Explosion
chapters.content:
"Are there so many people in Orario who want us to disappear?"
Ryuu pursed her lips tightly, with a complicated expression on her face.
As the purest and most fragile one among the four, her heart was a mess, with all kinds of thoughts intertwined together, making her feel extremely entangled and confused.
Are there really so many people in this bustling city of Orario who are hoping that they will disappear?
The LV. 3 member of the Evilus waved his hand and shouted to the other members, "Go! Kill them and you will get the god's wish!"
Following this shout, like a surging black wave, the members of Evilus responded in unison, "Oh oh oh!!!"
Their faces were distorted, revealing expressions of extreme ferocity and madness, and they rushed towards Akira and the girls like hungry wolves pouncing on their prey.
At the same time, the LV. 3 man hiding in the back quietly abandoned his teammates and rode his tamed monster quickly away towards the road that Jura had just left.
At this moment, his heart was constantly roaring.
"Only idiots would believe those nonsense said by the gods!!"
He cursed in his heart, staring nervously at the red gems in the passage ahead, and anxiously urged the monster under him, "Can you go faster? You are such an idiot!"
Looking at the attacking members of Evilus, Akira and the others entered combat mode. Normally, before charging, the mages and Ryuu would first launch a wave of AOE output.
But now there are many Kaensekis buried around, and they can't cast magic, so they can only use melee weapons to fight against the Evilus.
Time was running out, so Alise and the others showed no mercy when facing these Evilus members who were at most Lv. 1 adventurers.
Akira was seen moving as fast as lightning, holding tightly in his hand the one-handed sword that was flashing with cold light.
He swung his sword violently, and where the sword flashed, a member of Evilus didn't even have time to react, and he was split in half along with the sword.
Then, Akira raised his left hand high, and powerful magic power instantly surged in his palm.
In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen extremely sharp ice spears suddenly rose from the ground, piercing straight through the bodies of the enemies with fierce momentum.
The Evilus members who were pinned to the spot by the ice spears let out sharp screams. The blood flowing from their wounds was frozen by the extremely cold ice spears before it could even flow out.
Such a horrifying scene frightened the Evilus members who had originally intended to bypass Akira and attack Alise and the others, and they stopped in their tracks.
When they turned in horror to look at the captain whose strength had reached Level 3, they were shocked to find that he had disappeared long ago.
Seeing their captain disappear and the enemy's moves stay equally terrifying, the morale of the Evilus members plummeted.
The idea of ​​defeat and escape began to spread in their minds.
Jura, riding on the giant snake monster, reached the exit of the 26th floor in just a few minutes and looked at the Kaensekis lined up one by one.
"It's over, everyone from the Astraea familia."
With a wild smile on his face, he took out a flaming magic sword and swung it forward. The moment the flame touched the Kaenseki, sparks flew and the fire spread rapidly.
In the blink of an eye, the originally silent Kaensekis were ignited one after another, and they began to bloom with dazzling brilliance like brilliant fireworks.
Immediately afterwards, a series of earth-shaking explosions occurred.
Sponsored by the Chamber of Commerce and Evilus, tons of flammable and explosive Kaensekis were quietly buried around the expedition team.
The real trap this time is not the secret factions and mercenaries, they are just a group of tools.
The most important thing is to stop the expedition team at a designated location. The reason why the Lv. 3 captain revealed the mastermind behind the conspiracy was to delay time.
The Kaensekis thrown by the group running around in the passage were like fuses that repeatedly caught fire and exploded, shattering every passage.
The monsters in the cave were burned by the flames, and the melted crystal pillars were gradually washed away by the destructive vortex.
....
"!?"
"What's going on? What's the situation now?!"
"The ground collapsed?!"
"Run, run!"
The explosion spanned two floors, and the loud noise was also heard by some adventurers on the 25th floor.
The crystal walls were blown away, the ground exploded, the ceiling collapsed, and the water flow lost its order and flooded.
The 25th floor, which has a multi-layered structure, was gradually collapsing as if it had lost its support.
The force of this impact was also transmitted to Akira, Alise and others who were still on the next floor.
The dazzling explosion flashed in everyone's eyes, but Akira's pupils did not show any negative emotions when Alise and the others were about to inject magic power into the magic items.
In an instant, Akira's hair turned snow-white, his red eyes were filled with cold absolute rationality, and he pressed his hands suddenly, and the power of ice gushed out.
Only a few crisp "crackling" sounds were heard, and the ground quickly solidified. Ice walls appeared out of thin air around them and wrapped up all the members of the expedition team, forming a huge ice ball.
Then, chains of ice flashing with cold light suddenly shot out from the inside of the ice ball and wrapped around everyone like nimble snakes, firmly fixing them in place.
As long as you enter this big sphere formed by the power of ice, no matter what kind of attack comes from outside, it will not affect the people inside in the slightest.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The violent explosion was even more terrifying than Evilus had expected. The shock wave and heat wave blew to pieces all the Evilus members closest to the explosion.
The entire underground city seemed to be hit by a magnitude 13 earthquake, and the violent shaking seemed like the end of the world.
"Hahahaha! It's a success." Jura felt the huge vibration and shouted excitedly.
However, seeing that the collapsed crack was getting closer and closer to him and others, he stopped talking nonsense and quickly left with his men.
The Kaenseki has extremely high explosive power. Once it explodes, the power is astonishing. The explosion is extremely powerful, but it ends quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 137: The Dungeon's Immune Response
chapters.content:
At this time, the surging heat wave was gradually dissipating, the previous violent vibrations were slowly subsiding, and the sound of collapse came from a distance.
The solid ground where the expedition team was originally located had now turned into a huge hole with a diameter of nearly 100 meters.
Not only that, the nearby caves around the hole were also not spared, and each one became riddled with holes and in ruins.
The walls were covered with dense cracks, some of which were even several meters wide, as if they would collapse at any time.
In the midst of this mess, the huge ice ball controlled by Akira was not greatly affected.
Driven by Akira's thoughts, it slowly melted away and finally turned into a stream of water.
All members of the expedition team were safe and sound in this thrilling explosion.
However, because the ground beneath their feet was completely blown up, everyone lost their support and was caught off guard. They fell straight down from the 26th floor to the 27th, where Amphisbaena was.
"Is everyone okay?"
"That was a close call, Akira, you are awesome."
"It's a trap. They actually want to destroy us with so many bombs. What a scary guy."
The voices of the familia members could be heard from all around.
...
"Huh?!!!"
Ouranos stood up from the throne with a serious look on his face.
In the stone space that looked like an underground temple, four torches set up beside the altar emitted red light. In the center of the altar dominated by the dim darkness, Ouranos opened his pale eyes.
"What's wrong, Ouranos?"
Fels felt the immovable old god standing up, so he sent him a message.
Ouranos paused for a moment, then spoke with a heavy heart, "Something is wrong in the dungeon, something is hatching..."
"Something? What do you mean? What are you talking about, Ouranos?!"
Perhaps sensing the unusual aura of the old god, Fels asked a little impatiently.
Ouranos squinted his eyes and looked down at his feet.
Looking down at the underground world (dungeon) spreading out below, he answered to the crystal, "I don't know, I can only feel that an unknown monster is being born..."
"Monster?!"
Ouranos solemnly declared to the speechless Fels, "The disaster is coming..."
Ouranos listened to the sounds coming from the dungeon and told Fels in a sad voice.
"The defensive instinct triggered by excessive damage... That is the cry of the dungeon that even my prayers cannot reach."
If you simply destroy the structure of the dungeon, it will not cause any reaction. Every time the dungeon is damaged, it will start to repair itself in order to regenerate. The power is so sufficient that adventurers call it [Infinite Resource].
However, once someone carries out an act that makes it too late for the dungeon to regenerate... no, it is an act of excessive destruction.
Then, the dungeon will no longer regenerate, but will start eliminating the "cause".
If we use living things to describe it, it will be easy to understand.
Just like humans, when the body is attacked by foreign objects, the immune function will be activated to eliminate the invading pathogens (viruses).
Of course, all living things have this self-defense instinct.
The same goes for the dungeon.
As a dungeon that can produce monsters, it is alive. When it is attacked excessively, this living underground maze will play its self-defense instinct and give birth to that...
Giving birth to that being that is equivalent to an immune response.
Give birth to apostles to remove foreign objects such as adventurers who invade the body (dungeon).
Back to Akira, everyone landed safely after having a thrilling experience. Everyone was gasping for breath with lingering fear, but soon focused their attention on the huge and deep hole above their heads.
Alise raised her head, looked up at the shocking hole in the ceiling, and said solemnly, "What a horrible attack, these damn Evilus."
Kaguya also had a look of disgust on her face.
She frowned and gritted her teeth and said, "Ah, I didn't expect that they would even raise such a thing."
At this time, Akira stood there calmly, listening to the discussions of the girls around him.
Just as he was about to say something, he suddenly felt his body shake violently.
"What happened again? Is it... an earthquake?" Lyra reacted quickly and noticed.
You know, in this mysterious labyrinth, any tiny vibration is often a harbinger of some abnormal state to come.
Alise didn't dare to delay for even a second. She made a prompt decision and shouted at the top of her voice, "Everyone, hurry up and evacuate the bottom of this hole!"
Hearing Alise's cry, the members of the expedition came back to their senses as if awakened from a dream, and then ran as fast as possible towards the cave leading to the 28th floor that was covered by tree roots.
Akira grabbed Maryuu and Celty in each hand and held them between his waist and quickly followed everyone's pace.
As they ran desperately, the vibrations around them became more and more intense, as if the entire dungeon was shaking.
At the same time, bursts of low and faint roars were heard from a distance, the sound was deafening, it seemed that the monsters in the two adjacent floors were rushing towards here frantically.
Then, a sharp, piercing, and creepy cry resounded throughout the space.
"Ahhh!!!"
The huge maze buried deep underground was like a living being being tortured, crying out in pain.
It was as if a knife was ruthlessly cutting through a silver string stretched to its limit, producing an extraordinary, inorganic, high-pitched melody.
This extremely sharp sound has unparalleled penetrating power. It is powerful enough to easily penetrate people's fragile eardrums and physically drill into the depths of the brain.
The undoubted "crying" of the dungeon made every girl present frown involuntarily.
They instinctively covered their ears with their hands, but even so, the horrible sound still followed them like a shadow, madly attacking their nerve endings.
At this moment, the light around, which had seemed a little dim, suddenly began to flicker and quickly turned into a dazzling red light.
The red light illuminated the surroundings, making it seem as if one was in purgatory, terrifying and depressing.
In Akira's perception, the intricate lines crisscrossed like blood vessels connecting countless lives. These lines were the veins that stored the vast amount of magic power in the dungeon.
The magic power began to gather, like a waterfall falling straight down and like a flood spreading across the sky.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Akira VS Juggernaut
chapters.content:
At this time, the magic power of this part of the dungeon had been drained, and no new monsters would be born here during this period.
All the power of the dungeon was used to create a singular monster.
The huge amount of magic power in the dungeon was used to incarnate it, allowing it to be born in a very short time.
A crackling sound entered everyone's ears. Through the broken hole, they could see a disgusting purple liquid gushing out from the wide, long, and deep crack on the ceiling of the 26th floor.
Something emitted high-temperature steam, and a huge blue-purple claw stretched out from the crack, just like tearing its own uterus apart, brutal and terrifying.
First the claws, then the head, the ominous crimson eyes, like the cold-blooded eyes of a goat, the new monster was slowly emerging from the cracks.
It was a large monster that was three meters tall, but it had long and thin arms.
It's legs were also slender, but their abnormal reverse joint structure was chilling.
That body had no muscles, only dark bones, covered with an armored shell, wrapped in an incredible blue-purple glow.
A sharp tail over four meters long extended from the waist, and on the head of the skeleton were two empty eye sockets that flashed a bloody red light.
It was like a dinosaur fossil wearing armor.
The Juggernaut was created specifically to destroy foreign objects that destroy dungeons.
The Juggernaut fell straight down from the crack and hit the place where Akira was standing, and the crack was slowly closing.
It turned its head, and the pupils of the man and the beast met.
The Juggernaut roared, and the sound was like the strange chirping of cicadas or the howling of a banshee, extremely penetrating and creepy.
In an instant, everyone present felt a powerful oppressive force coming towards them.
Their bodies seemed to be cast under a spell and became stiff for a moment, unable to move at all.
At the same time, a strong desire to escape arose involuntarily in the depths of everyone's heart, as if they were facing an irresistible disaster.
The duration of this state seemed to vary from person to person and was closely related to the individual's strength.
Apart from Akira, even the strongest of the girls, Alise, had a momentary flaw.
If it was on the battlefield, everyone would surely die.
Just after Akira gently put down the two delicate girls and exchanged a hostile look with Juggernaut.
In an instant, the huge black monster turned into a pitch-black line and crossed a distance of several hundred meters in the blink of an eye, rushing in front of Akira.
Almost at the same time, the monster quickly raised its huge and ferocious claws.
The sharp claws swung with lightning speed, and the three slender and sharp fingertips were like three sharp swords, stabbing straight into Akira's chest.
Akira seemed to know in advance where the Juggernaut's attack would be. Just when the three slender fingertips were about to touch his chest, he suddenly raised his right arm, and the powerful ice power in his body surged out instantly.
In the blink of an eye, five thick and solid ice shields appeared out of thin air. Each shield flashed a freezing blue light. Layer upon layer, they intertwined together to form a huge ice wall with a diameter of two meters, standing firmly in front of Akira.
At the same time, Akira's left hand did not stop at all. He stretched it back without hesitation. With a low roar, even more powerful and vast ice power gushed out from his palm.
The continuously surging ice quickly condensed into a huge glacier and swept towards the rear.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on novel✶fire.net
In the blink of an eye, a 22-meter-high glacier froze all of Alise and the others in the cave entrance leading to the 28th floor.
Bang!
A crisp and loud sound rang out.
A large amount of broken ice splashed before his eyes, and the Juggernaut's claws penetrated Akira's first three layers of ice shield.
That was an ice wall that even Amphisbaena could hardly break with brute force, but unexpectedly, the Juggernaut did it so easily.
Although the ice shield blocked its attack, the impact force penetrated Akira's hand that was pressed on the ice wall.
Even though the impact was reduced several times, the violent impact still caused Akira to take several steps back, and his back finally hit the huge glacier that had just condensed in his left hand.
When Alise and everyone else broke free from their fear, they saw that the Juggernaut's speed was so great that even their naked eye could only see a blurry afterimage.
Before they could react and use their swords to block the attack, the glacier had already blocked their way. At this moment, they were extremely anxious, and their hearts were filled with endless worry and fear.
It was not until they saw through the crystal clear ice that Akira successfully resisted the Juggernaut's fierce attack that everyone felt as if a heavy burden had been suddenly unloaded and they breathed a sigh of relief.
It wasn't over yet. The extremely sharp tail, which was over four meters long, swung suddenly, and like lightning, it nimbly avoided the ice shield cast by Akira and smashed towards his left shoulder.
Squeak—
Accompanied by a sharp sound, at the critical moment, Akira only had time to instantly attach an armor to the center of his arm.
In a hurry, he could only raise his arms hastily and try his best to block the fierce attack.
However, the huge impact force still caused him to stagger several steps to the right involuntarily before he could barely steady himself.
There was only a slight "crack" sound. Although Akira had tried his best, his forearm bones still could not withstand such a strong force, and there seemed to be a slight cracking sound.
Then, Akira's magic power surged again. A huge ice cone with a width of three meters condensed rapidly at an astonishing speed under his control.
Then, the icicle emitting biting cold air rushed straight towards the Juggernaut like an arrow shot from a bow and hit the opponent's body hard.
After a loud bang, the Juggernaut was knocked away by this powerful force and fell heavily to the ground in the distance.
Although Akira didn't know what kind of monster the Juggernaut was at this time, he found out from the attack of just one icicle that this icicle could actually cause the enemy's armor shell to fly into pieces and be covered with cracks.
Akira realized from the attack and defense at this moment that the enemy had extraordinary [Strength] and [Agility], but it's [Endurance] and [Defense] were significantly low.

chapters.title: Chapter 139 139: Astraea Familia's Powerlessness
chapters.content:
Whoever attacks first wins!
As Akira shouted, a huge and hideous thorny ice ball suddenly appeared in front of him.
At the same time, he slapped out his palm without hesitation and hit the thorny ice ball hard.
There was a loud bang, and the ice ball suddenly exploded, turning into dozens of extremely sharp flying blades, like a group of ferocious falcons, roaring straight towards the Juggernaut.
The knocked-away Juggernaut grabbed the ground with both claws, and a deep gash was easily cut on the ground as if cutting butter with a hot knife.
It's limbs landed steadily on the ground, and then, as if it realized the danger approaching, it subconsciously mobilized all the magic power in its body, causing the blue-purple shell that covered its body surface to begin to emit light.
In the blink of an eye, the attack had already hit Juggernaut's body.
However, something unexpected happened. Under the effect of the Juggernaut's Magic Reflection feature, the attacks changed direction and counterattacked towards Akira at a faster speed.
'Can it also reflect magic?'Akira thought to himself, and raised his hand slightly, and the returning ice attack dissipated instantly.
Once again, the Juggernaut demonstrated its astonishingly fast movement ability. It flashed in front of Akira, waving its sharp claws at a tricky angle.
Not only that, its sharp mouth also opened slightly, revealing a row of cold sharp teeth, and it was obviously ready to pounce on Akira if its attack failed.
Akira took a stance with both feet and stood firmly on the spot. A huge ice sword appeared out of thin air in his right hand, and then he swung it towards the Juggernaut's claws, and the two collided fiercely.
Clang!
As the claws were bounced away, Akira leaned to the left.
Seeing that it's claws were ineffective, the Juggernaut immediately opened its bloody mouth, revealing rows of sharp fangs and bit towards Akira.
However, an identical ice sword appeared out of thin air. Akira swung the ice sword in his left hand violently, slashing it from bottom to top at the Juggernaut's chin.
With another loud "bang", the Juggernaut's chin was hit hard, and the armored shell on its body shattered instantly, with debris flying all over the ground.
After suffering two consecutive blows, the Juggernaut became furious, but it had to give up the attack. It swung its hind legs, stomped the ground hard, and used the force to jump rapidly to the rear.
Then, climbing on the wall like a gecko, it observed Akira for a few seconds, uttered a short inorganic roar, and stepped on the wall with its limbs, breaking the rocks and raising a cloud of dust.
It shot out with a fierce shock wave. When it approached Akira, it swung its claws and long tail, tearing everything around it into pieces.
Before the attack could land, Akira overlapped the two ice swords in his hands. Under the influence of the power of ice, their shape changed, and an axe appeared.
He took a step forward, twisted his body, and chopped the huge axe fiercely on the attacking claws of the Juggernaut.
The man and the beast were in a stalemate for only a few seconds before both were bounced away by the impact.
However, Akira did not intend to pause at all. He quickly aimed the giant axe in his hand at the monster and threw it out with force.
And the Juggernaut was not to be outdone. It swung its thick and powerful tail flexibly, like a whistling steel whip, and collided head-on with the oncoming giant axe.
It glanced at the giant axe that was smashed open by its tail. It had no way to deal with these things that were harder than its own shell.
Then, two ice swords appeared in Akira's hands again. He rushed towards the enemy, twisted his upper body violently, and swung out a double-swinging attack with his two swords.
Clang... Clang... Clang...
The weapons of both parties collided with each other more than a dozen times, and during one of the collisions, the fingertips of one of the Juggernaut's forelimbs were broken.
'Sure enough, it's physical strength is gradually weakening.' Akira thought as he looked at the left limb with only two claws left.
Inside the glacier, as Akira's battle became farther and farther away, Alise and the others could only see two blurry figures colliding with each other and then separating.
Watching Akira fighting the powerful monster alone, in just a few minutes, Alise and the others' hearts beat like a roller coaster.
Sometimes it hung high up to the throat, and sometimes it fell heavily to the bottom of the valley.
Every time a collision sounded, their hearts would beat violently. Every time figures flashed by, their breathing would involuntarily become rapid.
If they weren't worried that rushing out rashly would not only fail to help but also cause trouble for Akira, the crowd, led by Alise, wanted to use their most powerful magic immediately to blow the glacier in front of them into pieces.
Fortunately, they finally saw that the claws of the monster seemed to be broken, which made them realize that Akira's attack was effective against the monster.
This discovery made Alise and the others' tense nerves relax a little, and they all let out a long breath of air that had been held in their throats for a long time.
But at the same time, they began to show frustration on their faces.
They already knew how powerful Akira was. But seeing that he was able to deal with such a powerful monster alone with ease and even gain the upper hand, and they didn't even have the qualifications to fight alongside him, a feeling of powerlessness arose spontaneously, and the mood that had been slightly relieved due to Akira's advantage became heavy again.
Iska punched the wall and said with an unwilling look on her face, "Damn it, if I had known I would encounter something like this I should have tried harder."
"It's okay." Neze walked over, patted Iska's shoulder, and comforted her.
"There's no point worrying now. We have to work harder in the future. Next time we encounter a situation like this, we will definitely be able to help."
Although Neze said this, her eyes also revealed a hint of loneliness.
Obviously, she felt the same as Iska, feeling extremely frustrated about her own powerlessness at the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 140: Juggernaut Tests Friendly Fire
chapters.content:
Alise stood aside, frowning slightly, watching the battle in the distance, and said softly, "All we can do now is to believe in Akira and cheer for him silently."
"As for the other things, let's wait until this battle is over and reflect on them. We can't let ourselves be so useless again."
After hearing what Alise said, the others all nodded. Although they were still filled with resentment and frustration, they could only turn this emotion into motivation for future efforts.
They looked forward to the day when they could truly stand with Akira and face those powerful enemies together.
Ais also felt the same way as she listened to the girls discussing how to become stronger. Just as she was about to join in, she felt a vibration coming from the cave.
Under the control of the dungeon, some monsters swarmed out from the 28th floor and poured into the entrance of the 28th floor.
They would work with the Juggernaut to kill the "foreign objects" that cause excessive damage to the dungeon.
Ais pulled out her weapon from behind and said, "Alise, a monster has appeared. "
"Okay, I understand...Everyone! It seems that we can still do something to help Akira." Alise said with a cheerful look.
The girls stood up murderously, their hearts filled with the desire to vent.
Looking at the monsters appearing before them, they had only one goal in mind.
"I won't let you disturb Akira's battle." X12
...
A bunch of blue crabs, mermaids, mermans and other monsters from the Water City poured out from another cave.
Akira, holding two swords, used his magic power to sweep and found out that Alise and the others were also fighting monsters behind him.
And these monsters are obviously the Juggernaut's teammates.
But in this vast battlefield, these monsters were killed by others.
The crystal urchin was held by the Juggernau with one hand, and then in the face of sharp claws and power, it's body covered with spikes suddenly burst like a watermelon.
Some clever mermaids and mermans saw that the situation was not right and tried to turn around and escape.
But would the Juggernaut let them go easily? It flashed and approached the monsters that were trying to escape as fast as lightning.
The bloody mouth full of sharp teeth bit several mermaid heads, and only a creepy sound of bones breaking was heard.
At the same time, its claws drew an arc in the air, accurately hitting the bodies of other monsters.
Accompanied by several shrill screams, the monsters' bodies were instantly cut into several pieces.
The magic stone fell to the ground, and the Juggernaut picked it up and threw it into its mouth, just like it was eating a biscuit, with a crunching sound.
The red pupils that had begun to dim seemed to return to emitting red light.
"Can it strengthen its abilities by devouring magic stones? Or..." Akira speculated as he stayed where he was and watched the scene.
In just one minute, all the newly appeared monsters were slaughtered by the Juggernaut like fragile ants.
It slowly turned around and looked at Akira. Although it didn't understand why the "foreign object" in front of it gave it time to recover, it didn't care what Akira thought. It just wanted to tear the guy in front of it into pieces and then slaughter all the "foreign objects" behind it.
With a dull thud, Juggernaut exerted force suddenly, and crushed the solid ground beneath its feet.
Using the recoil force, it rushed towards Akira like a cannonball.
At the same time, its right claw flashed with cold light and slashed down diagonally, bringing up a gust of fierce wind.
Facing the Juggernaut's fierce attack, Akira remained calm.
After successfully resisting the attack, Akira twisted his body and cleverly resolved the impact to the right.
Then, the ice sword in his hand swept across quickly, hitting the vital part of the Juggernaut's head with its bone-chilling coldness.
The ice sword chopped towards its head with lightning speed, but it reacted and ducked down to avoid it, so only the horn on its head was chopped off.
With its body damaged again, the Juggernaut swung its tail to hit Akira.
The two ice swords overlapped to block its tail. Akira was knocked back more than ten meters.
As it flew away, Akira suddenly realized.
"No, it's getting weaker and weaker. It doesn't seem to be getting stronger at all. Sure enough, this is not the reason why it swallowed the magic stone."
The sharp claws hit the ice sword, and the impact made Akira realize that the Juggernaut had not become stronger.
Since Akira had already studied most of the Juggernaut's characteristics and weaknesses.
Akira tightly grasped the ice sword with both hands, exerted force suddenly, and threw it towards the Juggernaut.
The ice sword drew two cold rays of light in the air and flew towards the target like a meteor.
Then, Akira had an idea, a breeze blew, and his class changed again.
After dodging two ice swords, the Juggernaut, who was about to chase Akira, suddenly stopped and looked at the place where he had just stood in confusion.
It has a sensory network given to it by the dungeon, and as long as the target is still in the dungeon, it cannot escape its pursuit.
However, now it had become unaware of the cold "foreign object" just now.
Its red eyes quietly observed the surroundings, not missing any corner.
Whoosh—
There seemed to be a slight sound of wind quietly ringing around.
With a loud "bang", it felt its armored abdomen being severely shattered and the outer shell fell off.
It was pushed into the air by a force far exceeding that of the initial icicle, causing it to let out a scream.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 141: Juggernaut's End
chapters.content:
Unable to perform any effective movements in the air, the Juggernaut could only desperately shake its head to look around, with its tail ready to pierce the enemy.
Another gust of wind sounded. It's instincts were screaming, and its vigilance was at its highest level.
But it was totally useless!
As an unstoppable bombardment force came from the armored shell on the back, with a crack, the shell was covered with cracks and shattered from the back.
At the same time, it smashed towards the ground at an even faster speed, shattering the rocks, forming a hole and blowing up a cloud of dust.
As the armored shells on its body were shattered, the Juggernaut's vitality was rapidly decreasing. If it didn't swallow a magic stone, even without Akira's intervention, it would die within a dozen minutes.
Just as it got up and emerged from the dust, a whistling gust of wind passed by and the joint of its left forelimb was broken.
Without having time to think about where the attack came from, the Juggernaut instinctively used its remaining limbs to run towards the cave where the monsters came from.
It was running away staggeringly and in a panic, but its speed was no longer as great as at the beginning, and it might even be slower than Lyra.
Akira, whose figure slowly appeared in the strong wind, looked at this scene and made a bow-holding gesture in mid-air.
The Juggernaut turned its head suddenly, and it's red pupils reflected the young man holding the wind bow and pulling the bowstring to the full.
The silver gale was condensing into a giant spinning arrow.
"Die."
The next moment, Akira let go of the bowstring.
A giant silver arrow came in front of the Juggernaut as if it had crossed another dimension.
The giant arrow seemed to be reflected in the Juggernaut's red pupils which were beginning to dim, and it... couldn't react.
The giant spiral wind arrow pierced through its body, like a nail, embedding itself firmly into its body.
Immediately afterwards, violent force burst out from the giant arrow, dragging the Juggernaut's body all the way towards the wall at the end of the road.
Boom!
The powerful energy exploded the moment it hit the wall, and a terrifying gale erupted wildly in all directions with the explosion point as the center.
Under this powerful force, the Juggernaut's body was blown apart, and its bones were shattered into a large amount of dark purple ashes, which were blown away by the wind.
The strong wind caused by the giant arrow also blew wildly in the cave, and the strong wind made Akira's black hair dance wildly.
Akira stood quietly in mid-air, looking at everything in front of him calmly.
With the complete death of the Juggernaut, the strong wind surrounding Akira slowly dissipated.
He changed his state back to his usual appearance as an elemental blaster. His hair, which originally had a dazzling silver sheen, gradually turned back to ink-black and fell softly on his shoulders.
The violent wind that was originally surging under his feet also quietly dissipated at this moment.
Akira, suspended in the air, slowly and lightly fell toward the ground, steady and graceful.
At this time, the glacier that was once controlled by the power of ice disappeared as Akira's ice power was withdrawn.
Not only did it begin to show signs of melting, but its originally indestructible properties were also slowly disappearing.
A slight "tick-tick" sound began to be heard from inside the glacier. It was the sound of ice melting into water droplets, as if playing the final chapter of this thrilling battle.
Akira casually opened his panel and saw that his level did not seem to have changed. It was still 37. It seemed that the Juggernaut didn't cause him much trouble.
Akira sighed softly, turned around and walked towards Alise and the others.
After a fierce battle, Alise and the others who were trapped at the exit of the 28th floor finally successfully ended the battle with the monsters.
Almost at the same time, she also saw Akira in the distance ending his "hard battle" with the Juggernaut.
Alise panted slightly, her eyes sparkling with excitement. She turned to look at her companions and said loudly, "Everyone, step back a few steps!"
Upon hearing this, everyone quickly stepped back. After creating a safe distance, Alise raised her shining sword with both hands.
She closed her eyes slightly and began to chant quickly.
As the chanting ended, her body gradually began to glow with a layer of scorching flames, emitting billowing heat waves that baked the surrounding air blazingly hot.
After a moment, Alise suddenly opened her eyes.
In an instant, scorching flames madly wrapped around the sword in her hand, and then she slammed the sword towards the glacier in front of her.
When fire and ice collided violently, there was a sizzling sound and a large amount of water vapor was instantly created, forming a white mist that enveloped everything around.
Suddenly, with a dull "bang" sound, the flame containing Alise's powerful magic successfully shattered the glacier.
Under the influence of the impact, huge blocks of ice splashed in all directions like cannonballs, colliding with each other and making crisp sounds.
Akira gently raised his hand and waved it in the air, and a strong gust of wind blew in instantly.
The strong wind quickly blew away the sultry steam, and the fog gradually dissipated, revealing the figures of Alise and the others.
Alise and the others rushed out of the exit happily and saw Akira standing not far away.
Akira had a smile on his face, raised his right hand high and made a "yeah" gesture with his fingers.
"Akira!"
The girls excitedly rushed towards the boy who touched their hearts.
In the blink of an eye, Akira was surrounded by them. They were touching him all over, their eyes full of worry and concern.
Akira reached out and grabbed the brown hand that was touching his "weak spot", and looked helplessly at the face that pretended to be calm and expressionless.
He muttered to himself, 'Do you want to seriously check if I am injured, or take advantage of me?'
Shinji transmigrated to the Naruto world with no cheats. To ensure his safety, he became a teacher at Ninja School.
Finally, when he met the two protagonists, Naruto and Sasuke, the Strongest Teacher System activated. He can be rewarded by teaching and educating people.
[Detected that Naruto is willing to establish a master-disciple relationship.]
[Reward: Wind Release Nature Transformation (Extraordinary), Yang Chakra (Proficient)]
[Detected that Sasuke is willing to establish a master-disciple relationship.]
[Reward: Yin-Yang Scroll (Basic), Detection (Extraordinary)]
[Class Completed, Calculating...]
[Overall Rating: A]
[Reward: Chakra Perception (Proficient), All Stats +5, Chakra +500]
After this, the original trajectory of the Ninja world gradually deviated.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Akira Has Become Even More Popular
chapters.content:
"Are you hurt?" Maryuu looked worried and expressed her concern immediately.
"Akira, well done!"
"That monster really scared me. We couldn't tell its speed at all."
"That's right, if I were in front of it, I would have been dead long ago. Just one claw would have killed me." Noin said with a smile.
Neze asked curiously, "So where is the body of the monster?"
Alise hugged Akira gently, pressed her cheek against his, and whispered, "I'm sorry, Akira, I couldn't fight alongside you."
There was a hint of guilt in her voice, as if she felt extremely guilty for not facing danger with Akira.
"If it weren't for you this time, we might not have been able to return safely." Kaguya's face showed a rare tenderness, and she reached out and gently stroked Akira.
Akira was about to respond to Maryuu that he was not injured, but a bunch of questions came at him overwhelmingly, coupled with Alise's sudden hug, which caught him off guard.
He patted Alise's back gently to comfort her, and then said helplessly, "Stop, stop, stop, you have too many questions. I don't know which one to answer first."
There was a hint of smile in Akira's voice. It was obvious that he was not annoyed by being questioned by everyone. Instead, he enjoyed the care and concern among his companions.
After hearing Akira's words, Alise finally reacted and let go of him somewhat embarrassedly.
Her cheeks flushed slightly and a hint of shyness flashed in her eyes, as if she was embarrassed by her impulsive behavior just now.
Akira then added, "Also, don't forget that I am a member of the Astraea familia. Why are you all so polite?"
In his heart, everyone has long been a close family who shares life and death.
After that, Akira began to answer everyone's questions. "My arm was slightly injured, but it's really not a big deal."
Maryuu and Ryuu chanted recovery magic, pulled up Akira's arm and began to heal him.
"Noin, don't talk about death so casually."
Hearing this, Noin stuck out her tongue mischievously, with a playful smile on her face, as if she was acting coquettishly and admitting her mistake to Akira.
"As for the corpse, look, that pile of blue-purple ashes is it." Akira pointed at the snow-like dust piled up at the exit.
The crowd gathered around the "wreckage" with curiosity, their eyes full of confusion and curiosity.
Ryuu took out her wooden sword and scraped the ashes a few times, and asked in confusion, "Doesn't this monster have a magic stone?"Discover more novels at N0veI.Fiɾe.net
"Yes, but these ashes are magic stones. It seems that it's entire body is made of magic stones." Akira explained.
Akira took out a bag and put some of Juggernauth's ashes in it as evidence that excessive destruction of the dungeon would lead to the emergence of new monsters.
"Let's go. We have to keep going. I wonder if there are any Evilus members that have escaped yet."
On the way, Akira also told them about the Juggernaut's attack methods and weaknesses.
The most terrifying thing about the Juggernaut is its speed.
With its amazing maneuverability, it is so fast that it is difficult to catch when the battle begins.
Ordinary hand-to-hand combat cannot touch it at all, and even powerful magic can hardly cause damage to it in the first confrontation.
It even has the potential to wipe out a team of first-class adventurers, so it can be said to be a symbol of death.
In general, at the beginning of the battle, it exhibits the terrifying characteristics of full attack speed, full magic counter, and armor penetration, but its health bar is relatively short, its physical defense is also low, and it does not have the ability of long-range attack and area damage.
Of course, it is not invulnerable.
Just find the right moment in close combat to break its legs and prevent it from making high-speed jumps.
Then smash its shell to prevent it from reflecting magic, then bombard it with explosives to defeat it.
In this case, the Juggernaut's life would be like a candle in the wind and it would be defeated by Alise and the others sooner or later.
Akira and his companions followed the winding passage and returned to the shocking large hole on the 26th floor.
Everyone's eyes fell on the ground that was slowly recovering, and their hearts were filled with emotion.
This place was bombed to pieces, with nothing left but some weapons left to prove that Evilus had appeared.
Who could have thought that they would dare to choose to ignite the Kaensekis and end their lives in such a decisive way?
They searched the ruins carefully, leaving no corner untouched, but in the end, they found nothing.
With no other choice, they could only speed up their pace and break through upwards.
Along the way, everyone remained vigilant and did not miss any suspicious signs, but until they reached the safe floor, they did not find any trace of Evilus.
The time had quietly come to ten o'clock in the evening, and everyone dragged their exhausted bodies to the safe floor on the 18th floor.
Akira and his companions were finally able to clean the blood off their bodies, allowing them to rest in peace as they were extremely exhausted both mentally and physically.
At night, a warm campfire burned brightly in the open field, and the jumping flames illuminated the girls' curious faces.
In this relaxed and joyful atmosphere, the girls surrounded Akira and shouted at him to tell them about the battle with the Juggernaut.
Akira couldn't resist the enthusiasm of the crowd, so he had to speak slowly. He vividly described every detail, from the sudden attack by the Juggernaut, to gradually figuring out its weaknesses, to finally successfully defeating it.
After he finished speaking, the admiration in the girls' eyes became stronger, and their enthusiasm for Akira became a little extreme.
They chirped and gathered around Akira, their eyes revealing admiration.
Akira was a little overwhelmed by this sudden enthusiasm. He could only cheer himself up and respond to everyone's friendly actions with a smile.
He thought silently in his heart, 'Pay attention to your image, girls.'
That night, Akira spent a unique night surrounded by girls, enjoying the warmth and beauty in their arms.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 143 143: A "Wonderful" Sleep
chapters.content:
The next morning, soft sunlight filtered through the gaps in the tent like strands of golden gauze, casting a gentle glow upon Akira's face.
He slowly awoke, his mind groggy and disoriented. A lingering unease haunted him—he had dreamt of being torn limb from limb by five wild horses. The memory of that nightmare made his scalp tingle.
Still half-asleep and murmuring to himself, Akira suddenly became aware of an unbearable weight on his chest, making it hard to breathe.
He froze.
A blonde girl was curled up on top of him, her delicate face flushed with a peaceful rosy hue as she slumbered soundly.
Akira thought, 'Good heavens, it's the blonde loli and she's sleeping directly on top of me?! No wonder I couldn't breathe!'
He let out a soft sigh, both helpless and resigned.
Of course I couldn't breathe...
Hoping to shift a bit, Akira attempted to move his right hand to ease the pressure. However, the moment he twitched his fingers, he was met with an unusual softness.
Startled, he turned his head slightly to the right and his eyes shot open wide in disbelief.
The Amazonesses lived up to their reputation of being fiery and uninhibited. Iska was hugging his right arm like it was her favorite pillow, clutching it with reckless abandon.
His arm had somehow slipped through the opening of her bra-like top. Her firm grip locked his arm in place, and the back of his hand was pressed intimately against her toned abdomen.
Gulping nervously, Akira then shifted his gaze to his left hand. Though the situation on that side wasn't as dramatic, he could still feel something soft resting against his palm.
And after a quick mental comparison... he concluded that the touch on his left was even softer than that of Iska's.
Well, she is the proud third-ranking member of the familia.
He thought, conflicted between awe and despair.
It didn't stop there. Akira then realized his head was nestled against someone's soft, warm belly.
Curious and fearful, he dared to turn his head further to the right. What greeted him was a pair of abundant, ample breasts that suddenly loomed into view, obscuring his entire vision. He couldn't even see beyond them.
At the same time, his legs twitched but found themselves restrained. Someone was holding onto his feet tightly, not letting him move an inch.
Wait a second...!
Akira's brain scrambled to piece things together.
Everyone in this party is a girl! I know there wasn't any "drinking party" last night, after all, there's a loli in the group.
Then why in the world were all of them crammed into this one tent?!
Credits go to Maryuu.
Last night, Maryuu had casually mentioned how comfortable Akira was to sleep on—like a human-sized pillow.
That one statement was like tossing a fireball into a pond of oil. The peaceful camp instantly descended into chaos.
Pandemonium broke out, and amidst the clamor, a scandalous secret was revealed: every girl, excluding Ryuu, had already secretly stolen a kiss from him.
Those confessions were like fuel poured onto an already raging fire, provoking those who hadn't yet "enjoyed" Akira into a jealous frenzy.
In the blink of an eye, the five of them pounced on him without hesitation.
Akira, unable to resist and lacking the courage to refuse, ended up crammed into a single tent with all five girls. As for Ais... he still had no idea when she had slipped in.
And so, this absurd and torturous scene unfolded—with Akira lying in the middle of a feminine pile, his soul nearly leaving his body, utterly devoid of will to live.
Tied down like a prisoner, he didn't dare move an inch. Internally, he cursed them all.
Damn it... once we get back home, I'm eating all of you alive!
— — —
Meanwhile, compared to the dangerous middle and upper floors of the dungeon, the Astraea Familia's return to the surface was a breeze.
However, the moment they exited the dungeon, the girls were met with a surprising sight—Floor 11 had been completely blocked off.
The Guild had taken immediate action following yesterday's tremor. A massive operation was underway, with staff working overtime to address the incident.
None of the Guild members could hide their astonishment. Not a single adventurer had emerged from the dungeon in over twelve hours—until now.
Astraea Familia was the last team to return. Though they were safe, their arrival didn't go unnoticed.
Hidden among the crowd were individuals belonging to evilus—silent observers with malicious intent.
Ever since the tremor had shaken the dungeon yesterday, the Guild had enforced a strict lockdown, cutting off all information. These underhanded supporters were left completely in the dark.
Though they knew Astraea Familia had been dragged into some kind of "experiment," no one would reveal what it actually entailed. The orders were clear—they had no right to know.
Since then, not a single member of evilus had returned.
No mercenaries, no scouts. Nothing.
The conspirators began to speculate. Perhaps their people had been attacked by monsters on the way out, or worse, utterly annihilated by Astraea's girls.
And now, seeing the entire Astraea Familia return unscathed... they finally had their answer.
Justice had triumphed once again.
The news spread quickly. The shadows trembled with fury.
In a lavish, dimly lit room somewhere in the city, a portly merchant of considerable wealth stood up with a snarl. His hand, trembling with rage, hurled a porcelain teacup to the floor, where it shattered into pieces.
"Not a single one of them died?!" He roared.
"We invested so much magic stone and firepower! And that damn evilus couldn't even kill one?! A bunch of useless trash!"

chapters.title: Chapter 144 144: Finally Home
chapters.content:
After the news of Astraea Familia's safe return reached the ears of those influential figures secretly backing evilus, restlessness began to ripple through the shadows of Orario.
They understood the stakes far too well. If the truth were to be exposed, their names could be dragged into the light and that would spell disaster.
So, while spitting curses and grumbling about evilus's utter incompetence, these so-called bigwigs hurriedly packed up their belongings. Tails tucked between their legs, they slinked out of Orario in disgrace, hoping to vanish from the public eye until the storm blew over.
— — —
In the bustling streets of Orario, the flow of people surged like an unstoppable tide. In a quiet alley off the main road, Akira and Alise temporarily parted ways.
Akira had to escort Ais home first. She followed beside him obediently, her steps light and silent. Their elongated shadows stretched ahead of them in the afternoon sunlight, dancing gently with each stride.
As they approached their destination, the watchful eyes of the Twilight Manor's gatekeeper immediately picked them out from the crowd.
"Oh? Isn't this Akira and Ais?" The guard called out warmly, his grin wide and familiar. "Haven't seen the two of you for days. So you've finally returned."
Akira gave a polite smile and nodded slightly. "Yes, it's been a few days."
After exchanging a few friendly words, Akira and Ais stepped past the gate and entered the Twilight Manor—their familiar home, now filled with nostalgic warmth.
Standing just outside the main entrance, Akira bent one knee slightly and reached out to gently pat Ais's head, his touch affectionate and sincere.
"This is as far as I go." He said softly. "Ais, you should rest now. You're not allowed to go to the dungeon for the next few days, understand?"
Ais stared up at him, her golden eyes clear and unwavering, without the slightest trace of discontent.
"I understand." She replied with a firm nod.
Akira smiled and handed over a notebook, thick with notes and sketches. "This records the new monsters we encountered. You can pass it to Riveria and the others when you return it."
Just as he was about to turn and leave, Ais paused. A flicker of anticipation danced in her eyes as she extended her arms toward him like a child asking for a hug.
"I want a reward." She said softly, her voice as light and sweet as cotton candy.
Akira blinked.
Huh? Since when was Ais this...adorable?
Was this really the same overly serious Ais he remembered from the anime?
Without hesitation, Akira opened his arms and pulled her into a gentle embrace.
"Haha, someone's acting spoiled again." He chuckled teasingly.
Ais didn't respond. Instead, she leaned into him and rubbed her cheek lightly against his chest, her way of showing both affection and mild protest at his words.
Just as she released him and turned to head inside, a familiar voice called out from behind.
"My, you didn't even tell me you were back. I don't remember teaching you to be this inconsiderate, Ais," came Riveria's voice as she opened the door, her usual composed smile playing on her lips.
The moment she appeared, Ais beamed and rushed straight into her arms.
Akira greeted the elf politely. "It's been a while, Riveria-san. Has anything happened while we were gone?"
Riveria looked at both of them with a glint of surprise in her eyes. "Long time no see, Akira... and Ais." She glanced down affectionately at the girl in her embrace.
Their reunion was brief but warm.
Before long, Akira decided it was time to take his leave. But Riveria's expression softened with reluctance.
"You're leaving already? We've barely spoken for a few minutes." She said gently.
Akira crossed his arms and smiled warmly. "I miss Astraea-sama too, after all. I'll come by again when I have the time."
Understanding lit Riveria's eyes. She nodded with a soft smile. "Alright then. Goodbye."
"Akira, see you next time." Ais peeked out from Riveria's arms, her little hands waving energetically.
Akira turned and waved back. "See you next time—both of you."
With that, he turned and left the Twilight Manor, heading home.
— — —
When Akira arrived and slowly pushed open the heavy door, the familiar scent of home wrapped around him like a gentle breeze. He turned back to lock the door and heard a voice that instantly warmed his heart. A voice that had echoed in his thoughts throughout the entire expedition.
"Welcome back, my child... my pride."
It was Astraea.
Her voice was gentle, elegant, and filled with deep affection. She stood gracefully at the entrance, hands clasped in front of her, her divine beauty bathed in the golden light of the afternoon. That soft, radiant smile on her face—like sunlight breaking through the clouds—welcomed him home.
Akira gently clicked the lock shut, turned around, and walked toward her. Without a word, he opened his arms and embraced her.
Burying his face against her shoulder, he inhaled the comforting scent of her hair, and murmured with heartfelt emotion, "I'm back, goddess."
They held each other quietly, wrapped in the kind of warmth that only distance and longing could deepen.
After a moment, Akira slowly loosened his embrace, took Astraea's hand in his, and together they walked toward the central hall.
As he pushed open the door, the peaceful aftermath of battle revealed itself before them.
The room was filled with the sound of gentle breathing. The girls were scattered around the sofas and lounge chairs, draped across cushions and armrests like sleepy cats.
Some had already dozed off with their limbs splayed in awkward but relaxed positions, while others leaned shoulder-to-shoulder, their chests rising and falling in sync.
A faint chorus of snores filled the room—quiet, rhythmic, oddly comforting.
Looking at them, one couldn't help but feel the exhaustion in the air. Their bodies had clearly reached their limit.
Perhaps it was because they knew they were finally safe. Or maybe it was because this place—this home—allowed them to let their guards down completely.
Nearby, the coat racks and lockers near the door were stacked with maps, enchanted tools, and other remnants from the expedition.
The solid wooden hangers had temporarily become weapon racks, adorned with protective gear, tactical clothing, and a variety of armaments—silver-white one-handed swords, sacred staffs carved from the World tree branches, and sleek Iai blades with crimson-black scabbards.
Everything was strewn about in casual disarray—evidence of warriors returning from battle and collapsing into well-earned rest.
Watching over this tranquil chaos, Astraea's eyes filled with tenderness and love.
She chuckled softly. "It looks like they were really exhausted. They didn't even make it to their rooms."
Akira smiled faintly, his eyes also falling on the peacefully sleeping girls. "A lot happened during this expedition. It's no wonder they're tired."
He let out a soft sigh, voice tinged with emotion.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Akira's Eyes?
chapters.content:
Speaking of which, Akira hadn't paid much attention earlier when he returned home, but now, when his gaze happened to fall on the goddess beside him, he couldn't help but be momentarily stunned.
He had stayed in Astraea's room several times before, and naturally had the chance to peek into her wardrobe—albeit unintentionally.
Nearly all her clothes were long dresses. Flowing, elegant, and ethereal garments, like holy vestments meticulously crafted just for her, accentuating her divine grace, noble temperament, and the mysterious aura that surrounded her.
But now… that elegance had taken a surprising turn.
Astraea wore a knee-length skirt—something rarely seen on her.
Though it was still as pure white as untouched snow, what caught Akira's attention wasn't the color but the dazzling vision now exposed to his line of sight.
Two smooth, flawless legs.
Her delicate skin glowed under the warm light of the hall, radiant and translucent, glowing faintly with a seductive luster. It was impossible not to imagine the scenery hidden above that hemline.
Even her feet, usually concealed beneath flowing skirts, were now in full view. Her dainty, fair feet, wrapped in simple sandals, radiated a soft charm that stirred something deep within. The kind of beauty that was hard to ignore.
Astraea, as if unaware of the effect she was having, gently pulled Akira by the hand and led him to a seat. Her smile carried a hint of playful curiosity.
"Now then, why don't you tell me everything that happened during your expedition?" She said, her eyes twinkling.
"It was your first official one, after all. I'm very curious to hear how our Akira performed out in the field."
They sat close, separated only by the thin blanket draped over the seat. But even that fabric couldn't block the soft, warm sensation of the goddess's presence beside him. Her divine aura was intimate—palpable.
Akira coughed lightly and replied with humility, "I'm afraid I'd disappoint you. I only acted as a supporter during the expedition. On the contrary, Alise and the others were the ones who really shone out there."
"Hmph. As expected of the first familia member personally discovered by me." Astraea replied, amused.
Akira chuckled and added with sincere admiration, "That just proves Astraea-sama's excellent judgment."
Astraea gently flicked her finger against his forehead with a mischievous smile. "Such a sweet tongue you have. But you shouldn't go praising other women in front of me, you know?"
Then her smile deepened slightly, her fingers moving to pinch Akira's cheeks as she narrowed her eyes. "Also, don't forget that I'm a goddess. Lies don't work on someone like me."
"Alright, alright, I'll talk." Akira surrendered quickly, his words muffled as she pulled on his cheeks. "But Astraea-sama, if you're tugging my face like this, how am I supposed to speak properly?!"
Only when she finally released him did Akira begin recounting the expedition's events in detail—from their journey through the middle floors to the unexpected confrontation with evilus on the 26th floor.
He spoke of the Kaenseki's detonation, the dungeon's eerie cry, and the awakening of the monstrosity known as Juggernaut.
As he described how danger loomed and how they'd escaped by a narrow margin, the initial tension in Astraea's expression slowly faded. In its place bloomed a gentle, relieved smile.
"I see… So that's what happened." Her hand lightly pressed against her chest as she sighed in relief.
"Thank the heavens you were there. Had Alise and the others faced that creature alone, things could've ended far worse."
"That's just what a member of the Astraea Familia should do." Akira said, a little exasperated by her concern. "Astraea-sama, there's no need to praise me for that."
Suddenly, Astraea's gaze turned thoughtful.
"Speaking of which…" She said slowly, her voice tinged with curiosity. "Have you… changed in some way?"
"Huh?"
Akira blinked and instinctively glanced over his body. But nothing seemed different. Just as he was about to look up to ask for clarification—
His eyes met hers. Her deep blue eyes, speckled with starlight, locked onto his.
Time seemed to still for a heartbeat.
What followed was a soft, intoxicating fragrance. Their gazes met and grew closer... closer still.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs n̷o̷v̷e̷l̷f̷i̷r̷e̷.net
To witness the growth of a mortal child, especially one that one cherished, is a joy that few gods are ever granted. But to see a change in someone they hold dear, a change so tangible even for gods who exist in eternal stasis…
For Astraea, it was overwhelming.
"Let me see your eyes." She whispered.
The goddess, already leaning close, inched even nearer. Her body pressed subtly against Akira's, their breaths overlapping.
At such close proximity, the calm within Akira's eyes—eyes that never wavered even in the face of monsters—began to shift. As if responding to her divine presence, his pupils widened.
"There's definitely something different about your left eye." Astraea murmured, leaning even closer.
"It used to be just a plain black pupil… but now, there's a light within it. Like a glimmer of something awakening."
"Do you know what it is? Any hidden dangers?"
Her right hand rose and gently cradled his face, brushing his cheek with the tenderness of a breeze, inspecting him with utmost care.
Akira hesitated, then shook his head softly. "There shouldn't be any problem, Astraea-sama. I think… maybe it's just my power evolving."
He knew the reason. Deep down, he understood what had caused the change. But now wasn't the time to explain.
Astraea's warm breath tickled his skin. The walnut-colored hair that fell naturally to her shoulders brushed lightly against his neck, causing a subtle shiver. Akira shifted slightly but didn't dare move too abruptly, fearing he might disturb the delicate moment.
His hands, uncertain of where to rest, slowly crept around Astraea's back. His fingertips brushed against the ends of her hair.
It was soft.
As soft as silk spun from moonlight.
He couldn't help but run his fingers through it gently, entranced by the texture.
The goddess, for all her divine poise, had a troubled expression. Her brows furrowed ever so slightly, like a girl wrestling with complex feelings.
Her body leaned into his—fully pressing against his chest.
Akira could feel every detail. The warmth of her skin. The rhythm of her breathing. The supple softness that pressed gently against him.
His heart skipped a beat, and his gaze involuntarily drifted downward.
To her lips.
Soft, pink, and glistening faintly under the lamplight—they looked as if a single touch would reveal their hidden sweetness.
He wondered, almost unconsciously, just how soft those lips were. How they might taste.
Astraea, ever radiant, radiated affection without even trying. And though she often lamented the chaotic nature of her familia, it was as if she had no awareness of just how dangerously charming she was at this very moment.
But surely… the goddess of justice wouldn't be so easily swayed by her own emotions, right?
Or at least… that's what Akira tried to tell himself.
And then—
"Oh my—"

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Akira Has Changed So Much
chapters.content:
Astraea finally noticed the change in Akira's demeanor. She blinked in surprise, then chuckled lightly when she realized it was nothing more than shyness from their close proximity.
To someone like her—an immortal goddess who had seen all manners of desire and restraint—Akira's bashfulness was endearing. She was satisfied by the subtle effect she had on him, yet at the same time, she had no intention of letting this rare opportunity slip by so easily.
With a serene smile that seemed to carry the warmth of a spring breeze, Astraea lifted her hand and gently brushed her hair behind her ear, revealing the curve of her petite, delicate earlobe. For a brief moment, that pearl-like ear flashed into Akira's view, its translucent white and pink hue so exquisite that it stirred the instinct to lean in and—
No. Focus.
The soft hue of cherry blossom pink had begun to bloom across her cheeks, and that gentle blush stretched slowly to her ears. It was as if a delicate sakura had bloomed on her porcelain skin, painting her beauty with a hint of shy charm.
Her fingers, always soft and warm, gently touched Akira's cheek before lightly brushing down past the corner of his lips. That fleeting contact made his heart skip.
At that moment, a playful glint appeared in Astraea's eyes. Perhaps recalling the light kiss she'd once given her precious familia as a blessing… or maybe she simply found Akira's reactions amusing. Like a girl discovering a delightful toy, she leaned in once more—this time pressing her supple body more fully against him.
Her head came to rest on his shoulder, but she didn't stay still for long. With subtle movement, her breath fanned across his collarbone. It was like a whisper of wind brushing his skin, yet the warmth it brought sparked an inexplicable impulse deep in Akira's chest.
Then came her finger—her slender index finger, like a mischievous sprite—slipping lightly beneath his collar. It moved down slowly, tracing an invisible path on his skin, its teasing touch invoking waves of tingling sensations.
But as her hand reached his collarbone, Astraea suddenly seemed to realize how bold her actions had become. Her face immediately flushed an even deeper red, rich and enticing, like the ripe skin of an apple warmed by the summer sun.
Astraea let out a melodious laugh, clear as a silver bell ringing through the hall. The sound, pure and sweet, lingered like perfume in the air, adding a tender layer of charm to the already warm, ambiguous atmosphere.
Sunlight poured gently through the clean, crystal windows of the familia's base, casting soft golden rays into every corner. The warmth it brought merged with the warmth in their hearts.
After teasing Akira so thoroughly, Astraea stood up gracefully. Every motion was a dance of elegance, and as she leaned down slightly to him once more, a faint, sweet fragrance wafted over.
She extended her hand toward him again—not with divine authority, but with the soft, inviting gesture of a woman and pulled him up with a fluid movement.
Then, with a playful tilt of her head, she stood beside him, raised her hand, and measured the top of their heads.
"Akira seems to have grown a lot taller." She mused, her voice filled with both surprise and maternal pride.
Her starlit-blue eyes softened as she gazed at him. The corners of her lips curled upward into a gentle arc, full of affection and delight.
She remembered clearly—just two months ago, when they first met, Akira had still been half a head shorter than her. But now, standing face-to-face like this, their gazes met on equal ground.
Only two months… but within that fleeting time, Akira had changed so much.
His height had shot up rapidly. His limbs had stretched and thickened, his torso grown broader and sturdier. Beneath his coat, faint lines of lean muscle had begun to form—marks of a boy shedding his youthful innocence and stepping toward manhood.
Even his face had matured, losing its softness and gaining sharpness, while the aura surrounding him grew calmer yet more commanding.
The divine Falna granted by her hand was continuously evolving within him, and with each passing day, the power flowing through Akira became harder to ignore.
Had he not trained himself in rigorous control techniques daily, Astraea had no doubt he would've long surpassed his peers in pure destructive potential alone.
But even more than that, what made her heart swell was that Akira was steadily living up to her expectations. With quiet resilience, he was growing into a steadfast pillar—someone who could support the weight of the Astraea Familia with grace and strength.
"Is that so? That's really something that makes me happy." Akira replied, finally looking up from her snow-white skirt and meeting her gaze. A gentle smile curved on his lips, full of gratitude and serenity.
Just as the two of them settled back onto the soft, luxurious sofa, whispering in hushed tones, an unexpected sound broke the tranquil moment.
"..."
A faint rustle came from the other side of the room, followed by a sleepy groan.
Lying on the edge of another sofa, wrapped in a warm blanket, Alise slowly blinked open her eyes.
There was still a trace of drowsiness in her ruby-red gaze, and she yawned quietly, stretching lazily like a cat basking in morning light.
Her gaze swept across the room and upon seeing her sleeping familia all resting soundly around her, peaceful and unharmed, a radiant smile lit up her face. A smile as warm and dazzling as the sun.
Home… It's really good to be back in this warm place again.
Alise sighed inwardly, her heart filled with relief.
To avoid disturbing the others, she carefully peeled the blanket off her body and tiptoed down from the sofa with practiced grace.
Standing up straight, hands on her hips, Alise exuded the vibrant spirit of a leader who had fully recharged her energy.
Her crimson eyes scanned the room, and then she spotted them—Akira and Astraea, seated closely side by side, whispering softly on the couch.
Akira had a calm and peaceful expression, while Astraea tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear with casual elegance.
The scene, at first glance, appeared innocent.
Yet the keen instincts of a woman, especially a certain red-haired captain with a lively imagination, sounded the silent alarm.
Something… happened.
Alise thought, narrowing her eyes slightly.
Before she could say anything, Astraea noticed her and waved gently with a serene smile. Then, like a child trying to make room in a shared secret, she shifted closer to Akira, silently inviting Alise to join them.
Akira turned toward her and asked softly, "You're awake, captain. How was your rest?"
Alise said nothing at first. She simply raised her arms and struck a powerful pose—her silent declaration that she was back at full strength.Follow current novᴇls on net
